issue:999.body:
### Background and Goal Description

Memory 让 DM 在换了会话以后，还能查到用户说过什么，以及获准读取的邮件、日历等信息。

1. **DM 启用插件。** DM 启动时装配 Memory 的 Ingestion 和 Retrieval 接口。首版建议 Ingestor 用进程内的异步处理流。需要隔离时可以把同一处理流放进子进程，调用方仍用相同接口。
2. **每个获准事件触发一次摄取。** DM 保存会话消息或结果，或连接层确认 App 数据变化后，把事件交给 Ingestion。后台完成分类、裁定如何更新记忆，以及哪些结果应进入可读的 surface。会话可以先返回。
3. **需要时再查。** 后续会话由 DM 按需查询 Memory Provider。记忆发布后，常驻的 Commander 从已授权的变更通道续读，自己决定何时检查有没有值得做的事。来源更新、删除或撤权时，DM 先停止使用旧证据，随后刷新记忆和候选。

例如，用户在会话 A 说「周会前帮我整理未决项」，随后 Gmail 收到一封写着「预算尚未确认」的邮件。Ingestor 分别记录用户的要求和邮件证据。用户换到会话 B 问「还有什么没定」，DM 就能查到预算这一项，并给出邮件出处。

DM 自行实现这套记忆逻辑，沿用 PPMA 中可验证的溯源、版本化和跨 App 对象身份思路。PPMA 和 Linkie 可独立演进。

### Proposed Solution

#### 周会示例时序图

图中是目标流程。Commander 启动后自己观察记忆变更和时间，识别值得行动的情况。用户确认后，DM 才提交任务。

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as 用户／DM UI
    participant S as 会话与 App 来源
    participant H as DM 宿主
    participant M as Memory／Ingestor
    participant C as Proactivity／Commander
    participant A as Router／Session Manager
    participant R as Agent Service
    Note over H,C: DM 按配置启用插件并装配通道
    H->>C: 启动常驻 Commander，提供受限接口
    C->>H: 订阅 Memory 变更，从持久游标续读
    U->>S: 会话 A 交代「周会前整理未决项」
    S->>H: Session Store 持久保存后发出会话事件
    S->>H: 连接层交付已核实的 Gmail 和 Calendar 事件
    H->>M: 经 Memory 事件处理器交付上述来源事件
    M-->>H: 回执确认已持久接收
    Note over M: 异步分类、裁定与发布，推进 surface revision
    M-->>H: 发布带 revision 的 surface 变更
    H-->>C: 经订阅通道交付变更事实
    C->>H: 按引用读取会议时间和用户要求
    H-->>C: 经 Memory Provider 返回当前依据
    C->>C: 更新周会观察条件并保存会前检查时间
    alt 会前窗口内有相关证据变化
        C->>C: 评估该周会是否值得行动
    else 到了自己设定的会前检查时间
        C->>C: 从时钟等待恢复并评估
    end
    C->>H: 请求当前有效证据
    H->>M: 通过 Memory Provider 查询
    M-->>H: 返回会话要求、预算和会议时间
    H-->>C: 返回 surface revision 和有效证据版本
    C->>C: 确认预算仍未决，保存候选
    C-->>H: 发布候选「整理一页会前清单」
    H-->>U: 展示候选
    U->>H: 点开始，确认这个候选版本
    H->>A: 宿主提交任务、证据版本、提交 ID 和事项键
    Note over A: Router 选 Session，Store 复核证据并按事项键去重
    A-->>H: 返回接纳回执及 Run ID
    A->>R: Agent Service 接管已接纳的 Run
    R-->>H: 发布进度，提交清单草稿后报告完成
    H-->>U: Activity 显示进度和结果
```

#### 最终架构与接入点

Memory 包向宿主声明**能力提供者和事件处理器**。下表描述拟定的插件声明及其调用方向，具体注册类型、签名和绑定格式由对应宿主负责人定稿。

| 插件声明 | 宿主何时调用 | 插件返回或提交什么 |
|---|---|---|
| **Retrieval** | Session 绑定读取接口的版本。模型显式检索时走 HostAPI 和 Plugin Gateway。获准的后台消费者通过宿主提供的接口查询和续读。 | 返回当前可读的 surface、`surface_rev`、条目版本及证据引用。已提交的变更按游标续读，供 Commander 更新自己的观察状态。 |
| **归档恢复贡献** | Agent Service 在 `archive_restored` 调用已绑定的 Memory hook，传入已验证的 Session 范围和读取预算。 | 返回有限的上下文及证据引用，由宿主决定纳入本轮的内容。普通回合是否自动 recall、在哪个阶段 recall，留给 HostAPI owner 定稿。 |
| **Ingestion** | Session 生命周期在消息／结果持久提交后交付受限事件，回合结果接 `turn_committed`。连接层交付已核实的对象变化。纠正、删除等 Memory 命令也由同一写入所有者处理。 | 返回持久接收回执。后台处理完成后登记发布结果或无变更结果。 |

装配时，Registry 解析精确版本及声明的依赖，Profile 决定是否启用。Session 绑定读取和恢复接口的版本。**每个工作区只有一个 Memory 写入所有者**，不同读取版本通过兼容接口访问同一写入域。首版建议用有界的进程内异步处理流，依靠持久接收记录恢复未完成事件。子进程作为部署选项，沿用相同的事件、回执和发布语义。后台提取使用宿主授予的身份、数据权限和模型预算。 [注册与绑定 ADR](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/adr/0003-registration-and-binding.md) · [V3.1 生命周期与接入点](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/visions/README.md)

V3.1 的 Registry 参考实现已有精确版本的 `core`、`model`、`tool`、`skill` 装配。Memory 的工具部分可沿用 Provider 模式。恢复 hook 由 M22 跟进，持久来源事件的订阅、接收回执和重放仍需宿主契约。M22／M38 计划中的目标目录为 `plugins/memory/`。 [Registry 参考实现](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/registry/README.md) · [M22 #791](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/791) · [M38 #810](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/810)

#### 摄取、读取与失效

1. **提交来源事件。** DM 先提交 Session 消息或结果，再交付事件。连接层核实账号和对象状态后交付同形事件。来源接口携带服务端解析的 `scope`、生产者命名空间内的 `event_id`、`source_key`、对象版本 `source_rev`、三方授权代次 `grant_epoch`、操作和补录标志。更新携带可按版本读取的内容引用。Webhook 只有变更提示且版本不可比较时，由连接层核实当前快照再登记版本。
2. **分类、裁定、发布。** Categorization 识别事件中的承诺、状态等记录及其证据。Jurisdiction 结合当前 surface，裁定可以新增、更新或撤下哪条记录，以及写入哪个范围。Promotion 决定哪些结果可以进入可读 surface，并生成变更。三步是逻辑阶段，可合并实现。同一事件和内容重放时恢复原回执及已提交结果，内容冲突显式失败。中断可以重试，成功发布只发生一次。无变更的处理结果也记录。历史补录可建立记忆，单独补录保持静默。
3. **按需读取。** `ModelCall` 与 `AgentCall` 都可使用合格的记忆。Session Store 按自己的上下文版本推进，追加新消息时已有消息的证据版本仍有效。同一会话的下一轮直接读已提交历史，跨 Session 可见性从 Memory 发布开始。普通 recall 可以按预算超时降级，显式引用的证据失效时返回可区分的错误。「记住」和「忘掉」以 Provider 的操作回执为准。
4. **失效优先于重算。** 来源更新使旧对象版本失效，删除留下删除标记，撤权关闭整代连接授权。有效版本提交后，随后开始的读取和任务接纳都须排除旧证据。派生记忆、索引和候选投影随后清理。迟到的提取结果无法恢复旧版本。合并记忆若仍有独立依据，可从剩余证据重新生成。会话转述的 App 内容保留原始依赖。用户亲自陈述的独立承诺仍按自身权限可读。

#### Surface revision 与防重

Surface 是某个作用域当前可读的记忆视图。每次提交改变内容、证据或可见性时，推进该 surface 的 `surface_rev`。回放和无变更结果保持原 revision。发布后，读取只能看到已提交的版本，变更记录可以续读。Retrieval 同时返回实际使用的 `memory_id + memory_rev` 和 `source_refs`。

Commander 按游标追变更，用 `surface_rev` 识别已观察过的版本。它记录候选实际依赖的条目和来源版本。整个 surface 推进后，可以只复核那些依赖。另一条无关记忆的变化无需撤回周会候选。某个事项是否已经开过 Run 由 DM 接纳记录判断。 [Proactivity 的接纳幂等](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/998)

**共同的提交边界。** 目前提议由 DM Store 维护小型有效版本索引，供接纳事务校验证据。来源所有者和 Memory Provider 通过公开接口推进各自版本。DM 撤权以有效状态提交为准，三方变化从 DM 核实并登记后生效。Ingestor 先持久化可恢复的提取结果，再以当前来源和所读版本为条件发布。发布点一次确定事件结果、可见 revision 和变更记录。旧结果与当前证据冲突时重新判断。Store 在写接纳回执的同一事务里校验证据和事项身份。具体存储与发布事务仍由 Memory、Store 和 Agent Service 定稿。 [V3.1 Store 接纳契约](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f27cd2630f3ebd77c8cf49f9353796408872e346/docs/specs/session-store-admission.md)

#### 当前重构阶段的交付方式

当前主线经 `server_engine.engine_cli` 启动。首页的 Session Affinity 已运行在 `dm_sessions` 与现有 Bridge 上。当前 Memory 由 `EngineMemory` 的目录与证据链、兼容 `MemoryStore` 和 `FactKeeper/MemoryStep` 等路径共同提供。可用现有 `memory.read`／`memory.search` 刻画权限和检索行为，用 `FactKeeper.after_run` 刻画回合后触发。可重放的事件交付需要单独证明。目标 `server/plugin_gateway/` 和 `plugins/memory/` 在这份主线基线上尚未落地。 [当前生产边界和 Memory 归属](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f27cd2630f3ebd77c8cf49f9353796408872e346/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/architecture-gate.md) · [现有 Memory 读取入口](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f27cd2630f3ebd77c8cf49f9353796408872e346/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_service.py#L2712) · [A32 #758](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/758)

| 阶段 | 开发与验证范围 |
|---|---|
| **现在** | 由测试装配器用 DM Session 样本及 Gmail／Calendar 回放驱动异步 Ingestion。以真实临时存储验证 surface revision、回执、重放和失效。先以影子读评估质量，生产记忆写入仍由现有所有者承担。 |
| **迁移过渡** | 若现有所有者能提供已发布、可重放的输入接口，可在当前入口装配薄适配器。记录调用方、唯一写入方、替换条件和迁移 owner。以此接入取决于实际接口和权限，夹具验证可先行。真实 App 由 M43／M44 的连接所有者补齐后台订阅或增量同步及撤权。 |
| **目标切换** | 等 A32、M22／M38 的实际消费者接通后，将支持的记忆路径统一委派给新 Provider。盘点现存数据、引用和读者，验证格式与历史读取。在切换写入权之前阻止旧写入方继续提交。回退按兼容范围恢复受支持入口，保留已提交记录与失效状态。 |

[并行开发与临时适配器规则](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f27cd2630f3ebd77c8cf49f9353796408872e346/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md) · [M43 #833](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/833) · [M44 #834](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/834)

#### 开发前需要厘清的核心细节

| 负责方 | 需要做出的决定 |
|---|---|
| **Session Store／连接层／Memory** | 定首版事件种类、提交点、生产者幂等键、游标和保留窗口。明确用户消息何时可摄取、哪些完成结果可作为证据，以及取消、清空会话、编辑和权限变化如何产生失效。历史事件若超出保留窗口，明确何时要重新同步。 |
| **Memory／连接层／产品** | 定每类内容的访问、保留和删除范围，尤其是私人会话、工作区共享、三方引用、模型可见内容及撤权后的索引与缓存清理。确定连接重新授权时如何切换代次。 |
| **Memory／Store／Agent Service** | 定有效版本索引的归属和提交顺序。明确如何恢复已持久化但未发布的记忆，如何保证删除／撤权与接纳的竞争结果可解释，以及条件接纳暂不可用时的退化行为。 |
| **Memory／Registry／HostAPI** | 定 Provider、恢复 hook 和事件处理器分别用哪个扩展类型注册，谁装配与调用，哪些版本随 Session 绑定。明确启用配置、可选 recall 超时与已绑定版本缺失各如何表现。 |
| **Memory／Runtime／部署** | 定异步处理流的恢复、容量和隔离需求。如果选择子进程，再定 IPC 和就绪。确定 Provider 版本与存储格式的兼容范围，以及现有 MemoryStore／EngineMemory 的读者迁移和唯一写入切换。 |
| **Memory／Proactivity** | 定 Commander 主动订阅或续读的通道、最小查询、证据引用与变更语义。明确后台消费者可见的数据范围、补录静默及游标失效时如何重新同步。 |

### Involved Public APIs

Memory 暴露 Ingestion 和 Retrieval。需要定稿的是持久接收与恢复语义、surface revision 和条目版本、可续读的变更通道，以及发布时的版本比较。首版建议使用进程内异步流，子进程沿用同一契约。

### Test Verification

以下为计划验收。

Session A 记录「周会前整理未决事项」。Calendar 回放给出会议时间，Gmail 邮件给出预算和报价两项。Session B 能引用三条来源。邮件更新为「报价已完成」后，旧记忆立即失去读取资格，新版本只保留预算。删除邮件并重放旧事件时，邮件事实仍不可读，独立的用户承诺和日历信息保留。撤销 Gmail 授权则覆盖同一代的全部 Gmail 证据。

让旧提取晚于来源更新完成，让写入后丢失回执，再让 Commander 停止消费变更。分别观察旧结果无法发布、同一事件重放只得到原结果和 revision，以及旧候选被当前证据拒绝。再验证无变更事件保持原 revision。在接纳与撤权的事务边界强制两种提交顺序，以 Store 回执和可见内容验收。

插件装配验收用同一宿主分别启用和关闭 Memory，验证新 Session 的绑定与事件派发随 Profile 变化。再切换 Provider 版本，验证旧 Session 解析原绑定或报告该版本缺失，同一来源的摄取写入仍只经过一个所有者。

### Additional Supplementary Information

配套提案见 [Proactivity RFC](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/998)。

本提案沿用既有后端重构方向，并和 V3.1 迁移任务协调。 [后端模块化重构 #505](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/505) · [V3.1 迁移 #737](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737)

### Before submitting a new issue

- [x] Please confirm that you have searched the previous RFC documents

长任务在等待回复时缺少可读进展。Home 会话展示一个紧凑气泡，从模型显式提供的公开 `progress_text` 中筛选并展示原句，动态三个点表示运行中；过滤空白、少量无信息短句和过短未完成片段，限制逐字符扩展带来的刷新。新合适文案替换旧文案，没有合适内容时保留上一次文案；没有可用公开文案时不凭空生成。

pr:1022.body:
## What

Keep complete JSON object/array replies byte-for-byte intact during web citation presentation. The bridge currently treats URL values as prose citations and silently deletes them when they are absent from its native source registry.

Observed in three search conformance trials: the model retrieved the document through Python/bash and returned the correct answer, source URL and evidence. After an earlier `fetch_webpage` call, the legacy completion cleanup changed every `"source":"http://web-search:9001/documents/..."` value to `"source":""`. Retrieval, answer and evidence checks passed, but all three source checks failed.

The candidate guards the legacy cleanup and opt-in web presentation entry points. It does not infer verified sources from shell text, add source bindings, relax prose citation validation, or change stored benchmark scores. Malformed JSON and prose containing JSON-like fragments still follow existing cleanup.

Related infrastructure: #783 (DM31-M12); this PR does not complete that migration task.

## Routing and scope

- Source: main `77a425ec9e41f114c63574f0d2a8a4bd96549023`; candidate `aade5ab65716dc035e5edf52668eb4acc52909bd`.
- Supported path: existing `server_engine.server.Bridge._execute_jiuwen`, both legacy and free-search presentation modes.
- Owner: registered `legacy-mobile-gateway` / Mobile Gateway owner (DM31-M01); source/citation migration carry-forward belongs with DM31-M12.
- Writable files: `server_engine/server.py` and the existing `test_web_reply_presentation.py` only. No new module, published interface, Store writer, schema, adapter, or runtime activation.
- Transition: no new adapter to retire. Carry the structured-output regression into the future source/presentation owner at its cutover.

## Before and after

Before: `{"answer":"code","source":"http://web-search:9001/documents/record","evidence":"A fact."}` becomes the same JSON with an empty source.

After: the entire JSON response is preserved. It still has no verified source binding. Ordinary unread prose links continue to be removed.

## Verified

Interpreter: isolated CPython 3.12.15 environment; editable contracts and engine from this exact checkout, bridge dependencies from its pyproject, vendored Mandate wheel, pytest 9.2.0. No production deployment. Offline tests used no credentials; the later live test used the configured model provider through Nullius’s relay without exposing credentials to DigitalMate.

- Red: the six JSON presentation cases fail on unmodified main. Both real Bridge completion regression cases also fail on main (exit 1), including the legacy path that produces the observed empty source.
- Green: focused presentation, unread-citation, source-link and reply-stream tests passed. The expanded nine-file regression selection completed with **204 passed, 8 skipped, 7 failed, 236 subtests passed** (exit 1).
- All seven remaining failures reproduced on unmodified main: one removed search-setting field rejected by configuration, and six SearchSessionTest setup failures from an undefined `ScriptedBackend`. They were not modified or waived.
- Bridge tests use the real execution/completion code and temporary source store. ScriptedBackend supplies controlled tool/model events, and runtime connectivity is stubbed. These are not live model or actual shell retrieval tests.
- Private replay of the three recorded final model answers preserves all three URLs in both presentation modes. The recorded retrieval/answer/evidence checks were already true. This is replay evidence, not a newly scored live run; original results remain unchanged and no run data is included here.

## Summary

Group the DigitalMate product-center artifacts by the authoritative session-affinity topic instead of showing one flat list. The artifact center is a read-only projection: `DigitalMateConversation.artifactTopicAssignments()` maps `taskId -> conversationId -> conversation title` from the existing `session_proximity` snapshot, walks `parent_task_id` for child artifacts, and degrades missing or cyclic parents to 未归类. Display identity is always the ID-based key, so retitling a conversation changes only the label.

`ArtifactPresentation.artifactTopicGroups()` is a pure, unit-tested function: same-topic tasks merge, same-title conversations stay separate, same-name files are not deduped, files sort by generation time with a stable fallback, and search matches the topic title (all files) or individual file names (only matches). The page renders expandable topic rows with count and latest time, preserves loading/retry/empty/no-result states, and reuses the existing preview/open/download/delete actions. No second artifact write path, no new download, and no change to session-affinity classification or routing.

Closes #1048

## Version history (blocked server dependency)

- Client keeps only the last receipt per `(taskId, path)` (`DigitalMateConversation.ets:1100-1106`).

## 背景

bot（`agent-CI-Infra-bot`）的检视打标原先是通用规则：按 `type/*`、`priority/*`、`area/*` 这类斜杠轴选标签，并把 `priority/medium` 当默认。这与本仓库实际标签体系不匹配——这里是 `priority:P0/P1/P2`、`client`/`backend`/`hybrid`、`source:*`、`channel:*`。结果是模型选出的名字大多落在 `repository_labels` 之外，被控制面静默丢弃，等于不分类。

## 本 PR 做了什么

- 新增 `.bot/rules/labels.md`。这是 bot 文档规定的仓库级规则路径（`docs/rules.md`），整份覆盖内置 `labels.md`，每次检视都会注入。
- 规则内容对齐 #996 的 `.agents/skills/digitalmate-issue-triage`：只处理未指派且类型为 bug / UX / Experience feedback 的 Issue；四个维度（技术范围、优先级、source、channel）各最多一个值；优先级必须恰好一个 P0/P1/P2；只用现有标签，不新建、不改名；不覆盖人工已给的维度。
- 保留首行 `review_label: bot-reviewed`，检视标签行为不变。
- 全部标签名已对照仓库线上 43 个标签校验，无自造名称。

## 与 #996 的关系

#996 的 skill 已经在 main 上，bot 会把 `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` 作为按需 skill 索引（`docs/rules.md`）。但 skill 是按需读的，而 `labels.md` 是每个任务都注入的规则层。两份配合：本文件负责“每次检视必须怎么选标签”，skill 负责“分诊细节和责任田”。

## 生效方式

规则只从默认分支读（PR 内的改动不影响当次任务）。合入 `main` 后，下一次 Issue 检视即按新规则打标。注意：本 PR 改了 `.bot/`，bot 检视这个 PR 时会在总结里提示“改变了 bot 行为，需要人决定”，这是预期行为。

## 范围影响

feature / documentation / RFC / Competition feedback 等类型不再添加分类标签，只保留 `bot-reviewed`；这与 #996 skill 的 issueScope 一致。如果希望 feature 也自动分类，需要在后续 PR 里放宽本文件的处理范围。

## Summary

Implements the approved scope of `docs/plans/session-artifact-grouping-proposal.md`:

- The server keeps prior artifact receipts for the same task + path, stamps each receipt with its delivery time, and serves a published receipt's immutable snapshot when the deliverable path now points at a later version.
- The DigitalMate client projects a version chain (`artifactVersions`) and a task → conversation owner map (`artifactOwners`), registers history versions in a separate file catalog, and groups the artifact center ("产物中心") by session-affinity conversation. Expanding a topic lists each readable version with a "第 i/n 版" label; preview/open/download/delete are reused.
- Chat cards are unchanged: `artifacts()` still returns only the latest active receipt per task + path. Delete stays local-hide only; no server delete contract was added.

Design and limits: `docs/design/artifact-version-history.md`.

## Server

- `artifact_versions.py`: append-merge receipts, dedupe by receipt id, keep the existing 100-per-task cap.
- `engine_service.py` / `server.py`: use the append merge and add `created_at` from the ledger `applied_at`; wire the snapshot store into the attachments reader.
- `engine_attachments.py`: for a envelope whose path was overwritten, read the receipt's snapshot from `SnapshotStore` after validating receipt, path and SHA-256. Missing or mismatched content fails explicitly with "This version is unavailable"; the current file is never returned as an old version.
- `workswarm_artifacts.py`: byte quota counts retained ids, while the file-count quota stays per path.

## Client

- `cloud-adapter`: `DigitalMateArtifactVersionView` / `DigitalMateArtifactOwner`, `artifactVersions()` and `artifactOwners()` (parent-chain lookup with cycle guard, room-scoped keys, "未归类" fallback).
- `file-service`: optional `versionIndex` / `versionCount` on remote/view/record.
- `entry`: history catalog in `DigitalMateArtifactFiles` (`syncHistory`, `currentHistoryFiles`, `artifactCenterContext`), topic rendering in `DigitalMateHome/Index.ets`, and per-file catalog resolution so chat cards and artifact-center rows each read their own catalog.

python -m py_compile ... (modified server modules)

pr:1039.body: ## Problem Fixes #971. In a later turn or a new conversation, the agent answers "no repository is connected" (or "I can't create issues") even though `gh issue create` already worked in this workspace. The route never became durable: - `MemoryStep` stores only facts quoted from the person's message, so the agent's own sentence ("the sandbox `gh` can create issues here") is never stored. That is deliberate: storing model claims would make a hallucination or a prompt injection durable. - `EditLearner` stores procedural lessons only from user edits, not from successful runs. - Recall is lexical and window-bound, and the GitHub connector inventory has read/comment/prefilled-form operations only, so nothing in the brief said the shell route exists. ## Change Record a route only from a successful tool receipt, and keep it in every brief: - **`server_engine/engine_brief.py`** now holds the capability registry, next to the brief it feeds (so #971 needs no new production module and no ownership-policy change): - `CapabilityRegistry.observe_tool_result` records `github.issue.create` from a successful shell result (`bash`, `Bash`, `shell`, `exec_command`, `commandExecution`, ...). A record needs the create at a command position *and* the issue URL `gh` prints; a grep, echo, comment line or create without a URL is not proof. - A failed receipt marks the record `stale` only when the environment's answer (the receipt's `Command:` echo is stripped) says sign-in or the executable is gone; a repository-scoped denial stales only that repository. A rejected title or body keeps the route. - `brief` renders a short `[capabilities]` section for records that are available and not older than 30 days. A route with no successful receipt is never listed, and background (ambient) tasks get no route to write. - **`server.py`** feeds every `tool_result` frame to the registry, the same frames the activity and breaker paths already read. - **`engine_service.py`** initializes the registry; `assemble_brief` injects the section through the existing `for_agents` gate. - **`ROUTING_NOTE`** tells the model to read `[capabilities]` before declaring an app operation unavailable. Nothing here stores a model-authored claim: only a tool receipt can create a route. ## Tests Run from `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests` with Python 3.13 and `PYTHONUTF8=1`, repo root on `PYTHONPATH`: - `pytest test_engine_capabilities.py -q` — **18 passed**: success keeps the route in a later brief; one record per repository; lost sign-in stales and omits it; a rejected create (including a real `Command:/Stdout:/Stderr:/Exit Code:` receipt whose title says "permission denied") keeps the route; a grep/echo/comment mention and a create without an issue URL are not evidence; a multi-line or indented `gh issue create` is recorded; argv-list commands; repository-scoped denial; TTL expiry; ambient tasks; restart. - `pytest test_engine_capabilities.py test_engine_brief.py -q` — **80 passed, 16 subtests passed**. - `test_engine_service.py` / `test_server_scope.py`: 5 failures + 13 errors, identical on the unmodified head of this branch with the same interpreter and `PYTHONPATH` (openjiuwen `AgentSpec` version mismatch), so this change introduces no regression there. - `ruff check` on `engine_brief.py` and the capability tests — clean. (`engine_service.py` has 5 pre-existing F401/F821 findings at the branch head, unrelated to this diff.) - Architecture scan with **both** the base policy (`f02f5d8a`) and this branch's policy — 283 files / 38 checked / **0 findings**; `manifest.py --check` — 56 owners / 0 exceptions. Not run: the complete bridge suite. Its collection needs `pytest-xdist` (not installed here) and `tests/test_model_failure.py` also errors at collection; without `pytest-timeout` the full run hangs, so I stopped it rather than claim a result. ## Limits - Only a route that has already succeeded can be kept. A workspace where `gh` has never run successfully still needs a connector write operation (option B in the issue discussion); this PR does not add one. - Records are workspace-scoped with a 30-day TTL; a lost sign-in or executable marks them stale. ## Verification screenshots DevEco simulator against the isolated deployment (patched runtime on port 20016), same request in both rounds; the keyboard/clipboard area is cropped. The injected `[capabilities]` brief and the `gh: not found` receipt are in the verification comment below. Round 1, no capability record (baseline) — the reply says no GitHub account is connected: Round 2, after a (seeded) capability record — the model attempts `gh issue create` and reports the tool missing: Closes #971

pr:1066.body:
## 2026-11-14：与当前 main 的对照

此草稿是基于 `29516ada` 的 P2 替代实现，尚未与当前 main（`c26c27fa206907542f4cd6e506833e92aab863f5`）完成代码对齐。#1190 已在 main 实现云端发起的手机日历读取：结果关联当前任务和交互、限时存于进程内并一次取出；进一步分析时日历字段可能作为上下文发送至配置的模型服务。

本草稿仍提供可评估的更严格候选方案，包括将授权绑定到选定执行、约束敏感结果流转和检查模型服务策略。它与当前主干的实现路径不同，不能视作已在 main 启用；原有 owner、完整隔离测试、真实设备及服务商验收条件仍然有效。下方历史测试结果只对应其标注的原始提交，并非当前 main 或重整代码的验收结果。

---

## Problem and scope

Complete the 2026-11-10 device/cloud calendar design's P2 read-only path: bind an explicit local user grant to the actual admitted task and selected WorkSwarm execution, then allow one private model request to consume the result. Raw tool results and private authority stay outside ordinary conversation state, checkpoints, generic callbacks and frame diagnostics.

This PR remains **Draft** while trusted owner admission, complete isolated server validation, and actual device/provider acceptance remain open. The repaired-source Node, native compilation/Hypium unit and Code Check runs now pass; the standard CI acceptance verdict remains **`local-required`**. P3 date-selection continuation and P4 calendar writes remain outside this change.

Main advanced during publication and included PR #1082, which reverted the older P1 calendar foundation. This update integrates that main, removes the old pre-read/date-parser/text-context helpers, and retains the minimum reader and whole-calendar read permission needed by the P2 tool. Main's location, activity-clock retirement and new trajectory behavior are preserved.

## Changes

- Add private capability/ready/result/cancel messages, canonical scope checks, bounded date windows and UTF-8 payload limits. The device owns intent and consent; explicit refusals and unrelated/third-party requests cannot create grants. Page, account, connection, task and cancellation changes revoke access.
- Connect the actual mobile Bridge, Gateway request, AgentServer, selected InterfaceDeep child, DeepAgent/ReAct tool and final model send. A bounded memory broker permits one read per tool call and one-time consumption of each result, tied to the admitted task, submission, execution epoch and runtime generation. Ordinary tool state retains only an opaque marker.
- Keep private frame bodies out of WebSocket log records before record construction, clear sensitive ingress/error copies, and sanitize provider diagnostic/error extensions. The producer tests drain the real background-memory owner through its public shutdown hook before checking files and provider requests for the canary.
- Require a valid credential-bound provider-policy receipt and a supported HTTPS Chat Completions transport. The receipt is an operator attestation; it does not itself prove a provider's account retention or training settings. Missing, expired, mismatched or unsupported policy keeps calendar access off. Private sends do not retry, redirect or reuse cached raw bodies.
- Preserve current main's retained-context contracts. Calendar capability is supported on the default owned WorkSwarm normal path; hosted/retained, factory and unsupported runtime/provider modes keep it disabled while retaining ordinary chat.
- Declare imported-source changes and first-party additions with strict path/mode/blob checks, preserve original upstream manifests/revisions, and declare the actual broker/caller ownership delta for trusted-policy review. Its formal admission is still blocked, as documented below.

- Fix ArkTS `10605038 / arkts-no-untyped-obj-literals` by explicitly typing the empty capabilities parameters. Extend the actual client/bridge/reader round-trip test to preserve one empty-params request with exactly the existing wire keys. No consent, lifecycle, caching or retry rule changes.
- Add native/device acceptance instructions and a nine-case owner-registration audit; retain original failed results and distinguish every executed participant from pending device/provider evidence.

## Source identity

- Integrated main: `29516ada27d0e9aac208cb0c536f96c9ee42de28`; actual main merge: `0b1a31bdcf415a9caf6009e1e080a3e8396899e8`.
- Initial follow-up head: `e7af3a8c0660ab8f44bb8f2394caab51d4861c7d`; its first native compile failed and is retained in the new record.
- Published production fix: `ea7f3ca2d588878dbc2724a11d6494e20ac2dc37`.
- **Tested implementation/test head:** `a0371e039a23f5c737910c7747e9a859423b3f21`; complete tree `95626a2761d0b63889f6e629028438748836070a`.
- **Final documentation head:** `f674f2ca74aa178ed74dbca1cc49a7cf07c3bd2e`; complete tree `eb5e763d1ce5a9c424494802277d93a372668eb0`.
- Both complete remote trees were read back and exactly match the respective frozen local trees, including paths, file modes and blobs. Only six Markdown files changed after the tested implementation head; the passing runs below are explicitly attributed to `a0371e0`, not relabeled as executions on the later documentation head.

## Validation

| Check | Actual source / observed result |
| --- | --- |
| [Standard CI #1334](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/42858633843) | `a0371e0`, normal branch `workflow_dispatch`, all four server inputs empty. **Success**, 10 min 6 s. The successful report's acceptance verdict is **`local-required`**. |
| Node in CI #1334 | **3,442 total: 3,434 pass, 0 fail, 0 cancelled, 8 skip**; job 4 min 43 s. The real pinned-browser runner completed this gate. |
| Native compilation and Hypium in CI #1334 | **BUILD SUCCESSFUL; 2,305 tests, 2,305 pass, 0 failure, 0 error, 0 ignore**; job 7 min 30 s. This executes `entry/src/test`, not calendar `ohosTest` or real P2 device scenarios. |
| [ArkTS Code Check #1819](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/42859316858) | `a0371e0`, manual branch run. **PASS**, exit 0, **0 errors / 6,316 warnings / 0 suggestions**, 338 files with findings; 2 min 39 s. Existing rules are unchanged. |
| Affected local regression after the type fix | **196 / 196 pass**, 0 fail/skip/cancel, 4.418 s; overlaps the complete Node run. |
| [Trusted-main architecture CI #1331](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/42855656171) | Trusted workflow/main `29516ada`, explicit candidate `e7af3a8`: **FAIL** at `Enforce trusted source policy`. The corresponding local trusted scan reports one AR10 for the new broker, 288 production / 42 enforced modules. |
| Complete isolated server LOCAL_REQUIRED preflight | **BLOCKED before suites**, exit 2: inherited host home/credential environment; this environment has no Docker/Podman boundary. The earlier focused server passes do not replace this gate. |
| Final documentation/readback | **PASS**: six reviewed Markdown files, 76 relative links checked, balanced code fences, clean whitespace, exact complete remote tree. |

The final gate report records Node and Hypium passes, while ST, architecture-conformance and server-ut-st are skipped in this branch-dispatch profile. It explicitly requires exact-candidate architecture/server evidence and independent review under #1014. Manual runs do not turn the Draft PR's skipped `pull_request_target` checks into executed checks or grant merge acceptance.

Node reports **76.8% loaded-source line coverage (11,884 / 15,470 lines)** across 56 loaded production ETS files out of 592; 536 files are excluded. This is not whole-application coverage. The local pinned Chromium download remains blocked by an HTTP 200 HTML “Site Unavailable” response instead of a ZIP; the successful remote Node result belongs to its own runner and source.

The [earlier main-integration evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/calendar-device-bridge/docs/verification/device-calendar-p2-main29516-2026-11-10.md) retains the original 580 focused client, 68 core/context/observability, 162 bridge/runtime/producer and 28 provenance passes with their exact commands and controlled participants. The client type repair changes no backend/runtime source. Those older results are preserved with their original source and are not claimed as newly rerun suites here. The actual producer's enabled JSONL/rehydrated-SQLite privacy checks and loopback TLS tests remain bounded tests with controlled external phone/provider participants.

The earlier candidate-policy architecture result (288 / 43, zero findings) remains valid only under that explicitly supplied proposed policy. It is **not** a trusted-main policy PASS. The nine registration experiments demonstrate that active policy without source fails, planned registration does not admit production code, and adding the full broker together with policy still fails under the existing trusted baseline.

Detailed current evidence: [native CI follow-up](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/calendar-device-bridge/docs/verification/device-calendar-p2-native-ci-2026-11-10.md), [owner-registration prerequisite audit](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/calendar-device-bridge/docs/verification/device-calendar-owner-registration-2026-11-10.md), and [native/device validation runbook](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/calendar-device-bridge/docs/developer_guide/device-calendar-native-validation.md).

## Remaining gates

1. **Trusted broker owner admission.** Review the exact 21-added/1-removed-line registry delta and the recorded nine-case matrix. There is no already accepted generic calendar initialization path. A new finite checker-contract producer requires specific maintainer acceptance and independent review under repository change control before implementation. This PR does not weaken the checker, borrow consumed ADR-0017/Root/Hosted authority, or treat candidate policy as trusted. After an accepted producer actually lands, update from real main and revalidate the final candidate.
2. **Complete isolated server LOCAL_REQUIRED evidence.** Obtain the supported isolated runner/image and run the full unmodified enrolled suites, installed-package checks, bounded collector and cleanup receipt. Keep the actual preflight failure visible; focused tests are not a replacement.
3. **Actual product/device acceptance.** Build and record product/test HAPs, install on a specifically allocated device, execute the five registered no-I/O calendar preflights, and perform N01–N09 authorization/read/revocation/TTL/lifecycle scenarios. Native unit success does not establish these results.
4. **Live selected-provider/privacy acceptance.** Verify the actual account/credential policy and supported HTTPS chunked path, then execute and correlate the real phone → broker → owned runtime → provider sequence and durable-output checks. No production activation receipt or provider retention/training evidence is fabricated from fixtures or `store:false`.
5. **Independent final review and applicable final-candidate gates.** Keep this PR open and Draft until the real obligations are satisfied. Passing manual jobs and documentation publication do not authorize merge or deployment.

pr:1077.body:
**What type of PR is this?**
/kind bug

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:
DigitalMate currently exposes both WorkSwarm native web search/read tools and the product search MCP; model turns can mix them, repeat searches and add latency. Register only the product search and page-read tools in the DigitalMate managed runtime, including code mode, even when permission checks are disabled. Keep upstream WorkSwarm behavior unchanged when the product switch is absent. Return the first usable search results without a default merge delay (the configurable `DIGITALMATE_FREE_SEARCH_GRACE` restores a wait). Filter structural navigation, footer, aside and form regions from search page text, while retaining the existing watch extraction behavior and text limits. If search fails, report failure rather than silently inventing results. Native search is no longer a model-visible fallback; product search retains its own parallel-engine and retry behavior.

Routing: product launcher and search MCP own this existing supported WorkSwarm path; narrowly scoped WorkSwarm registration switches retain the upstream default and are recorded in `harness/UPSTREAM.json`. No new state owner or durable schema is introduced.

For the mixed Chinese / Latin-name news and special-review queries reported in #1064, deployments can opt in with `DIGITALMATE_FREE_SEARCH_NAMED_NEWS=1`. The free search tool checks the subject in each lead's title or snippet. When ordinary engines return off-topic results or exhaust their results, it can request one Bing News feed within the existing search deadline and return direct publisher links. If no lead matches, the tool reports a miss and does not cache unrelated links. The opt-in covers a single explicit Latin-script name and supported Chinese news/review intents plus common English model rewrites. After a search miss, managed guidance prioritizes known official/editorial page reads. Transliteration, content freshness and review quality still require separate evaluation. Deployments default to the existing provider policy.

The integrated change also preserves an article inside a full-page form and applies the unified-tool switch when paid search configuration reloads. WorkSwarm source identities were regenerated against the merged source.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
Related #1064 (search relevance and repeated tool calls). Related historical change: #376 introduced product-first search with native fallback.

**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：
**Expanded test-6 verification — `fee9c0fd` / `d13046ad` search sources (2026-11-13)**

**HOLD MERGE. The expanded run does not establish an overall latency improvement.** The new policy reduces simple-query search expansion in some cases, but model compliance is inconsistent, factual lookups still time out, and the runtime can bypass the product page reader through general bash/Python tools. #1064 remains unresolved. No merge or shared deployment was performed.

The additional code at `d13046ad` asks ordinary lookups to stop after sufficient evidence, target one or two readable sources, reuse successful page text, preserve offset continuation, and limit simple-query reformulation. These are model instructions, **not enforced tool budgets or a new deduplication cache**. All three production search files are byte-identical after the conflict-free merge of main `34f3d1cc` into `fee9c0fd`.

| Case, same order within each six-turn conversation | Control `27ca812d` | Candidate | Search calls control → candidate | Page attempts control → candidate |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Louis C.K. news | 122.69 s (cancelled) | 111.48 s | 8 → 4 | 18 → 13 |
| Dave Chappelle news | 101.91 s | 59.30 s | 6 → 2 | 16 → 4 |
| Louis C.K. special reviews | 104.57 s | 36.33 s | 3 → 1 | 10 → 3 |
| Taylor Swift news | 77.53 s | 145.48 s | 5 → 6 | 12 → 10 |
| Oppenheimer professional reviews | 87.57 s | 47.11 s | 2 → 1 | 7 → 4 |
| Verify alleged NASA 2030 crewed Jupiter landing | 87.34 s | 39.49 s | 3 → 2 | 7 → 2 |
| Forbidden City closing day and exceptions | 56.78 s | 31.47 s | 2 → 2 | 4 → 4 |
| Chang'e-6 return date and lunar sample origin | 36.73 s | 120.84 s (cancelled) | 2 → 3 | 6 → 26 |
| DeepSeek-V3 release date and public artifacts | 22.17 s | 98.94 s | 0 → 3 | 2 → 8 |
| Ne Zha 2 reviews | 46.95 s | 100.51 s | 1 → 1 | 12 → 13 |
| China space station news and event/report dates | 22.02 s | 76.52 s | 0 → 0 | 2 → 12 |
| Verify alleged permanent free Forbidden City admission | 43.59 s | 27.01 s | 0 → 0 | 2 → 2 |

**Observed totals (not a production-speed estimate):** 809.85 → 894.48 s, candidate +84.63 s (+10.5%). Both returned 11/12 final answers, with one cancellation each. Control produced 10/12 source-backed answers: its Chang'e-6 reply admitted that the facts had not been verified against a usable source. Candidate produced 11/12 answers with citations traceable to successful reads in the same conversation. All its citation URLs were checked against actual tool results; two review citations reused successful reads from the earlier turn. Core facts were manually sampled, including closure exceptions, the release date, review scores, and the two false-premise questions; this is not exhaustive external fact grading.

Search calls: **32 → 25**. MCP page attempts: 98 → 96, but the candidate also made **five successful page reads through bash/Python**, making its actual observed total **101**, not 96. Three bash calls occurred on the space-station case: curl was unavailable; Python fetched the news index and then four original articles. Those four article URLs were present in actual stdout and support the citations. Consequently a generic-tool bypass remains; do not interpret unified registration as an enforced ban on all other HTTP access. Two candidate fetch outcomes were unavailable when Chang'e-6 was cancelled, and are included as attempted reads.

Exact duplicate direct-fetch argument sets (URL, offset, max_chars) were **0 in both variants**. Each variant made four explicit offset continuations. Repeated URLs alone therefore overstate wasted reads. The result supports fewer search invocations, not a demonstrated reduction of exact duplicate fetches. Extra searches, broader source coverage and source failures still cause long tails. Examples: DeepSeek-V3 22.17 → 98.94 s; Ne Zha 2 46.95 → 100.51 s; Taylor Swift 77.53 → 145.48 s.

**Method and limits:** 12 distinct cases x two variants = 24 attempts; one isolated six-turn conversation for each group/variant, with explicit conversation identity checks. Same existing Linux/amd64 integration image `sha256:c7e52757fab9c49bb706685ef1cbf3cc9e261343eb3fbf518b335813d4b9fa0e`, same normal WorkSwarm mode and `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`, same keyless configuration with named-query opt-in enabled, and exactly three read-only source overlays. All four source ConfigMaps were compared byte-for-byte to their frozen control/candidate revisions. Candidate search sources also match `fee9c0fd`. This isolates the search changes on the existing image; it is **not** a rebuilt/runtime deployment test of every change from latest main.

Groups ran serially, with a 2.2 s delay before each model HTTP request to limit gateway traffic and 4 s between questions (the latter excluded from per-turn timers). WebSocket submission-to-final/terminal status was sampled every 250 ms. The delays are present in the reported per-turn times. A 120 s cancellation watchdog was introduced after the first candidate international group had run; that group's 145.48 s Taylor Swift answer was already completed and was retained, not silently capped. Thus this is exploratory paired live-web evidence with unequal cutoff exposure, not a controlled causal performance estimate. Do not interpret the totals as a statistically established regression or speedup. Earlier parallel/low-budget trials encountered 429 and budget errors and were discarded for the reported comparison. The final serial run had no model HTTP errors. A newly issued test-only key expired within two hours and was revoked after use.

**Validation and gate status:** 86 affected Python tests plus 29 subtests passed in test-6 after clearing deployment-specific search-market/read-budget overrides for default-value assertions; no tests or assertions were weakened. `git diff --check` passed. On `fee9c0fd`, architecture, ArkTS, node UT, Hypium UT, ST, gate-report and pr-ready passed. Server UT/ST remains explicitly skipped by repository policy and is not reported as passing; the affected local suite is narrower. The previous architecture failure was a missing policy path in the stale base snapshot; synchronizing main refreshed that snapshot and the architecture check passed without a gate change.

**Updated candidate and test-6 conversations — `27ca812d` (2026-11-12)**

The opt-in person-query relevance check now recognizes common English rewrites of news and review questions. Managed search guidance tells the model to read known official/editorial URLs after an irrelevant search rather than repeatedly rewriting keywords. No new search provider, key or persistence format was added.

All three final answers in this paired-topic rerun were substantive and cited pages actually fetched successfully in that same turn. Citation URL/read matching was checked for every inline source. This verifies source presence; individual factual claims were not exhaustively graded. Sources included Louis C.K.'s official news page, Variety, IndieWire and NY Post. Some supporting material was a Google News topic page, not an independently read original article.

| Same three-turn conversation | main `192ec6c6` | New candidate | Main → candidate search rounds | Main → candidate search/read rounds | Main → candidate page reads OK/attempts |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Louis C.K. news | 97.20 s | 81.08 s | 3 → 5 | 9 → 5 | 8/11 → 10/15 |
| Dave Chappelle news | 49.85 s | 60.32 s | 0 → 5 | 3 → 7 | 4/4 → 8/15 |
| Louis C.K. special reviews | 64.92 s | 45.08 s | 1 → 1 | 2 → 2 | 2/3 → 6/8 |

**Interpretation:** Three-turn total **211.97 → 186.48 s**, saving **25.49 s (12.0%)**. Unlike the earlier 57.83 s run, the candidate produced sourced answers for all three questions. The second question slowed by 10.47 s. Search calls increased **4 → 11** and page attempts **18 → 38**; repeat reads and source expansion remain. This is one live-web/model sample per revision, with the baseline from the preceding run, so it does **not** demonstrate stable improvement or close #1064. The earlier 72.7% time reduction was an early failure-to-answer result, not the result of this updated candidate.

**Reproduction and provenance:** Fresh isolated test-6 pod, same three Chinese prompts, same model `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`, same normal mode, explicit same-conversation follow-ups and WebSocket submit-to-final-task timing with 250 ms polling. Existing integration image `c7e52757…` plus read-only mounts of exactly the three changed production Python files at `27ca812d` (the only other changed file is the unit test). This is a source-overlay runtime test, **not a rebuilt image containing `27ca812d`**. The previously supplied `-test-6` image still contains `6cb7dadd`. No shared sandbox template or live user workspace was changed. Domestic provider credentials were unavailable; the run used the existing keyless routes. No 360 scraper was added.

**Checks:** 56 free-search unit tests passed on the Python 3.13 test pod, including English rewrite/miss fallback and out-of-scope comparison/qualifier cases. The suite was run with deployment-specific search-region overrides unset, as required by its default-market assertions. `git diff --check` passed. This commit's CI status is separate and must be checked; earlier green checks apply only to the earlier head.

**Full model conversations on test-6 (2026-11-12)** — Retest for #1064. **The candidate returned sooner, but all three replies reported that no reliable answer could be found. This does not demonstrate a speedup for a successful answer or resolve #1064.**

| Prompt, in order | Search rounds, main → PR | Search or page-read rounds, main → PR | Page fetches (returned OK / attempted), main → PR | Send → final answer, main → PR |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Louis C.K. recent news | 3 → 3 | 9 → 3 | 8/11 → 3/4 | 97.20 s → 24.07 s |
| Dave Chappelle recent news | 0 → 3 | 3 → 3 | 4/4 → 0/0 | 49.85 s → 20.58 s |
| Louis C.K. special reviews | 1 → 2 | 2 → 2 | 2/3 → 0/0 | 64.92 s → 13.18 s |

- **What changed for the user:** The sum of the three turn times went from **211.97 s to 57.83 s** (−154.14 s, −72.7%). Main produced three substantive answers naming sources, including Variety, Wikipedia and Rotten Tomatoes; their factual claims were not independently graded. The candidate delivered **zero** substantive answers. It issued eight DigitalMate search queries versus four search-tool calls on main. There were fewer rounds of combined search/reading (14 → 8) and fewer page reads (14/18 → 3/4 returned OK). A successful fetch means that text was returned, not that it was relevant. The three successful candidate reads on the first question were unrelated; the last two questions never fetched a page.
- **Why the tool-only result did not carry over:** The user asked in Chinese, but the model generated English queries such as `Dave Chappelle recent news 2026` and `Louis C.K. stand-up special reviews`. None of the eight candidate queries matched the opt-in Chinese intent patterns, despite `DIGITALMATE_FREE_SEARCH_NAMED_NEWS=1`. The candidate used only DigitalMate web tools and did not choose its direct-page tool. Main also got unrelated leads, then used native direct reads to recover; for the second question it went straight to source pages without a search-tool call. Next verification should cover English rewrites and bounded direct-source fallback, with useful final answers as the acceptance criterion.
- **Method:** One fresh isolated application pod per variant in test-6; a single three-turn conversation per pod, with explicit reply linkage checked on the follow-ups. Both used the same test gateway, model `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`, normal WorkSwarm mode and public internet. The prompts were reconstructed from the three topics in #1064: “帮我上网查一下 Louis C.K. 最近有什么新动态。” / “那 Dave Chappelle 最近有什么新动态？也帮我上网查一下。” / “再帮我查一下 Louis C.K. 的专场评价。” Timed from the application WebSocket submission until the task returned its final answer, polling every 250 ms; no human delay, phone UI or sandbox startup time. Counted actual model/tool traffic: simultaneous calls in one assistant response are one round; tool discovery is excluded. The combined metric includes direct URL reads. Pages count attempted document reads (including repeat URLs and the pages inside search-and-read), excluding ordinary search snippets and provider-internal requests. One paired run; live web and model variation preclude a stable latency or failure-rate estimate.
- **Build and scope:** `main 192ec6c618ab06dfbdd0f3124e4cceff80ce7207` + PR head `6cb7dadda7c2b45044c69ce84a42937e4abe6177`; local integration revision `ceecfdc462b7e54d04a98cde0aa4911487c53154`. Linux/amd64 test image: `swr.ap-southeast-1.myhuaweicloud.com/openjiuwen-online-test/digitalmate:main-192ec6c6-pr1077-6cb7dadd-test-6`, digest `sha256:c7e52757fab9c49bb706685ef1cbf3cc9e261343eb3fbf518b335813d4b9fa0e`; both pods reported that exact image ID. Baseline reversed only the seven changed runtime source files inside the isolated pod, leaving the same installed dependencies and runtime packaging; all seven reverse patches reproduced the main checkout byte for byte in a source check. The build recipe moved two disjoint virtual-environment COPY instructions to the end to reduce temporary disk use; sources, installation commands, paths and entrypoint were preserved. Cloud sandbox only; no HarmonyOS package or shared deployment was changed.

**Current candidate and test-6 results** — `6cb7dadd` on integration baseline `1bce4530`. A temporary pod in `adx-jiuwen-test-6` ran the candidate search code against public search engines. The search module SHA-256 matched the checkout. Used an isolated Python 3.13 environment with copied application sources and supporting packages. No deployed application traffic, model or phone session was replayed.

Three queries reconstructed from #1064 covered Dave Chappelle news, Louis C.K. news and Louis C.K. special reviews. Alternating switch off/on across five rounds, with cleared search cache and provider cooldowns, produced these results. A match means the title or snippet mentioned the requested Latin name, allowing punctuation differences.

| Free search | Switch off | Switch on |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Calls with at least one name match | 10/15 | 14/15 |
| Matching leads / all leads | 45/74 | 65/65 |
| Median tool latency | 197 ms | 233 ms |

Five of the 15 enabled calls attempted the additional news source. One call returned an explicit miss. The first independent baseline round reproduced unrelated Xiaohongshu, Zhihu and DeepSeek pages. Rankings varied across repetitions.

The real `digitalmate_search_and_read` function also ran twice per query per variant (three pages per call). Calls with a name match in the extracted page text increased from **4/6 to 6/6**. Pages successfully read increased from **8/18 to 10/18**, and median tool time rose from **1.036 s to 1.302 s**. These are tool timings. Changes to model turns, time to final answer and semantic relevance of the complete answers have not been measured.

pr:1098.body:
## What this fixes

Chinese follow-ups were being split into new conversations:

- #1008: `查询上海天气` → `将以上天气结果显示到一张图片中` → `改为横版 16:9` must stay in one conversation and one artifact.
- #1056: `帮我整理上海有哪些摇滚和金属乐队的现场演出` → `最近乐队演出定的怎么样了？` must continue the shows conversation.

Both are routing defects in `dm_sessions/routing.py`: `_REFERENTIAL` did not cover result references or progress questions, and `_tokens()` kept the whole Chinese run as a single token, so particles and request framing diluted the subject evidence.

## What changed

`harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/dm_sessions/routing.py`

- **Continuation intent is modelled separately from topic evidence.** Bounded result references (`以上/上述/刚才` + `结果/天气/清单/图片/表格/…`) and progress wording (`进展/怎么样了/定得怎么样/…`) are evidence, but they never bind a conversation on their own: they still require topic matches, a lexical floor, margin and distinctness. A bare `以上` regex is deliberately avoided — `以上海为例` is not treated as a reference.
- **Chinese tokenization no longer inflates the denominator.** The whole-sentence token is gone; particles (`的了着过吗呢吧…`) and function-word bigrams are skipped; proper-noun characters and internal bigrams are preserved.
- **Output-only refinements follow the server-recorded focus.** `改为横版 16:9` or `把以上结果整理成表格` carries no subject of its own; when the message has no remaining topic word and a focus exists, it continues the focused conversation. With no focus, or with a new subject, it does not.
- **No contract change.** Typed decisions, scope, visibility revision, pending/explicit-reply priority, judge validation (offered candidates only), thresholds and public interfaces are unchanged. English behavior is unchanged (verified: the new token subtraction removes nothing from Latin text).

`tests/session_proximity/test_routing.py` — 18 new tests (`ChineseContinuationTests`) covering: result reference with and without a judge, output-format refinement with/without focus, refinement with a new subject, generic processing without focus, progress question continuing a distinct topic while focus is elsewhere, progress question surviving judge timeout and judge rejection, ambiguous identical topics not guessed, progress topic not binding an unrelated weather conversation, `以上海天气为例`, a new city question, return to a discussion after an intervening topic, result reference with no candidate, and `classify_history`.

`harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/evals/session_proximity_cases.json` — 3 conversations and 5 holdout cases added (result-to-image, format refinement, shows progress with focus on another topic, processing without focus, false reference example).

## Verification (run locally unless marked NOT_RUN)

Environment: Windows 11, Python 3.11.15, `PYTHONUTF8=1`, `PYTHONPATH=harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src`.

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `python -m unittest tests.session_proximity.test_eval_corpus tests.session_proximity.test_routing` | **69/69 OK** |
| `python -m unittest tests.session_proximity.test_service` | **10/10 OK** (SessionManager-level, fixture reader) |
| Full `tests/session_proximity` set (9 modules) | **123 tests, 1 error, 1 skip** — error is `test_import_does_not_load_engine_or_backend_sdks`, reproduced identically on a pristine `origin/main` extraction (environment), skip is the Ollama-dependent evaluator runner |
| RED evidence before implementation | 7 of the 18 new tests failed on the unmodified router |
| Deterministic no-judge corpus replay (scratch harness, baseline `origin/main` vs branch) | With the new corpus: baseline **38/47**, branch **41/47**; the three new Chinese positive cases fail on baseline and pass on the branch. The 6 remaining misses are the same pre-existing judge-dependent cases on both sides |

Corpus quality note: an earlier draft of `shanghai_weather_zh` embedded the follow-up text it was meant to detect, which made `existing-weather-result-to-image-zh` pass even on the unfixed router. That leak was removed and the baseline failure above is the proof the case guards the behavior.

## NOT_RUN (and why)

- **Real continuity evaluator run (judge/embeddings)**: no local Ollama at `:11434`; `test_eval_runner` skips. `new-processing-without-focus-zh` and `new-example-phrase-zh` expect NEW/FALLBACK, which is the contract outcome for insufficient evidence, but those expectations are validated only on the deterministic path. Running the evaluator with a live judge is a merge-stage gate; results may need re-calibration.
- **Bridge integration / production admission tests**: the harness runtime dependency `aiosqlite` is not installed on this host; the plan's referenced `test_session_proximity_integration.py` is not present in this checkout. Delegated to CI `server-ut-st`.
- **Device/App reproduction of #1008/#1056**: no coordinated device or cloud environment. Router fixtures are not device evidence.
- **Deployment configuration** (`DIGITALMATE_SPLIT_CONVERSATIONS`, `CONTINUITY_JUDGE_MODEL`, `EMBEDDING_MODEL`, `SESSION_ROUTING_BUDGET_MS`) was not inspected or changed.
- **CI**: not yet run for this branch.

## Out of scope

The entity-recognition/search half of #1056 (`由理生社`, `假假条`) is explicitly separate per the plan; this PR changes nothing there and does not claim it is fixed.

## Risks and limitations

- The cue vocabularies are calibrated on the issue reports and the evaluator's holdout set, not on a labelled production corpus; wording outside these patterns will still fall back to ordinary ranking and the judge.
- The focus-following rule is intentionally narrow (output-processing cue, no remaining topic word, focus present). A subjectless `总结一下` with a focus continues that conversation; without a focus it stays NEW.
- Choosing NEW is not a claim that the user confirmed no relation; ambiguous references still go to the judge when configured.

## Review

An independent whole-branch review (fresh context) found no Critical issues. Its two Important findings were in the eval corpus and are fixed in `ead50ec1`; four Minor findings were deferred and are listed in the PR discussion without code impact.

**What type of PR is this?**

/kind feature

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

Let mobile users send text while the report they asked for is still streaming. After topic routing, a supported running task receives the follow-up with its expected execution ID. A completed task gets a new task in the same topic. The persisted submission identity makes retries resolve to their original target.

Public progress remains visible. A revised answer phase replaces the previous draft, and delayed events from an older phase cannot append to the new answer. The scope is the default legacy single-agent WorkSwarm path. Team mode, attachments, and Hosted A20 are outside this change. This PR changes the DigitalMate adapter and mobile client; it does not modify vendored WorkSwarm or Core.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Refs #964 (sending input while a task is running). Related to #802 (durable steering receipts).

**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：

- Tested base `acbb5e6b167f09ab28867baa5be9ce609227c1c6`, candidate `f12bf812e14272dc5cf67087f0fa253bcc66515f`. The upstream main observed at PR creation is `81f9ebc2ab2738ae8680b278192e7f06fec53d1f`.
- The WebSocket integration scenario exercises the mobile `room.message` RPC, DigitalMate routing, admission, persistence, and answer events. It starts a twenty-minute report, sends “改成十五分钟” and “听众都是研发” while the old draft is visible, switches to a weekend trip, then revisits the completed report to shorten the background. Checks include follow-up deduplication, independent trip context and rejection of old output. The semantic router judge and external WorkSwarm gateway/model are controlled test doubles in this scenario.
- Local checks reported 252 passes, 1 skip and 1 Windows path assertion failure also reproduced at the base. Mobile Node suite: 163 passes. Architecture manifest/scan: zero findings. An unsigned HarmonyOS HAP was built. A physical-phone recording and live-provider acceptance are pending. In the isolated test-6 Kubernetes instance, Linux/Python 3.13 ran the candidate's test_reply_stream.py, test_workswarm_adapter.py and test_workswarm_flow.py with pytest: 112 passed, 2 pytest configuration warnings (optional plugins disabled), 14.10 s. The report/travel scenario in this suite uses the controlled gateway and semantic judge.
- Also ran the scenario twice on a dedicated Linux pod in test-6 with the PR bridge, the repository-pinned WorkSwarm and agent-core source, and its official runtime build patch. Only the OpenAI-compatible provider was a local test double (including semantic-judge answers). No shared environment alias was switched. This drove the product mobile WebSocket RPC against genuine runtime executions, without a physical phone.
- The original twenty-minute draft was visible before input. Both follow-ups returned the same report task and conversation IDs. Provider inputs contained both the duration and audience constraints. The final report had a different output stream ID from the old draft; concatenating all frames of the final stream exactly equalled the fifteen-minute revised report. The trip request had a different task and conversation; its actual model input contained neither report constraint. After completion, the final edit created a new task in the original conversation. Its provider input contained duration, audience and shortened-background requirements. The confirmed transcripts were synthetic, and this did not measure generation quality or speed. Background memory-extraction calls emitted JSON warnings because the fixture only implements the scenario responses.

- Gate repair on `81f4fb24f1d8332f53c6a82d2cf5732243dfbd6e`, based on `81f9ebc2ab2738ae8680b278192e7f06fec53d1f`. The two affected Node suites reproduced two failures before the repair and passed all 21 tests after scoping source assertions to DigitalMateHomePage. The trusted base scanner checked 45 files with zero findings locally. GitHub passed [architecture-conformance](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/43060824486/job/130662599133), [node-ut](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/43060824486/job/130662599012).

## 问题与修改
云侧镜像构建会传入端侧资源和测试记录，运行时依赖解析存在版本回溯；两个 Python 环境中可再生的字节码也增加镜像体积。

- 按 Dockerfile 所需路径生成 Git archive，完整保留上游来源树、Git 文件模式和来源校验。
- 为 Python 3.13/Linux 的 bot 与 runtime 增加第三方依赖版本约束，版本来自前一轮成功镜像；本地 WorkSwarm/agent-core wheel 及其补丁校验保持不变。
- 安装时不预编译字节码，并在构建阶段清理有对应源码的 `.pyc`，保留无源模块、资源、业务依赖及两套环境。
- 增加通用 `--builder`、`--no-cache`、`--pull` 开关，以及打包回归用例和说明。

本 PR 不包含 Windows 换行适配、基础镜像源覆盖、本地 PC 工具安装、机器路径、测量脚本或原始日志；现有基础镜像来源保持不变。

## 测量结果及范围

| 指标 | 优化前 | 优化后 | 变化 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 无历史缓存构建总耗时 | 477.79 秒 | 381.19 秒 | 缩短20.2% |
| 扣除构建器启动后的耗时 | 454.99 秒 | 377.59 秒 | 缩短17.0% |
| Docker镜像逻辑大小 | 1,946,547,122 字节 | 1,520,860,170 字节 | 减少21.9% |
| Git archive 大小 | 308,858,880 字节 | 98,488,320 字节 | 减少68.1% |

以上为前序实现 `29fd59a9` 与基线 `204b5a4c` 的单次本地 Linux/amd64 实测：均使用全新 docker-container 构建器、`--no-cache --pull`，pip 缓存挂载初始为空，同源依赖和相同 --load 输出方式。优化后两套环境的全部已安装包版本与基线一致。构建器启动和网络存在差异，不能将全部耗时收益归因于代码，也不是云上环境的稳定收益承诺。

本 PR 从 main `81f9ebc2` 重新整理，排除了前序实现中的 PC 适配。Dockerfile、依赖约束、安装和瘦身实现与实测版本一致；PR 精确提交的完整镜像尚未重新构建，已在 Linux 容器中验证该提交的精简上下文与测试。

## 验证

- [x] 当前 PR 提交的 Git archive 在 Linux/Python 3.13 容器中通过 `harness/verify_sources.py`：WorkSwarm 2570 文件、agent-core 2894 文件。
- [x] Linux 容器中2个新增打包回归用例通过：排除端侧文件、保留已提交字节/可执行模式、保留源文件/资源/无源模块。
- [x] Linux 容器中10个原有来源校验用例通过。
- [x] 前序优化镜像的来源、wheel补丁、安装后补丁与 pip check 全部通过；与基线两环境的包版本逐项一致。
- [x] 前序优化镜像的业务模块和运行时主要模块导入通过，包括文档、向量/数据、飞书和浏览器相关依赖。
- [x] `git diff --check` 通过。

## 限制与运行代价

移除字节码会增加模块首次导入的解析开销。本次9个运行时模块的顺序导入采样从约4.42秒变为5.99秒（增加约1.57秒），不等同于完整服务启动或请求性能。依赖约束是指定 Python/Linux 环境的版本约束，不是带哈希的完整供应链锁；依赖或 Python 版本变更后需要重新验证。未做本次 PR 的云部署、手机或真实模型任务完整回归；合入前仍需仓库 CI 与评审。

pr:1141.body: ## What Re-based the #512 fix (originally PR #513 by @HugoXK) onto current `main` (`81f9ebc`), so it can be reviewed and merged against the latest tree. The aggregate-search renderer treated any `http(s)` address as a valid source, so `https://a.com@evil.test/y` rendered as a clickable source button and as the "打开原文" preview while the WebView lands on `evil.test`. The host that actually receives the click was never checked. ## Fix - `validSourceUrl()` now also rejects an address whose authority carries userinfo (`url.username || url.password`). It is the single gate behind three consumers: the card source anchor, `normalizedRelatedUrl()`, and the related-image filter — including the `coverUrl` fallback, which used to bypass it. - `renderPostLink()` now goes through a named `safeExternalUrl()` helper (http(s) only, no userinfo in the authority) instead of writing the row URL into `href` with no check at all (`javascript:` included). - An `@` inside the path (`https://a.com/x@evil.test`) is not userinfo and keeps working. ## Relation to existing PR - Fixes #512. - This is the same change as PR #513 (by @HugoXK), re-based onto current `main` (it was based on `8cc7213`, 944 commits behind). The #513 head lives on a fork that could not be updated in place, so this PR carries the rebased commits. If this is merged, #513 can be closed as superseded. ## Verification (local, Node 22.14) - `node --test tests/unit/aggregate-search-link-userinfo.test.mjs` → 5 pass / 0 fail - `node --test tests/unit/waterfall-renderer-interaction.test.mjs` → 1 pass / 0 fail (1 Playwright test skipped) - Mutation A: remove `if (url.username || url.password) return false;` → tests 1–4 fail, test 5 still passes. - Mutation B: `renderPostLink` `safeExternalUrl(postLinkUrl(block))` → `postLinkUrl(block)` → only test 5 fails. - Rebase 3/3 clean, no conflict markers; diff = 2 files, +156/−2. ## Residuals (out of scope, same as #513) - `renderEmbed()` `embedUrl`/`thumbnail` → ``/`

**What type of PR is this?**

/kind feature

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

Each authorized aging pass considers all open bug, UX and Experience feedback issues, including assigned ones. Initial triage still skips assigned issues. By default, count elapsed 24-hour periods from creation: P0 is due on day 2; P1 on day 5 (promote on day 3); P2 on day 10 (promote on days 5 and 8). When a human other than huben manually sets the priority, use that labeled event time and new priority as the new baseline. For example, a manual P1 is promoted to P0 after 3 days and is due after 5 days, even if the issue is already older. huben and authorized-runner changes do not trigger this reset; automatic promotions never restart the clock.

The skill instructs the runner to persist the base priority, effective aging start, deadline and baseline event identity outside the repository, reconcile human edits and interrupted writes, and verify individual label additions/removals without replacing other labels or assignees. Rebaselining is idempotent per labeled event; ambiguous actor or event attribution skips the issue. The included Python helper accepts separate creation and effective aging-start timestamps and only calculates dates/priorities. Scheduling, event attribution and GitHub writes remain with the authorized runner.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Follow-up to #996; no separate tracking issue.

**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：

Merged main `4b83ad09f2e7c69d282bf1037d46252b0679b537`; tested head `3749063a`. The only conflict was the mainline CRLF-to-LF normalization in `SKILL.md`; the requested rules were retained without additional semantic changes. `PYTHONUTF8=1 python -B -m unittest discover -v -s .agents/skills/digitalmate-issue-triage/scripts` passed (6 tests): original thresholds and deadlines, non-huben manual P0/P1/P2 rebaselines, P1 promotion after 3 days and deadline after 5, P2 promotions after 5/8 days with the day-10 deadline, automatic promotion retaining the rebased deadline, timezone offsets and expiry. JSON parsing, diff checks and the rebased CLI example also passed. No live issue mutations, scheduler, event-attribution or recovery integration test performed. No client or server runtime changes.

**Self-checklist**:

+ - [ ] **Design**: Maintainer review pending.
+ - [ ] **Test**: Calculation unit tests included; no live automation integration test.
+ - [x] **Verification**: Tested revisions, results and limitations are recorded above.
+ - [ ] **Interface**: No external product API changed.
+ - [ ] **Document**: No official website documentation changed.

pr:1152.body:
**What type of PR is this?**
/kind bug

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**
修复 #1144：回答里对同一来源的重复内联引用（如「The National」被连引 4 次）阅读体验差。

现有 `deduplicate_source_links` 已经会把同一目标地址的重复**链接**去掉，但对**同名标签**（相同描述文字）的重复引用会保留可见文字，所以同一来源仍被重复点名多次。

本次改动：对同一目标地址，若后续出现的是**同一个标签**，则整段重复提及一并去掉（该来源只在首次出现处标注一次）；若后续是**不同的描述性标签**，仍保留其可见文字（保持原有「保留有意义的不同标签」行为不变）。这实现了 #1144 诉求中的「同一来源在同一回答中去重、只在首次统一标注一次」；「同源要点合并」属生成侧内容合并，不在本 PR 范围。

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**
Fixes #1144

**How was this tested**
- `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest tests.test_engine_unread_citations -v`：19 项全部通过（含原有 18 项回归 + 新增 1 项）。
- 新增用例 `test_repeated_identical_named_citation_is_named_once`：`[The National](url)` 连引 3 次后仅首次保留链接，其余重复提及被移除。
- 既有语义保留：不同标签重复（`test_repeated_meaningful_title_keeps_visible_words`）、同域不同文章（`test_different_articles_on_same_hostname_keep_links`）等用例均通过。

**Scope / limitations**
- 仅调整展示层的重复来源提及去重，不改变来源绑定、URL 安全校验与未读来源剔除逻辑。
- 未在本机运行仓库完整 node-ut / hypium-ut / ArkTS 门禁（本环境无 Node 与 HarmonyOS 构建）；已单独运行受影响的 Python 单测。

pr:1173.body:
## Problem

DigitalMate cold startup performs Python imports and constructs the bot plus both
WorkSwarm workers before the instance can serve its first user request. The
agent-dx shared Golden Snapshot work needs an activation path that preserves
those initialized processes while binding each clone to its own workspace and
model credentials.

## Change

- Add `cold`, `seed`, and `clone` boot modes. `cold` preserves the existing image
  entrypoint and `subprocess.Popen` behavior.
- Park a seed before it opens the user workspace, business port, database, or
  model credentials. Preload the bot modules and two WorkSwarm interpreters.
- Deliver clone settings through a private Unix socket after restore, reject
  conflicting activation replays, and report clone readiness only after
  `/health/ready` succeeds.
- Inject the parked WorkSwarm launcher through the existing supervisor path;
  ordinary standalone and DigitalMate boots remain unchanged.
- Add focused activation, credential redaction, restart, supervisor, and normal
  launch tests. Update image/provenance documentation.

## Validation

- Golden activation tests in the current image source: 6 passed.
- Harness regression suite: 191 passed, 136 skipped because optional pinned
  runtime tests were not enabled in this command.
- `harness/update_upstream_ids.py --check` and `harness/verify_sources.py` passed
  in a native Linux worktree.
- Changed Python files passed `py_compile`.
- `git diff --check` passed.

The companion agent-dx branch is `feat/digitalmate-shared-golden`.

pr:1175.body:
## What

Fixes the #952 chat chain on the server side, in three parts:

1. **One notice per task.** The engine's publish step now skips a terminal `result` message when the same task already posted the identical line (whitespace/case-normalized). Production records for #952 showed one task emitting the same "interaction expired after restart" line four times (~35 s apart, server-side delivery retries), which the client rendered as stacked bubbles.
2. **Localized interaction notices.** The three hardcoded English waiting lines in `Bridge._execute_jiuwen` (restart-expired, review-pending, remaining-questions) now go through `interaction_notice()`, keyed by `task_language(task, environment)`. English text is unchanged so stored replays and older clients read the same words; a Chinese user now gets e.g. "交互已因服务重启过期。请先核对之前的效果，再开始新的任务。".
3. **Connection drops stop surfacing raw exceptions.** `ClientConnectionResetError: Cannot write to closing transport` used to fall through `_turn_failure_output`'s raw-detail fallback straight into the chat (#951). A narrow `transport_reset` classification now maps transport drops to `FailureCode.SERVICE` and a localized "connection dropped, retry" note. Other unknown errors keep the existing raw passthrough contract (e.g. "disk full" stays as is).

## Why this layer

Main already rebuilds the waiting state from both stores after a restart (`recovering_question` in `server.py`); the production incident hit the remaining path where the WorkSwarm runtime itself was absent, so the expired notice itself had to become well-behaved: localized to the conversation language, and idempotent across retried runs.

## Validation

Run from `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge` with the pinned requirements (`requirements.txt`) on Python 3.13:

- `pytest tests/test_terminal_notices.py -q` → **8 passed** (new file: notice catalog, language selection, transport-reset classification incl. negatives, `_turn_failure_output` en/zh wording, dedup semantics).
- `pytest tests/test_engine_service.py -q -m "not slow"` → my new `test_a_retried_terminal_notice_is_published_once` **passes** (three runs, one notice); 5 failures in this file are identical on unmodified `main` (verified by stash + rerun), including a pre-existing `Unknown agent` routing failure — environment/dependency drift, not this change.
- `pytest tests/test_model_failure.py tests/test_context_isolation.py tests/test_engine_brief.py tests/test_workswarm_adapter.py tests/test_engine_ask.py tests/test_account_access.py tests/test_bridge.py tests/test_engine_bridge_boundaries.py -q -m "not slow"` → all pass except 3 failures that reproduce unchanged on unmodified `main` (HTTP-500 budget cases, deeply-nested-JSON socket case).
- `git diff --check` clean.

## Out of scope

- Resuming the answered question when the runtime is still down: the notice remains "start a fresh task". Deeper resume belongs to the gateway retry path; the notice is now localized and posted once, so the blast radius is one well-behaved line.
- Retry billing (#1009).

Refs #952
Refs #951

pr:1183.body:
## Problem and change

Related to #950 and #951.

A WorkSwarm turn reporting `ClientConnectionResetError: Cannot write to closing transport` could expose that exception in a chat result. Recognize this exact diagnostic as an unconfirmed outcome, display safe guidance, and retain the existing check-result-only action so the user is not prompted to replay work with an unknown outcome. A direct aiohttp failure takes the same path. Already-classified rate limits now receive specific English and Chinese guidance instead of a generic settings message.

This is a bounded improvement to #950: other unknown failures retain the generic fallback. The historical production logs for the reported incident were unavailable, so these changes do not establish the incident's root cause or resolve every possible cause of the generic message. No automatic retry, timeout, retry budget, or public protocol is changed. PR #1181 handles the separate model-stream timeout case.

## Validation

- Source: `438a56d9d3089991f154db7d3467c50ccf77f6ea`, based on upstream main `69e2a2ea1972a334937f37108c425c99e4522dbd`; Python 3.12.13, Node 22.15.0.
- Bridge focused regression: 41 passed, 24 subtests passed. Includes the actual Bridge and authenticated phone WebSocket connected to a controlled WorkSwarm Gateway, a real aiohttp exception object, direct-reply and failure classification tests.
- Existing client status and adapter tests: 125 passed, including check-before-retry behavior.

One affected test reproduced the same failure in the unchanged #870 checkout; these assertions were not weakened. The complete extended suite was not rerun after rebase.

pr:1200.body:
## 背景

会话亲和的容量为 `SESSION_CAPACITY`（默认 10），队列开启时第 11 条消息会进入 `QUEUED`。
此前只要 `release_runtime` 返回 `STILL_IN_USE` / `UNKNOWN`，排队消息就会被维护循环无限重试：

- `STILL_IN_USE`：永远重试同一个 LRU victim；
- `UNKNOWN`：每次重试 fence 一个新的 victim，直到 10 个全部被 claim；
- 第 11 条消息一直是 `pending`，客户端看不到失败或告警。

本 PR 包含两部分：

1. #1185 已提交的修复（runtime busy 判定、release 结果 fence、generation 恢复、
   terminal 分页对账、WorkSwarm unload 报错可见等）；
2. 在此基础上补的两点：**排队超时对客户端可见** 和 **「全部候选都不可释放」的有界运维恢复**。

## 分支基线

本分支直接基于 `release_v0.1.10`（`3470885a`）重新提交，只携带与本问题相关的改动：

- 相对 `release_v0.1.10`：**17 commits / 16 files / +1432 / −35**；
- 不再像上一版那样把 `release_v0.1.10` 之后 `main` 的 300+ 文件一起带进来；
- 涉及的 16 个文件在 `release_v0.1.10` 与 #1185 的 base（`3c7d4569`）上内容一致，
  因此 replay 后的改动内容与 #1185 分支逐字相同（`git diff` 验证过）。

## 改动

### 1. 排队超时对客户端可见

- 新增 `SESSION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_S`（默认 `300`，范围 `0`–`604800`，`0` 关闭）。
- 维护循环通过新表 `dm_session_queue_blocks` 只跟踪**每个会话队首**的 `QUEUED` 轮次；
  同一会话中正确排在运行轮次之后的消息不计入超时。
- 超过期限仍无法启动时，`fail_queued(capacity_timeout=True)` 将该轮次置为失败：
  `FailureCode.SERVICE` + `retry_task`/`check_result`，任务结果写入中英文提示，
  轮次状态变为 `FAILED`，客户端不再看到永久 `pending`。
- 同时输出 warning 日志，包含 `occupied` / `claims` / `waiting_holds` / `blocked_turns`，
  便于定位是槽位、release claim 还是 waiting 持有导致。

### 2. 「全部候选都不可释放」的有界恢复

- 新增审计表 `dm_session_operator_releases`，记录操作者、原因、结果、明细与时间；
  释放和拒绝都会落库。
- 新增运维入口 `server_engine.session_proximity.operator`：
  - `--list [--json]` 列出占用槽位，并按 `idle` / `claim_pending` / `waiting_hold` / `busy` 分类；
  - `--release <conversation> --actor ... --reason ... --yes`：
    - 拒绝仍有 `ADMITTED`/`RUNNING`/`CANCELLING`/`UNCERTAIN` 轮次的会话；
    - 拒绝仍有运行中任务或非排队 `pending` 任务的会话；
    - `waiting_hold` 必须显式 `--allow-waiting`，确认后把等待任务置为失败、清空交互卡片，
      并把遗留的 `WAITING` 轮次置为 `FAILED`（避免该会话永久被保护、无法再准入）；
    - 删除该会话的 release claim/recovery 行，释放槽位并将会话置为 `OFFLOADED`。
- 卸载失败日志现在区分「轮次仍在执行」与 `owner task <id> is waiting`（waiting 持有）。
- 使用说明写入 `docs/developer_guide/session-proximity-cloud.md` 第 7 节，并注明：
  该入口把槽位标记为空闲但不向后端确认卸载，只用于确认后端会话已空闲的卡死场景。

## 验证

在基于 `release_v0.1.10` 的新工作树上，用 `.update-validation/pr481-merge-venv`
（`PYTHONUTF8=1`，`PYTHONPATH="src;../../../..;tests"`，目录
`harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge`）实际运行：

- `tests/test_session_proximity_repository.py`：24 passed
- `tests/test_session_proximity_acceptance.py`：59 passed, 14 subtests
- `tests/test_session_proximity_runtime_flow.py` + `tests/test_session_proximity_integration.py`：
  41 passed, 12 subtests
- `tests/test_context_final_v2.py` + `tests/test_workswarm_unload.py`：51 passed, 109 subtests
- `tests/test_session_proximity_upgrade.py`：8 passed

说明：`runtime_flow` 比 main 上少 2 个用例，原因是 `release_v0.1.10` 上该文件还是
context-reset 的旧版单一用例（main 后来拆成了两个），#1185 新增的用例都在。
`tests/test_session_proximity_a04_owned_claims.py`、`tests/test_session_proximity_integration.py`
等 main 侧唯一文件不在本基线内，未执行。

未执行：完整 CI、真机/云端验收、HarmonyOS 构建。没有真实设备或云环境证据。

## 与 #1185 的关系

- 本 PR 第 2 部分依赖 #1185 的语义（busy victim 跳过、`STILL_IN_USE` 不降级、
  release 结果 fence），因此把 #1185 的 16 个提交一并 replay 到 `release_v0.1.10` 之上，
  而不是仅提交增量 diff。
- #1185 的固定 base 是 `main`；若 #1185 后续为了解决冲突而改写提交，这里的 replay
  需要同步更新内容（当前内容等同于 #1185 head `7485053c` + 本 PR 的补充提交）。
- 合并顺序建议：先按 release owner 的意愿决定是「release 合入 main」还是「本 PR 直接进 release」；
  两种情况下本 PR 都不再携带无关的 main 变更。

pr:1253.body:
## Scope

Refs #754 and #737. This PR implements the Session Manager and Workspace Store side of A06 D1. The Host caller follows the producer in a separate PR. [A06 Feature and acceptance criteria](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/754) · [D1 specification](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/0ec89013822837f036e95b4cb6eb05ee0344a7f6/CLAIM-VALIDATION-v0.1.md) · [Architecture decision and owner edges](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1247)

- The selected Session Manager accepts the original acknowledged claim and independently supplied scope, turn, attempt and admission identity. The call is synchronous and returns `None` or raises. Both the Manager and Repository boundaries reject a nonempty result and close a miswired coroutine before it can validate or dispatch.
- The owning Store checks exact reference, current permit and transaction affinity. Preseal validation joins the actual managed Start frame. Committed Start acknowledgement requires an idle read cut and validates the original Start, dispatch and preparation together with the live claim. Foreign, copied and raw-frame cases fail closed.
- The Store index uses weak reference identity and owner-thread retirement. Callers that retain the original can still observe an existing terminal through C2. Dropping the last holder leaves durable UNKNOWN and its reconciliation obligations intact. The lifetime implementation and its ordinary regression tests are separate commits.

The producer does not activate Hosted ingress or transfer provider and Stop ownership. No schema or persisted encoding changes. #754 retains its remaining Host and acceptance work.

## Verification

Candidate `21f1b2a6ac12b23224794e00ca43c90057c27a43` (tree `5f667a2851f591e93b39fc288942f40a9749d72f`) is based on actual policy merge `9d32b6cb8182baa7683998f5e877445f43963534`. The three original patches are byte-identical after rebind. The fourth commit fixes a review finding in the synchronous Repository-to-RunClaims delegation.
