   - P1: `git grep MemoryProvenance\|MemoryExport` over `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets` on `9eea155` is empty; the modules exist only in open PRs #417 and #420, each one file with zero callers.
   - P2: the reminder chain is debug-gated at `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:5541`, `entryability/EntryAbility.ets:280`, `update/AppUpdateService.ets:13`; no authorization surface in `pages/Settings/Index.ets`.
   - P3: `model/MemoryCandidateSelectionSurface.ets:122` has no production caller; the reachable delete path (`pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:4253` → `:4068` → `:4080` → `memory/LongTermMemoryOverviewCoordinator.ets:396` → `:414` → `:842`) has no confirmation step.
2. **Run scoreboard** from the GitHub API at 2026-10-31T16:00Z: 17 issues, 18 PRs, 0 merged, 1 closed unmerged; 12 rounds delivered, 3 failed with reasons.
3. **Proposed goal additions** as a diff (four proposals), every line marked not in effect.
4. **Impact and risk** per proposal, including a reviewer-disagrees case and a rollback note.
5. **Non-goals**: goal section 4 is explicitly unchanged; the temptations the proposal forbids are listed.
6. **What to stop doing**, including this run's own low-value output.

## Test evidence

Red `5ef7e6d` — test only, on `main` `9eea155`:

```
ℹ tests 9
ℹ pass 0
ℹ fail 9
AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: docs/product/goal-review-2026-10-31.md must exist
AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: the review must contain the section "## 1. What the evidence says about the three pillars today"; the proposal is incomplete without it
```

Mutation check — delete one cited evidence line from the document (`sed -i '/forgetIfSnapshotCurrent/d' docs/product/goal-review-2026-10-31.md`), no commit:

```
ℹ tests 9
ℹ pass 8
ℹ fail 1
✖ P3 evidence is cited, not asserted

## Content anchoring

No assertion uses a hardcoded line number. Each section is located by its heading content and each pillar by the anchors it must cite, e.g.:

```js
const p2 = block.slice(block.indexOf('### P2'), block.indexOf('### P3'));
assert.ok(

The file:line strings here are the evidence being quoted, so editing the document is what makes the test red — not reformatting an unrelated source file.

## 问题

引用条（回复气泡上方的 `Beebou：…`）和输入框里的「引用回答」卡片显示的是 `markdownPreviewText()` 的输出。它在 `main` `0fb0456` 上有三个可见缺陷：

1. **截断没有省略号**：预览在 140 个 UTF-16 码元处硬切，被切断的半句话看起来像完整回答。
2. **emoji 处出现方块**：切口落在代理对中间时留下半个字符（`'答'×139 + '😀…'` → 尾部 `\ud83d`），渲染为 �。
3. **表格泄漏源码**：表格回答的预览是 `| 城市 | 温度 | | 北京 | 12 |`，用户看到 `|` 与 `---` 分隔行。

Fixes #404

## 改动

`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudReplyPreview.ets`（+34/−6）：

- `clipCharacters()`：按 UTF-16 码点边界截断，绝不切开代理对（截断点落在高位代理上时回退一个码元）。
- `clipPreview()`：只有真的超长才补 `…`，未超长的预览保持原样（与 `permissionDetail` 等处的 `…` 约定一致）。
- 表格块（`kind === 'code' && table`）走既有的 `parseMarkdownTable()`，按单元格扁平化为 `城市 温度 北京 12`，不再输出 `|`。
- 解析上限 4096 也用同一套安全截断，避免解析入口产生孤立代理。

不动气泡正文渲染、不动流式管线、不改 Markdown 解析器（#402 处理正文强调，二者不重叠）。

## 测试

新增 `tests/unit/cloud-reply-preview.test.mjs`，**先失败后通过**（在 `0fb0456` 上 4 条中 3 条失败：缺省略号、`\ud83d` 孤立代理、`|` 泄漏；修复后 4/4 通过）：

```
node --test tests/unit/cloud-reply-preview.test.mjs
```

回归范围：

```
node --test tests/unit/cloud-*.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-message-actions.test.mjs
ℹ tests 532 · pass 529 · fail 3
```

3 条失败全部是本地缺依赖导致的既有基线，与本次改动无关：`Cannot find module 'typescript'`（`cloud-account-service`、`cloud-embedding`）、`Cannot find module 'playwright'`（`cloud-math-renderer`）；CI 的 `ut.yml` 会安装这些依赖。既有的「公式在预览里必须可读」契约测试（`digitalmate-message-actions.test.mjs`）保持通过。

## 未验证

- 真机字体/换行下的实际显示：仓库无 ArkTS 工具链与真机，只能靠 CI 的 ArkTS Code Check 与纯函数测试。
- 未改动任何服务端或协议行为。

## 风险与回滚

预览文本形状变化（长文多一个 `…`、表格由 `|` 变空格），UI 侧本就用 `maxLines` + `TextOverflow.Ellipsis`，不冲突。改动是单文件纯函数，回滚只需 revert 这一个 commit。

items.body:
Fixes #414

## 这个 PR 做了什么

纯文档 + 一个契约测试，没有运行时代码、依赖、权限或设置改动（唯一的仓库元数据变化是新增 4 个标签名
`goal:P1`、`priority:P0`、`type:docs`、`source:goal`，供 issue #414 使用）。

产品迭代目标 v1 的 §10 要求四份产物先于功能落地，但仓库 `docs/` 没有产品目录，每轮都在重新论证定位。
本 PR 落地四份文档，并用一条契约测试把它们钉住：

| 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/product/positioning.md` | 一句话定位、目标用户、三条 JTBD、P1/P2/P3（每条含当前实现证据 / 差距 / 验收）、七条明确不做、三处定位冲突 |
| `docs/product/competitive-landscape.md` | 5 直接 + 3 间接竞品 × 10 维度；每行带 事实/推断/假设、来源、ISO 日期；附本轮复验记录与未核实清单 |
| `docs/product/roadmap-6m.md` | 6 个月只做三件事，分别对应 P1/P2/P3；各有 M1–M3 里程碑、可度量验收、不做清单、风险 |
| `docs/product/backlog.md` | 20 项按支柱排序：类型、优先级、四类标签、证据、用户故事、现状与差距、验收、非目标检查、为什么是我们、不做会怎样、风险、预估、链接 |
| `tests/unit/product-docs.test.mjs` | 7 条契约测试：文档存在与索引、定位句唯一、三支柱字段、竞品来源/日期/置信度、路线图恰三件事、backlog 恰 20 项并按优先级排序、相对链接可解析 |
| `docs/README.md` | 目录表新增 `product/` 一行 |

## 先红后绿（可复核）

文档改动同样能测试先行，所以这一轮拆成两个提交：

1. `8116d36` **只提交测试**。在干净的 `8116d36` worktree 上运行
   `node --test tests/unit/product-docs.test.mjs` → **7 tests / 7 fail**（文档尚不存在）。
2. `e9fb8a6` **加入四份文档与索引**。同一命令 → **7 tests / 7 pass**。

上一轮的问题之一是"文档改动没法先写失败测试"；这里的结论相反：只要是可检查的约束（来源、日期、置信度、
排序、数量），就能先写失败测试。约定不是叙事，能跑才算。

## 评审后的修正（第三提交）

`64ab1f8` 把三个「没有基线却写成验收」的数字标成目标：B01 的 90% 与 B06 的 2 秒标注为「目标，M1 校准」，
B06 改为相对 #223 基线的「P50 下降 ≥ 50%」，B10 的「静默时段 0 次通知」明确为硬性行为而非比例目标。
理由写进 backlog 的新增规则段：没有基线就写死百分比，会让下一轮误以为已经验收过。加完仍 7/7 通过。

## 三个竞品来源本轮重新读过

不编造结论；读不到就降级并写清楚。本轮实测（2026-10-31）：

| 来源 | 结果 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `https://www.notion.com/help/notion-ai-faqs` | HTTP 200，读到正文 | 由推断升为事实（套餐、credits、Agent 建改页面、执行前审阅计划、权限继承） |
| `https://docs.letta.com/self-hosting/channels` | HTTP 200，读到正文 | 由推断升为事实（渠道清单、DM/群组策略、管理员分层、`/reflection`） |
| GitHub API `letta-ai/letta`、`mem0ai/mem0` | 200；均 Apache-2.0；LETTA README 已指向 `letta-code` | 支撑开源与自托管行，并注明仓库迁移 |
| `https://help.openai.com/en/articles/8590148-memory-faq` | HTTP 403（再次复验） | 保持推断/假设，记录在「证据缺口」表 |

顺带修正了上一版的两处不严谨：Mem0 的"2026 年 4 月新算法"没有来源，已删掉月份，只保留 README 描述；
Letta 的 MemFS / schedules 只从文档导航看到，已从"事实"降为"推断"并写明未读正文。

## 与 issue #414 的映射（明确写清）

本轮只开一个 issue：**#414 是这份基线的落地/追踪单**，不是 backlog 里的功能条目。backlog 的 20 项中
**B01（记忆溯源："为什么记得"可回答）是下一个 P0 候选**，它的验收标准已经写进 `backlog.md`，但实现不在
本 PR 内——需要下一轮按模板单独开 feature issue。`backlog.md` 里已有上游单的 6 项（B03→#250、B06→#223、
B09→#377、B13→#65、B16→#367/#358/#388、B11→#291）直接复用，不重复提。

## 复用了上一轮的骨架（如实说明）

上一轮的同类 PR #393（issue #392）已关闭未合并，但分支 `docs/product-baseline` 仍在，CI 双绿。本 PR 在
其文档骨架基础上做了三件事：补 `backlog.md` 与对应契约测试、按上面所述修正竞品证据等级、把四份文档互相
链接并在 `docs/README.md` 建索引。没有直接 cherry-pick 那个合并提交，而是从当前 `main` `04621bb` 重新
组织成"测试先、文档后"两个提交。

## 跑过与没跑

- `node --test tests/unit/product-docs.test.mjs` → 7/7 pass（`8116d36` 上 7/7 fail）
- `node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs` → 1641 tests / 1602 pass / **32 fail**；32 条集中在 account / gateway /
  UI / memory-store 等与本 PR 无关的套件，基线对照见下一条
- 基线对照：在 `04621bb` 的干净 worktree 上跑同一命令 → 1634 tests / 1595 pass / **32 fail**。
  差值与分支完全一致：**+7 tests、+7 pass、失败数不变（32）**，失败集合逐条比对相同；唯一差异是
  `about-you-renderer-interaction.test.mjs` 内部哪条先报（该套件依赖 Chromium 交互，基线同样失败）。
  结论：本 PR 未引入回归，新增的 7 条契约测试全部通过
- 未跑：`hvigorw test`、ArkTS 构建、真机验证。本 PR 不碰 ArkTS 源码，这些检查由 CI 的 `node-ut` 与
  `ArkTS Code Check` 覆盖
- 未做：链接抓取式外链检查（离线环境只逐条 web_fetch 了表中列出的官方来源）；中文错别字工具未接入

## 回滚

`git revert e9fb8a6 8116d36` 即可完全回到 `04621bb` 的文档状态；两个提交都是新增文件 + 一行索引，
无迁移、无配置依赖。

## 非目标

不改产品定位本身（定位变更需人类批准，见 `positioning.md`「定位冲突」）；不创建 backlog 中尚无上游单的
14 条 issue；不把竞品结论当作任何功能立项理由；不引入新依赖或 CI 步骤。

## What

The composer attachment strip announced its two controls in Chinese only, so TalkBack on an `en` device read 「report.pdf，上传失败」 and 「移除附件 report.pdf」. The two announcements now follow the existing device-language value:

- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/files/FilePresentation.ets` — new pure helpers `composerFileStatusAnnouncement(name, status, language)` and `composerFileActionAnnouncement(name, status, language)` (plus `attachmentLanguageIsEnglish`). zh strings are the exact strings that were inline before; `en*` gets `, upload failed` / `, uploading` / `, uploaded` and `Cancel upload ` / `Remove attachment `.
- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/files/ComposerFileStrip.ets` — both `.accessibilityText(...)` calls now use the helpers with `this.language = digitalmateClientContext().language` (`model/DigitalMateDeviceContext.ets:14`, the value #425/#429 already use). No new module, dependency, permission, server call or locale framework.

Fixes #437

## Reachability (release path)

1. `resources/base/profile/main_pages.json:3` → `pages/A2uiHome/Index`.
2. `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:1029` `@State private cloudBackend: string = 'workswarm'` (shipped default) → `:8896` `HomePage({ … cloudChat: true (':8928') … })`.
3. `pages/A2uiHome/components/HomePage.ets:1192` `this.CloudComposerFiles(...)` inside `if (this.cloudChat)` (`:1191`).
4. `HomePage.ets:980` `CloudComposerFiles` → `:981` `ComposerFileStrip({ files: this.cloudFiles, … })`.

No constant `false`, no debug flag, no dead branch: `cloudBackend` defaults to `'workswarm'`, `cloudChat` is set to `true` by the page, and none of the touched files references `isDebugBuild`.

## Test: red → green → mutation

- **Red** `cbc93c7` (test only, +89) on `main` `04621bb`: `ℹ tests 5 / pass 0 / fail 5`, verbatim:
  `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: FilePresentation.ets must expose composerFileStatusAnnouncement(name, status, language)` (and the same for `composerFileActionAnnouncement`).
- **Green** `716523a`: `ℹ tests 5 / pass 5 / fail 0`. Test file byte-identical: `git diff --stat cbc93c7 716523a -- tests/unit/composer-attachment-announcements.test.mjs` is **empty**.
- **Mutation** (mandatory): `sed -i "s/', upload failed'/'，上传失败'/" digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/files/FilePresentation.ets` →
  `ℹ tests 5 / pass 4 / fail 1` with
  ```
  AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: Expected values to be strictly equal:
  + actual - expected
  + 'report.pdf，上传失败'
  - 'report.pdf, upload failed'
  ```
  restored → `ℹ tests 5 / pass 5 / fail 0`.

## Content anchoring (no line numbers)

Each assertion finds its element by the function name or the call text, never by a line number — adding or removing an unrelated line cannot turn it red. Example from the wiring test:

```js
assert.ok(strip.includes(call),
  'ComposerFileStrip.ets must announce through ' + call + '…), not an inline Chinese-only string');
const start = strip.indexOf(call);
assert.match(strip.slice(start, start + 200), /this\.language|digitalmateClientContext\(\)\.language|language\)/,
  'the ' + call + '…) call must pass the device language');
```

One assertion block per control: the status announcement (zh and en) and the cancel/remove announcement (zh and en), plus one for the strip wiring.

## Chinese output

Byte-identical: the combined CJK string-literal multiset of `FilePresentation.ets` + `ComposerFileStrip.ets` is **12 literals on `main` and 12 on the branch, and the two multisets are identical** — the same strings moved from the component into the pure module. No Chinese literal was edited or retyped.

## Checks run

- `node --test tests/unit/composer-attachment-announcements.test.mjs` — red, green and mutation as above.
- Full suite on the branch vs `main` `04621bb`: **1809 tests / 1770 pass / 32 fail / 7 skipped** vs **1804 / 1765 / 32 / 7**, with the same 28 failing files on both sides (baseline measured on the same `04621bb` tree; failing-file set compared).
- Not run: `hvigorw test`, device/emulator — no ArkTS toolchain or screen reader in this environment.

## Notes

- Branch is based on `04621bb`; upstream `main` has since advanced (`ls-remote` showed `9eea155`) and the local fetch of that commit did not complete from this sandbox, so a rebase may be needed before merge.
- Supersedes nothing; the file pair is touched by no open PR (`FilePresentation.ets`, `ComposerFileStrip.ets`). `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets` (owned by #434) is not touched.

items.author: HugoXK
items.body:
## What

Three interactive controls in the CloudHome chat header are drawn as a bare glyph or a bare icon with no accessible name, so a screen reader announces the character or "image" instead of the action:

| Control | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| back chevron | `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:1731` `Text('‹')` → announced as "‹" | `.accessibilityText('返回')` |
| session list | `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:1752` `Image($r('app.media.ic_session_fold'))` → announced as "image" / "图片" | `.accessibilityText('会话列表')` |
| queue-edit close | `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:2234` `Text('×')` → announced as "×" (multiplication sign) | `.accessibilityText('退出编辑')` |

One coherent defect class — *(i) icon-only / glyph-only control without accessible text* — one surface (the cloud chat page), one file changed. No layout, colour, size or interaction change; the visible glyphs are byte-identical.

`Fixes #433`

## Reachability (release path, hop by hop)

1. `digitalmate/entry/src/main/resources/base/profile/main_pages.json:6` registers `pages/CloudHome/Index`.
2. `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:363` `CLOUD_CHAT_ROUTE_URL: string = 'pages/CloudHome/Index'` routes to it.
3. `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:2572` `if (!this.contentOnly) { this.Header() }` — the header renders on every normal chat open.
4. `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:1728` `Header()` builds `:1731` (back chevron), `:1752` (session list, under `if (this.connectionState() === 'open')` at `:1751`), and `QueueBar` → `:2234` (queue-edit close, under `if (this.editingQueueId && !this.contentOnly)` at `:2231`).

No hop is behind a constant `false`, a debug flag or a dead branch: `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets` does not reference `isDebugBuild` at all, and the only conditions on the path are live UI state (`contentOnly`, `connectionState()`, `editingQueueId`).

## Test — red, green, mutation

- **Red** `c86fc69` (test only, +98) on `main` `04621bb`: `ℹ tests 2 / pass 0 / fail 2`, exit 1, verbatim:
  `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:1731 (the chat-header back chevron) must carry a non-empty accessible name, so a screen reader announces the action instead of the bare glyph or "image"`
- **Green** `7801fb2` (1 file, +3/−1): `ℹ tests 2 / pass 2 / fail 0`.
- Test file byte-identical between red and green: `git diff --stat c86fc69 7801fb2 -- tests/unit/cloud-chat-accessible-names.test.mjs` is **empty**.
- **Mutation check** (mandatory): `sed -i "s/        .accessibilityText('返回')//" …/CloudHome/Index.ets` → `ℹ tests 2 / pass 0 / fail 2`, same assertion as the red run; restored → `ℹ tests 2 / pass 2 / fail 0`.

The test reads the shipped page, finds each control's anchor line, walks its modifier chain up to the balanced `.onClick(` handler and requires a non-empty Chinese `.accessibilityText(...)` label, plus that the three names are distinct. A comment or an unrelated edit in the file cannot satisfy it; a control without its label cannot pass it.

## Chinese output

Byte-identical for every pre-existing string: all 121 distinct CJK string literals in `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets` (158 occurrences) are unchanged on the branch — zero removed or altered. The change only **adds** three labels: `返回` (6 bytes), `会话列表` (12 bytes), `退出编辑` (12 bytes). No English copy was added.

## Checks run

- `node --test tests/unit/cloud-chat-accessible-names.test.mjs` — red then green as above.
- Full suite on the branch vs `main` `04621bb`: **1806 tests / 1767 pass / 32 fail / 7 skipped** vs **1804 / 1765 / 32 / 7** — the 28 failing files are the same set on both sides (set difference empty).
- Not run: `hvigorw test` and on-device/emulator runs — this sandbox has no HarmonyOS/ArkTS toolchain, so the accessibility names were verified against the source the compiler consumes, not on a device.

## Non-goals held

items.body:
## 问题

`chat.final` 的落地路径先解析「这条 final 覆盖哪个分段」，`parseChatFinalSegmentId()` 把四个候选字段塞进 `string[]` 后逐个 `.trim()`。帧是服务端下发的 JSON，`Payload.segment_id?: string` 只是编译期声明；消息 id 在服务端常是整数，`||` 只吞掉 `0`/`''`，非零数字会原样进入数组并让 `.trim()` 抛 `TypeError`。

在 `0fb0456` 上实测：

```
parseChatFinalSegmentId({ segment_id: 42 })        → TypeError: value.trim is not a function
session.apply({event:'chat.final',
  payload:{request_id:'turn', content:'最终回答', stream_message_id: 98765}})
                                                   → TypeError: value.trim is not a function
```

异常发生在帧分发里，被 `CloudConnection` 的 `try/catch` 转成 `onProtocolError('消息处理失败，详见通信日志')`：这条 final 的正文整条丢失，同一轮的 `finishTurn()` 也没执行，用户看到的是通用错误提示而不是回复。

Fixes #410

## 改动

`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudFinal.ets`（+11/−6）：

- 候选值按 `string | undefined` 收集，逐个 `typeof value !== 'string'` 跳过，字符串路径仍 `trim()` 后返回；
- 四个字段都不可用时返回 `''`（表示写到客户端当前分段），不再抛异常；
- 与同文件 `parseChatFinalMode()` 已有的 `typeof raw !== 'string'` 校验保持一致。

不改协议、不改分段选择策略、不改任何网络行为；只是不再让一个可选字段的类型把整条 final 打掉。

## 测试

新增 `tests/unit/cloud-final-segment-id.test.mjs`，**先失败后通过**（`0fb0456` 上 4 条中 3 条失败）：

| 用例 | 断言 |
| --- | --- |
| 数字型 `segment_id` / `stream_message_id` | 返回 `''`，不抛异常 |
| 前一个候选不可用、后一个可用 | 取到 `'m-9'`；`'seg-1'` 原样返回；`'  seg-2  '` 被 trim |
| `parseChatFinalMode` 非字符串 | 仍返回 `''`（回归保护） |
| 带数字 `stream_message_id` 的 `chat.final` | 回复落进气泡、`completed === true`、会话回到 `idle` |

```
node --test tests/unit/cloud-final-segment-id.test.mjs   # 4/4
node --test tests/unit/cloud-*.test.mjs                  # 517 tests · 514 pass · 3 fail
```

3 条失败是本地缺依赖的既有基线（`Cannot find module 'typescript'` ×2、`'playwright'` ×1，CI 的 `ut.yml` 会安装），与本次改动无关。`CloudFinal.ets` 此前在 `tests/unit` 里没有任何覆盖，这个文件顺带补上。

## 未验证

- 服务端线上是否真的会下发数字型分段 id：仓库内没有服务端代码，无法证实。本 PR 修的是「客户端把可选字段做成硬失败点」这一可复现事实，而不是声称线上已发生。
- 真机渲染与 ArkTS 编译：沙箱无真机与 ArkTS 工具链，由 CI 的 ArkTS Code Check 覆盖。

## 风险与回滚

行为面很小：只有非字符串候选值从「抛异常」变成「跳过」。若服务端确实永远只发字符串，这个改动等价于空操作。回滚只需 revert 这一个 commit。

## 问题

最新 main 上，Orbit 设备 ST 的测试 HAP **编译不出来**。

```
.\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases core
→ COMPILE RESULT:FAIL {ERROR:22 WARN:100}
  Error: Property 'trajectory' does not exist on type 'ProductionComposer'
  Error: Property 'profilingEnabled' does not exist on type 'ProductionComposer'
  Error: Cannot find name 'OrbitResponse' / 'OrbitRequest'
  Error: Cannot find module '@loop/cloud-adapter'
```

## 根因

`tests/dfx/stability/orbit-device/ComposerHost.ets` 是一个**手写**的 host 类，承载 `prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs` 从生产 `OrbitHome/Index.ets` **逐字提取**的 `send` / `drainSend` 方法体。

生产代码这阵子给这两个方法加了 trajectory 打点、profiling 开关和 draft 行状态，但 host 没跟着声明。提取是逐字的，所以方法体里引用了 host 上不存在的成员——编译必失败。

这是 main 上的既有缺陷，**与任何新用例无关**。已用未修改的 main（`5d574e36`）直接复现。

## 改动

| 文件 | 改动 |
|---|---|
| `ComposerHost.ets` | 引入并实例化生产 `OrbitTrajectory` 作为 `trajectory`；补 `profilingEnabled`（关闭）、`traceSubmissionId`、`draftNeedsOwnRow`；补 `OrbitRequest`/`OrbitResponse` 导入 |
| `prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs` | 拷贝 `OrbitTrajectory.ets` 并在 `orbit/index.ets` 导出；改写 `OrbitDeviceContext.ets` 的 `'@loop/cloud-adapter'` 别名 |
| `tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs` | 两个新守卫 |

### 为什么用真实 `OrbitTrajectory` 而不是空实现

它是纯逻辑类，只依赖 `hilog` 和 `OrbitProtocol` 的计时类型，没有 UI 依赖。用真实实现意味着提取出来的 `send`/`drainSend` 仍然调用**产品本来的**记录器，而不是我在测试里伪造一个。这符合这套 ST 的原则：产品方法逐字执行，测试只补 UI 生命周期。

`profilingEnabled` 设为 `false`，与页面默认值一致，让产品 `send` 走非诊断分支。`traceSubmissionId` / `draftNeedsOwnRow` 也取页面初始值。

### 两个守卫

这次问题的本质是「手写 host 与逐字提取的方法体失配」，而且**只有到真机跑才会发现**。所以补了两个单元守卫：

1. **成员完备性**：提取出的方法体里每个 `this.<member>`，必须能在 host 上解析（`extractSupport` 注入的方法算数）。缺失即报 `ProductionComposer is missing: x, y`。
2. **别名改写**：直接对生成产物断言，任何生成的 `.ets` 都不得残留 `'@loop/'`。这比匹配 prepare 的源码写法可靠。

守卫已验证有效：删掉 `trajectory` 那一行，立刻报
```
AssertionError: ProductionComposer is missing: trajectory
```

## 验证

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `node tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs`（干净 main + 本 commit） | **25/25 通过** |
| 守卫有效性 | 移除 `trajectory` → 报 `missing: trajectory`；恢复 → 全绿 |
| `-CompileOnly -Cases core`（本分支） | **`CompileOnly succeeded`**，`Verified test HAP: SDK runner and all six business case implementations are present.` |
| 生成物别名 | 生成后 `OrbitDeviceContext.ets` 内已无 `@loop` |
| `git diff --check` | 通过 |

编译是**实际执行**的，不是推断：本机 hvigor 已跑通，输出见上。

**未做：** 没有在真机跑业务用例（需要 Gateway Bearer，当前环境没有）。本 PR 只修编译，不改任何用例语义。

## 复现

```powershell
# 修复前
git checkout 5d574e36
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases core
# → COMPILE RESULT:FAIL {ERROR:22}

# 修复后
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases core
# → CompileOnly succeeded
```

## 与其他 PR 的关系

与 #296（新增 #233/#278、#241 的 ST 回归用例）**相互独立**，可分别合并。#296 也包含同样的编译修复（否则它自己的新用例也编不过）；本 PR 先合入后，#296 可以 rebase 掉这部分。

items.body:
## 关联 Issue

- #233（`==` 标记泄漏，已由 #257 修）与 #278（等号比较被吞，已由 #269 修）
- #241（停止按钮无响应，已由 #268 修）

三个 issue 的修复都已在 main 上。本 PR **不改产品代码**，只把这三处行为补成设备级 ST 回归，避免以后同一个正则或同一处任务定位再退化。

## 做了什么

新增两条 Orbit 真实业务 ST 用例，并保持既有用例行为不变。

### `markup` — 等号比较与高亮标记解析（#233 / #278）

- 把**生产**的 `CloudMarkdown.ets` / `CloudMath.ets` 一起编译进独立 ST HAP，断言直接调用 `parseInline` / `parseMarkdownTable`，而不是复制一份正则到测试里（复制出来的正则会和生产实现漂移，正是这两个 issue 的成因）。
- 先要求模型原样回显一行混合文本，再对**该任务实际返回的回复**做断言：
  1. 每个带空格的比较片段（`a == b`、`if x == 0`）必须原样保留在可见文本里；
  2. 比较不得被渲染成 highlight（这正是 #278 里操作数被删掉的原因）；
  3. 紧贴文字的 `==标记==` 仍然高亮，且原始 `==标记==` 不残留在气泡文本里（#233 的症状）；
  4. 表格单元格路径同样成立：`` `a == b == c` `` 保持字面量，裸 `==25%==` 仍高亮。
- 不写死期望字符串：断言遍历回复中**实际出现**的比较片段，模型多说或少说不会被误判成通过。

### `stop` — 停止正在运行的任务（#241）

- 用 `extractRuntimeMethods` 从 `OrbitTaskRuntime.ets` **逐字提取** `topLevelTaskId` / `stopTarget` / `stopTask`，包进 `OrbitStopTarget`，仅补 `current` 与 `client`。停哪个任务、发什么请求，全部是生产代码。
- 真实流程：提交一条长任务 → 要求它此刻仍是 `pending`/`running`/`waiting` → 经生产 `stopTarget` 算出目标 → 发真实 `task.cancel` → 在同一预算内观察到**同一个 task** 变成 `cancelled`。
- 明确失败而非静默通过：`NOT_ACTIVE`、`READ_ONLY_ROOM`、`STOP_TARGET_MISMATCH`、`NO_CANCEL_SENT`、`STOP_IGNORED`、`CANCEL_UNCONFIRMED`。任务先跑到 `completed` 会被判 `STOP_IGNORED`，不会因为"反正结束了"算过。

### 配套改动

- `orb-rst-scenes.mjs`：注册两个新 key。两条新用例**不进** `all` / `smoke` / `core`，需显式 `-Cases markup,stop`；隔离规则改成按用例名判断，不再靠数组位置。
- `prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs`：新增 `extractRuntimeMethods`（源码结构变化即抛错，不静默降级），并把解析器与 `OrbitStopTarget` 纳入生成清单与 `source-manifest.json`。
- `LiveBusiness.test.ets`：`submit()` / `waitTask()` 增加 `untilActive` 分支，让用例能观察运行中的任务，同时仍正确收尾自己的 task trace。
- `run-orbit-device-st.ps1`：HAP 符号门禁补上两个新用例名（原先只校验六条）。
- `orbit-st-report-view.mjs`：补阶段中文名与用例标题，报告里不再显示裸 key。
- `nightly.yml`：`st_cases` 说明同步。
- `README.md`：用例表、选择器说明、以及**每条用例的真实通过条件**。

## 验证

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `node tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs` | 28 条，26 通过，2 失败 |
| 失败项 | `native stderr warnings…` / `native nonzero exit…` |
| 失败原因 | 本机沙箱禁止 `child_process.spawnSync` 捕获输出（`EPERM`），与本次改动无关：这两条用例及其依赖的 `runNative`（`scripts/orbit-st-tools.mjs`）在 main 上均未改动 |
| `scripts/prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs --compile-only` | 通过，27 个源文件，`OrbitStopTarget.ets` / `CloudMarkdown.ets` 均生成 |
| 生成物语法 | 用 SDK 自带 TypeScript 解析器全量解析 `.ets`，无语法错误 |
| `git diff --check` | 通过 |
| CI `node-ut` | **success**（含 `tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs` 全量 28 条，含本次新增断言） |
| CI `ArkTS Code Check` | **success** |
| CI `hypium-ut` | skipped（仓库变量 `ENABLE_HYPIUM_UT` 未开启，与本次改动无关） |

**未完成、不能算通过：**

- 本机真实 HAP 编译未跑成：hvigor 在 `C:\Users\qq567\.hvigor` 写缓存、并在 `node_modules\@ohos\hvigor` 建符号链接，本机沙箱分别报 `EPERM mkdir` 和 `EPERM symlink`（后者即 WinError 1314）。**CI 也没有跑 HAP 编译那条路**（`hypium-ut` skipped），所以 ST 工程的 ArkTS 编译门禁**仍未真正通过**；生成物只做了 TypeScript 语法解析。
- 两条新用例**从未在真实后端跑过**。`all` / `smoke` / `core` 里没有它们，Nightly 也不会自动跑到，需要显式 `-Cases markup,stop` 并配好 Gateway Bearer 与设备。
- 因此本 PR 不宣称 #233/#278/#241 的 ST 回归"已验证通过"，只提供可执行的回归用例与明确失败判据。跑通后再补真实回执。

## 复现

```powershell
# 离线断言
node tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs

# 生成 + 编译（需要可用的 DevEco 与符号链接权限）
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases 'markup,stop' -OutputDirectory "$env:TEMP\ST-IssueCases"

# 真实运行（需要 ST_DEVICE_ID / ST_ORBIT_URL / ST_ORBIT_BEARER）
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -Run -Cases 'markup,stop' -OutputDirectory "$env:TEMP\ST-IssueCases"
```

## 说明

- 提交内容只有上述 8 个文件，未包含签名材料、本地配置或凭据。
- `markup` 与 `stop` 跑通后会各自留下真实通过记录，届时再考虑是否纳入默认套件；本 PR 不预先放宽或收紧既有五条用例。

## 关于 PR 来源

本 PR 与 #294 是同一提交（`c6e0812f`）。#294 从私有 fork 发起，CI 的 `Download source snapshot` 用 base 仓库 token 去取 fork 的 tarball 返回 404，两个门禁只跑了收尾步骤就失败，实际未验证任何代码。改为从本仓库分支 `test/st-issue-regression-cases` 发起后，tarball 走 `github.repository`，两个门禁均已真实执行并通过。#294 已关闭。

recent_closed_unmerged.body:
## Summary

- **Why a weather question toasted "云端尚未升级，手机日历读取暂不可用":** `digitalmateClientContext()` puts `calendar_read: true` on *every* request regardless of topic, so an old cloud (which does not know the field) rejects even "今天天气" with `BAD_PARAMS: Extra inputs are not permitted [client.calendar_read]`. The client's retry path then shows a calendar-specific toast — once per message, on every message.
- `drainSend` now records the rejection in an in-memory `calendarReadUnsupported` flag, and a new `outgoingClientContext()` helper drops `calendar_read` from all later sends. Unrelated questions stop paying the retry round-trip and the misleading toast.

## Design choice

This mirrors the existing `profilingEnabled` suppression (same `BAD_PARAMS` shape), but is **deliberately not persisted**: once the cloud upgrades, the next app start re-advertises `calendar_read`, whereas the persisted profiling flag never comes back on its own. A comment in `Index.ets` records this reasoning.

## Changes

- `Index.ets`: `calendarReadUnsupported` field (page lifetime), `outgoingClientContext()` helper, both frame-construction sites (`task.create`, `room.message`) route through it, and the calendar rejection branch sets the flag before toasting.
- `tests/unit/digitalmate-composer-send.test.mjs`: new regression test — after the first rejection + successful safe retry, a second send ("今天天气") goes out with no `calendar_read`, exactly one request, and no additional toast. All 79 tests in the file pass.
- ST contract: the composer slice gains a fourth method, so `extractComposer` in `tests/st/prepare.mjs`, the ST host (`ComposerHost.ets`: new field + `DigitalMateClientContext` type import), and the two vm-sliced extraction tests are updated to the new shape. The fail-closed guard still throws on any further structural drift.

## Test plan

- `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-composer-send.test.mjs` — 79/79 pass.
- `node --test "tests/unit/*.test.mjs"` (glob form) — 3070 tests: 3061 pass, 0 fail, 9 skipped (pre-existing opt-in skips).
- Before the ST-contract update the full suite showed exactly 14 failures (6 in `digitalmate-message-actions`, 8 ST files), all traced to the extraction guard tripping on the new method — not pre-existing flakiness; all 14 pass after the contract update.

## Why

#1331 (`0b1a99508`) enrolled `tests/scenarios` as the `hive-scenarios` server suite. The isolated server run then refused it. Main's trusted `contracts_manifest()` raised `PackageProofError: incoming registry transition suite has an unreviewed shape: hive-scenarios`, because `transition_suite()` takes new enrolled suites only at `temp/<feature>/tests`. `9d6bd79f` reverted the row and its `INCOMING_REGISTRY` pin (plan: [#1331 F4 thread](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1331#discussion_r4572130582)).

The trusted run reads `scripts/ci` from the base branch, never from the PR. So the rule has to be on main before the row. This is PR 1 of 2. PR 2 adds only the `.github/ci-gates.json` row.

## Change

- `scripts/ci/server_contract_package.py`: adds `REVIEWED_PERMANENT_SUITES`, which holds one row, `hive-scenarios`: `discover`, `tests/scenarios`, `test_hive_*.py`, markers `test_hive_runner.py` and `test_hive_admission_steps.py`, `minimumTests` 20.
  - `registry_transition_rows()` accepts that name as an appended `enrolled` row only when it equals the reviewed row exactly, including key order. Any other shape is refused with `reviewed permanent suite has an unreviewed shape: hive-scenarios`.
  - `incoming_registry()` requires the row's path to be a real directory. It accepts a registry whose only appended row is this one, without a trusted policy, like the exact pin.
  - The row is optional. The row adds no `caseRoot`, `sourcePaths` or `sourcePackages` entry; the tests set up their own `sys.path`.
- Still fail-closed: `transition_suite()` is unchanged. A new suite at any other non-`temp/` path is still refused, and so is a `hive-scenarios` row with another owner, kind, path, pattern, markers, minimum, extra key or key order. The row cannot sit between pinned rows or repeat.
- Tests:
  - `test_installed_package_proof.py`: `TransitionRegistryRowTests` covers main's registry with and without the row, the pin plus only the row, every shape change, other permanent paths, `caseRoot`/`sourcePaths`/`sourcePackages` riders, a repeated key, and a missing, symlinked or file `tests/scenarios`. `test_main_registry_rows_are_admitted` leaves reviewed suites out of its expected feature set.
  - `test_contract_package.py`: full `contracts_manifest()` on the incoming layout, accepting the exact row and refusing its variants.
  - `test_suite_manifest.py`: `HiveScenarioSuiteTest`. If the registry has the row, it must equal the reviewed one. `load_registry()` accepts the registry either way. The real selector picks ≥ 20 tests from only the two runner modules, and a missing marker rejects the suite.
- Docs: `docs/guides/testing/ci-installed-package-proof.md` (registry rules), `ci.md` (single-group list), `UPDATES.md`.

## Local checks (Python 3.13, head `6cf9c72f4`, base main `336ab202e`)

| Check | main | this PR | this PR + PR 2's row |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_suite_manifest.py`, `test_contract_package.py`, `test_installed_package_proof.py` (pytest, deps venv) | 126 passed, 1521 subtests | 134 passed, 1553 subtests | 134 passed, 1553 subtests |
| `python3.13 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/scenarios -p 'test_hive_*.py'` | 20 OK | 20 OK | 20 OK |
| `python3.13 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/architecture` | 232 OK | 232 OK | 232 OK |
| `tools/architecture/check.py --policy docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json --root .` | 0 findings | 0 findings | 0 findings |

| Trusted `scripts/ci` | Candidate | Result |
|---|---|---|
| main | main | accepted (INCOMING, 34 files) |
| main | this PR | accepted |
| main | this PR + row | **refused**: `incoming registry transition suite has an unreviewed shape: hive-scenarios` (the original failure) |

The real selector also passes on this PR plus the row: `server-tests.py --suite hive-scenarios --require-tests --fail-on-skip` reports 20 tests, 0 skips, exit 0. recent_merged.author: lh913137941
recent_merged.body:
## Problem

- #1338: weather can fail after the device has supplied a city. test-7 has shown intermittent forecast connection timeouts; the underlying network or provider cause has not yet been established.
- #1339: phone calendar answers could report incorrect times or omit the phone-calendar read for a question about personal plans. A pre-read response-mode hint also mishandled filtered natural-language requests.
- The local-capability page displayed a system-todo placeholder even though that capability is not implemented.

- Standalone “where am I?” queries displayed coordinates instead of a readable nearby location.

## Changes

- The guarded HTTP connector probes each validated DNS address with a bounded TCP handshake and connects to the first live one, rotating the starting address from one attempt to the next. A silently dropped or hung first address therefore costs at most one short probe (or one attempt for HTTP/TLS-level hangs) instead of pinning every retry — the shape the v22 forecast failures showed (TCP completing while the TLS handshake stalled on one node, succeeding from another). When every address stays silent the fetch fails inside the attempt budgets (at most 12 s for the weather pair, inside the MCP deadline) with a timeout/transport category. Rate limits and the public-address guard remain enforced, and diagnostics stay privacy-safe (stage/phase only). This covers address-level faults; it cannot make a provider that refuses or rate-limits every address reachable.
- WorkSwarm is instructed to request the phone calendar for personal schedule questions, including questions that do not name the calendar. After a successful device read the Bridge renders the validated records itself: event times come from the device result and overlap claims from the Bridge's own interval comparison, with no task-local model interpretation call — so a model or transport failure cannot leave a successful read with a zero-value "please retry" reply (observed in production testing, 2026-11-14; removed in `9c514160`). Filtered or open-ended questions receive the full validated listing for the requested range rather than a model-selected subset.
- Calendar system authorization is requested directly when needed; there is no extra app-level notice before the system permission flow. Existing system grants still require the user's in-app consent when that capability is disabled.
- Remove the unavailable system-todo entry and update the native navigation and permission checks to require only calendar and location.

- Incorporate #1436: after one-time consent, the local card resolves the rounded fix through the system geocoder, discloses that use, and displays an accuracy-appropriate nearby address. It explains geocoder failure and retains existing precision-authorization behavior.

Refs #1338 and #1339. Weather reliability remains open and neither issue is closed by this PR.

## Validation

- Integrated head `ee54f0d5a9f2ad935a48a200d1707b7421ef672f` has the same source tree as the phone-tested integration commit `8ee99d58856abeb12eb820c9a8f0f0c372775cac`: 154 related Node tests passed with OS API fixtures, and the user confirmed the installed 10043 phone build displayed a readable address. The precise-location upgrade dialog was not independently re-tested on the phone. GitHub checks for the new head must be re-observed; results below are attributed to their named previous heads.

- PR head: `dbb859794e15837f0248d6d54bd86e39695ab0ee`, incorporating main `4b83ad09f2e7c69d282bf1037d46252b0679b537`. On this head, architecture conformance, ArkTS Code Check, Node UT, Hypium UT and device ST passed; `server-ut-st` was skipped and the aggregate gate was pending at the last observation. On prior head `41524368`, Node UT found one old test still expecting the removed todo entry; that test and the affected native acceptance cases and guide were updated.
- Local tests: 68 calendar/phone/schema tests passed (4 deselected), 9 calendar WebSocket flow tests passed (26 deselected), 56 weather/fetcher tests and 13 subtests passed, 28 client calendar permission/read-flow tests passed, and 21 local-capability navigation and permission tests passed. These tests include model-response fixtures and do not prove every natural-language request is interpreted correctly.
- A broader search/research selection had 82 passed, 11 failed and 28 subtests passed. The same 11 failures reproduced on the frozen main baseline in the same local environment; this suite is not reported as passing.
- Head `3c55b07e` adds the per-address probe/rotation above on top of `dbb85979`. Local: 56 weather/fetcher tests and 13 subtests passed (four new: HTTP-hang rotation end-to-end, all-silent bounded timeout, probe budget/timeout reporting, probe rotation). A six-file bridge sweep (workswarm flow, phone interactions, device calendar read, calendar answer, runtime wheels, workswarm adapter) showed 35 failed / 121 passed, and the identical 35 failures reproduce at the parent commit `41524368` in the same environment, so no new failure is introduced by this change; that sweep is not reported as passing. Product-source delta since the last full CI run on `dbb85979` is exactly this one commit, so the gates should be re-observed on the new head. Live validation of the probe/rotation against the test-7 weather path remains necessary.
- Head `21b6fab1` (previous, squashed) removes the task-local calendar interpretation call: after a successful device read the Bridge renders the validated listing directly (`calendar_answer`, `parse_calendar_answer`, `CALENDAR_ANSWER_RULE` and `CalendarAnswer` deleted; the zero-value "已读取日程，但暂时无法理解本次请求，请重试。" path no longer exists). Local: 86 passed across the workswarm-flow, device-calendar-read and phone-interactions bridge suites (30 calendar-selected tests included), and 10/10 client calendar read-flow tests. `test_calendar_answer.py` and the two filter-selection cases are deleted with the removed capability; listing, overlap, legacy-mode, range and source-footer assertions are kept and adjusted; the E3 guide commands and live checks are updated. Review follow-ups folded into the same head: all-day events render with the phone calendar exclusive end dates (a one-day all-day event no longer looks like two) and are excluded from overlap pairs; PHONE_CALENDAR_READ_RULE no longer promises a post-read filter that nothing applies. Local re-run after those fixes: 87 passed across the same bridge suites plus the new all-day rendering/overlap test. Gates should re-run on the new head.
- test-7 v23 is running server candidate `77a7a5aa83753f3ebbf00d62651429696b21c29b`, with existing data and parameters preserved. In the installed production app, both “今天剩下的安排” and “今天除早上的日程外，还有什么安排？” selected the evening events and showed their actual overlap. With the in-app calendar capability disabled but system grants present, the dialog's Allow action enabled access and the current query completed. Revoking system grants caused the OS calendar-permission sheet to appear; the original grants were restored. The OS sheet's complete manual-selection path has not yet been asserted by this test. These selections predate `9c514160`; filtered questions now return the full validated listing.

- Disclose that the system geocoding service receives the coordinates. Limit displayed detail to the granted precision and reported accuracy; do not show a house number or retain the result.

## Why

The CI server suite (`server-ut-st`) is paused repo-wide (#1014). Because of that, five test failures got onto `main` (`08e6ca2d`) with #1192 (Gmail/Outlook mail intake, `temp/composio-mail`) and #1337 (report cards, `temp/report-goals`) and nothing caught them. They also show up as pre-existing failures in the Hive Phase 1 integration PR #1336.

## Failures

1. `tests/architecture/test_domains.py`: `DomainWriterTests.test_real_schema_owner_and_existing_public_manager_pass`, `test_sql_values_and_comments_do_not_invent_writers` and `test_unrelated_sqlite_table_is_not_banned`.
   The domain checker reported AR03 "foreign SQL bypasses Session Store authority owner" with target `<dynamic SQL>` at:
   - `temp/composio-mail/src/dm_composio_mail/receiving/handoff.py:48`: a PRAGMA chosen by a conditional expression and passed as a variable.
   - `temp/report-goals/src/dm_report_goals/store.py:152`: a `SELECT` built by string concatenation.
2. `tests/server/test_installed_package_proof.py`: `InstalledPackageProofTests.test_actual_bridge_source_and_force_included_resource_are_enumerated` and `TransitionRegistryRowTests.test_main_registry_rows_are_admitted`.
   The Bridge `pyproject.toml` force-includes `dm_composio_mail` and `dm_report_goals`, and `.github/ci-gates.json` already admits both features. The proof test's expected `TRANSITION` map and its feature and enrolled sets did not list them.

## Fix

- Each flagged statement is now one plain SQL string literal, picked with `if`/`else`. The queries and behaviour are the same as before. This follows the pattern from #1332 (`e12a9faa`, `hive_store.py`). The domain checker and its tests are not changed.
- Added `dm_composio_mail → composio-mail` and `dm_report_goals → report-goals` to `TRANSITION`, and the two features to the expected feature and enrolled sets. This matches how the other `temp/` transition packages are listed. No assertion is weakened.

| `python3.13 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/architecture -p 'test_*.py'` | 232 tests OK |

| `temp/composio-mail/tests` | 92 passed, 109 subtests |
| `temp/report-goals/tests` | 37 passed |

The report-goals tests import `sqlite_bulk` from `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests`, so that directory has to be on `PYTHONPATH` along with the repo root, the Bridge `src`, `tests/server` and every `temp/*/src`.

recent_merged.body: Closes #1024 ## 问题与改动 额度耗尽时，失败气泡显示「本轮任务执行失败，暂时无法确认具体原因」或「云端模型请求过于频繁，请稍后重试」。用户据此去检查模型连接、反复重试，都无法解决（#1024）。期望直接说明额度已用完。 根因有两层，缺一不可： 1. **错误码被丢掉**：网关用 `quota_exhausted`（`apig.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED_CODE`）表示额度耗尽，但桥接层 `_CODE_NAMES` 只登记了 provider 的 `insufficient_quota`。码被丢弃后落到文本兜底，`engine_errors._ACCESS` 的 `quota|usage limit|billing` 又把这类文本读成限流，最终归为 `rate` 或 `unknown`。 2. **纯文本形态也认不出**：LiteLLM 预算耗尽是 HTTP 400 + `type: budget_exceeded`，既不是 402，也没有 provider code。当部署不跑在网关的 login model 上时（本环境 `MODEL_NAME=deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` 即是），网关不会补 `code`，错误到桥接层只剩一句 `Budget has been exceeded!`，任何现有规则都匹配不上 → `unknown`。 改动： - `execution_failures.py` - `_CODE_NAMES` 增加 `quota_exhausted`； - 新增 `_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED` 文本规则（`budget has been exceeded` / `budget_exceeded` / `insufficient_quota` / `余额不足` / `额度已用完` 等），位置在 provider code 之后、HTTP 状态之前，且仍在 `ToolError` 规则之后——工具失败时引述同样的句子仍判为 `tool`，不会说成额度问题。 - `DigitalMateStatus.ets`（客户端） - quota 文案改为「云端模型额度已用完，这一轮没有完成。请联系服务管理员补充额度，或等待额度恢复后再试。」； - quota 识别正则补「用完」，保证已渲染成新文案的历史回复回读时仍归为 `quota`。 边界：只改失败归因与文案，未改额度计算、计费口径或模型路由，也没有新增任何写额度的接口。 Fixes #1024 ## 验证 单测（改动后）： - Python `test_context_isolation.py::ClassifierTest`：5 passed / 13 subtests。新增两条用例覆盖网关错误码与纯文本 `budget_exceeded`，并断言真实 429 仍是 `rate`、`ToolError` 引述同样文本仍是 `tool`。 - Node：`digitalmate-status.test.mjs` 42 passed、`digitalmate-adapter.test.mjs` 83 passed；另 6 个引用状态文案的测试文件全绿，合计 195 passed。 真机（`adx-jiuwen-test-2`）： - 镜像 `v1025-adx-jiuwen-test-2`，源 commit `54e1fe5b`，北京/香港 SWR 摘要一致 `sha256:c662e0a43b6035877827641ce958b0d71c92ed905e06e3529c8953f07d115e1c`，linux/amd64，两地 `verified: true`。 - 把测试环境 LiteLLM key 的 `spend` 顶到 `max_budget` 制造额度耗尽后，同一会话的失败气泡由「暂时无法确认具体原因」变为「云端模型额度已用完，这一轮没有完成…」，效果见下表。 未跑：`ruff`（本机未安装）、e2e / Nightly。 ## 修复前后对比 | 修复前 | 修复后 | |:---:|:---:| | | | | 额度耗尽 → 「本轮任务执行失败，暂时无法确认具体原因」 | 额度耗尽 → 「云端模型额度已用完，这一轮没有完成…」 | ## 验证限制 - 真机复现依赖手工把测试环境的额度置 0（直接改 LiteLLM 虚拟 key 的 `spend`），不是产品内可用的开关；验证完成后已回滚到原值（`spend` 恢复到 34.96127720000007）。 - 只覆盖「额度耗尽」这一种拒绝形态。`rate_limited`、`free_model_unavailable`、`login_required` 等 APIG 错误码仍未进 `_CODE_NAMES`，目前靠文本兜底偶然得到正确结果或落到 `unknown`，建议单独跟进。 - 未验证额度恢复（`spend < max_budget`）后同一会话能否正常继续，也未覆盖多用户共用同一把 key 的并发场景。

> [!WARNING]
> **HIVE1 candidate. Do not merge before #1316 G1/G2; lands through #1336.** The coordinator combines it into `hive/hive1-integration`; G2 is the integration PR #1336 → main, so this PR is not merged on its own. No `pr-ready`.

Implements only the **Host answer path** of #1309 (H-A2 "原问题答复": answer the original question on a Run), so G1 check **SC02-S6** runs against a real `host_interaction` owner. Not included: H-A1 (Registry / factory / ProfileLoader), start / observe / supplement / Stop / release, the Beebou Harness (#1310).

Code is in a new transition feature `temp/hive-runtime/` (package `dm_hive_runtime`), registered in its own `ownership.json`, force-included in the Bridge wheel, and enrolled as the `hive-runtime` server suite (same layout as `temp/hive-worker/`, #1333).

## Published edge

`dm_hive_runtime.interaction.protocol.HostAnswerEdge.answer(AnswerRequest) -> AnswerReceipt`

- `AnswerRequest(scope, operation_id, interaction_ref, run_id, run_generation, question_version, answer)`
- `AnswerReceipt(operation_id, status, interaction_ref, run_id, witness, draft_kept, reason)`; `AnswerWitness(run_id, session_generation, run_generation, interaction_ref, operation_id, harness_ref)` is the Harness's consumption witness.
- Statuses: `CONSUMED`, `DELIVERY_PENDING`, `NOT_RESUMED` (all committed); `STALE_GENERATION`, `STALE_QUESTION`, `CLOSED`, `CONFLICT`, `UNKNOWN`, `INVALID` (nothing committed).

Names are the H-A2 review proposal; the Backend / Host owner has not yet signed them off (#1309 待签收).

Implementation `HostAnswerService` over ports (`interaction/ports.py`):

- `AnswerLedger`: `read_target`, `commit_answer`, `read_commit`. The Session Store (#1311) is the sole writer.
- `HarnessLocator` / `AnswerHarness.deliver_answer`: the Run's Harness instance, idempotent by operation ID.

## Ordering and errors

| Case | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Wrong Run or old run generation | `STALE_GENERATION`, refused before commit. An interaction's `run_id` and `run_generation` never change after it opens, so this check can't race a commit. |
| Settled or closed question (second answer, preempt reservation, Run end, intake closed) | `CLOSED`, draft kept, never reopened. The Store decides this in the transaction it shares with preempt. |
| Same operation ID, same request | Original receipt (Store replay plus Harness replay). |
| Same operation ID, changed request | `CONFLICT`. |
| Uncertain commit | Reconciled by the original ID through `read_commit`. Committed again with the same ID only when the Store has no record, up to `[commit] attempts`. Still undecided is `UNKNOWN`. |
| Delivery lost, or no live instance | `DELIVERY_PENDING`. A retry with the same ID delivers once. |

Tunables are in `config/answer.toml`.

## Verification (this head)

- `python3.13 -m unittest` in `temp/hive-runtime/tests`: 17 tests OK. These use **IN-MEMORY SUBSTITUTES** of the Store ledger and Harness (`hive_runtime_substitutes.py`), which are not evidence for Store or Harness behavior.

- `python3.13 -m unittest tests.server.test_installed_package_proof tests.server.test_suite_manifest tests.server.test_contract_package`: OK.
- **NOT_RUN here:** the real Store (`HiveBusyControls`) and the real WorkSwarm adapter. Both exist only on `hive/hive1-integration`. The stacked branch `hive1-runtime-c1` wires them and adds the real-SQLite tests: both S6 orderings, a parallel race and a repeated answer.

## Overlap check

No PR or branch on origin mentions #1309. I asked the Phase 2 parallel-work session whether anyone is building the unified proxy or its answer edge.

## Known limit

The consumption witness is not persisted. After the Harness instance is released, a repeat of a consumed answer no longer returns `CONSUMED`. Persisting the witness would need a Store write owned by #1311.

recent_merged.body:
> [!WARNING]
> **HIVE1 candidate. Do not merge before #1316 G1/G2.** The coordinator combines it into `hive/hive1-integration`; G2 is the Draft integration PR #1336 → main, so this PR is not merged on its own. Review requested from Bee owner @huben0423-hw.

Implements the #1268 Worker side for HIVE1 Phase 1: H-B1 Bot Repository plus roster, and H-A4 WorkSwarm peer Harness. It follows the #1228 H-C1–H-C5 contracts and the H-D2 rule (eviction archives a Bee; revival keeps its original `bee_id`).
Code is in a new transition feature `temp/hive-worker/` (package `dm_hive_worker`). The feature is registered in its own `ownership.json`, force-included in the Bridge wheel, and enrolled as the `hive-worker` server suite.

## Current entry, sole writers, file

| State | Sole writer | Storage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bee definitions, stable `bee_id`, roster version, REGISTERED/RETIRING/RETIRED | `BotRepository` | Its **own** SQLite file `<data dir>/hive-bot-repository.sqlite3` (`config/directory.toml`), tables `hive_bot_*` |
| Effective info (fixed template fields, CAS), generation gate, final-version witnesses | `BotRepository` | same file |
| Activation claim, generation, active binding (session/realm/**revision**), slot, receipts | Session Store (#1311, dev B #1332) | Store's `dm_hive_*` tables; never opened here |

There is no legacy entry and no Bridge adapter in this PR, so the `ownership.json` has no `adapters`/`callers`.

## Ordering against first admission (#1268/#1311 review question)

- `BotBinding.revision` is the **Store's own binding revision, passed through verbatim**. The Store compares it inside its admission commit against rows it alone writes. The directory's composition of definition and Store binding is preparation only; no cross-owner pre-read is presented as atomic.
- **Definition close/retire** happens in three steps:
  1. Bot Repository marks the definition `RETIRING`, so `resolve` returns `UNAVAILABLE`.
  2. Store `publish_bot_definition(..., retire=True)` closes the binding and **bumps its revision in the Store txn**. A dispatch prepared from the old binding then fails the Store's compare. The call is also made with `expected_revision=None` when there is no binding, so a later `activate_bot` returns `RETIRED`.
  3. Bot Repository marks the definition `RETIRED` and closes any open info generation.

  A Store conflict leaves the definition `RETIRING` (still unresolvable), and calling again resumes at step 2.
- **Effective-info gate:** opens only for a Store-verified claim (`verify_activation_claim`) whose generation is higher than any seen, including generations closed before they were opened. A same-generation close is persisted first; a late open or write for that generation is rejected. The final-version witness is the last committed version and digest at close.
- **Stable ID:** `bee-` + HMAC-SHA256(per-file key, [workspace, principal, operation_id]). A committed op ID replays its original receipt; the same op ID with a changed intent returns a conflict.

## Decided: Beebou as a seeded system definition

**Decided 2026-11-14** by the v3.1 lead (recorded on this PR and #1268). The Bee owner @huben0423-hw may revise it in Phase 2.

HIVE1 G1 SC01-D2 found that Beebou-origin deliveries failed #1226's receiver origin check. Beebou had only a Store binding, so `owner_of_session` returned NOT_FOUND.
Since `5a362694`, the change works as follows:
- `BotRepository.seed_beebou(scope, bot_id)` records Beebou as a fixed **system** definition: role `beebou`, one per scope, idempotent, values from `config/directory.toml [beebou]`.
- It is never a roster candidate and is never retired through the Bee lifecycle. The info gate answers `NOT_A_BEE`.
- The B1 directory (`hive1-worker-b1` `352237f7`) resolves it like a Bee. The definition comes from here; session, generation and revision come from the Store; the Store's role must match the definition's role.
- The receiver's origin check is not bypassed.
- The assembly must call `seed_beebou` before activating Beebou in the Store.

## H-C5 sealed-generation migration (SC01-W6)

`migration/driver.py` drives the Store's migrations by the original `migration_id`: `SEALED_PENDING → INGEST_ACCEPTED → PUBLISHED / SETTLED_NO_PUBLICATION → CLEANED`.
- It ingests only after the generation's release is recorded (its Local Memory is then frozen, `workswarm/sealed.py`).
- It asks the provider by the original ID before any delivery, so a lost ACK is resolved by query and never re-delivered or re-published. A held ID with different material stops the migration.
- A delayed publication is left for the next pass; every Store step is followed by a re-read, so a restart or a lost Store ACK resumes from the Store's state.
- Sealed material is cleaned only after a terminal receipt; a revived newer generation is never touched.
- Ports: `MigrationLedger` mirrors #1332's `HiveMigrationLedger` structurally (agreed with dev B; no `server_engine` import here); `MemoryIngestion` is the #1312 provider port. Retry, backoff and paging are in `config/migration.toml`. Assembly entry: `migration_driver(ledger, ingestion, bees_root, *, host)`.
- **Substitutes:** `tests/hive_worker_controlled_memory.py` is the **CONTROLLED** Memory provider (own SQLite file, counts deliveries and publications per `migration_id`; HIVE-SC-01 allows it, #1312 accepts the real provider). In this PR the Store ledger is `SubstituteMigrationLedger`; on `hive1-worker-b1` `test_hive_worker_migration_store.py` runs the driver on the real #1311 ledger with real SQLite restarts.

## Host answer delivery (agreed with #1309 dev C)

`WorkSwarmInstance.answer(run, interaction_ref, answer_id, payload=None)` delivers the Host-committed answer through `WorkSwarmRuntime.deliver_answer` and returns `AnswerWitness(run_id, generation, interaction_ref, answer_id)`. A repeat returns the original witness without redelivery; the same `answer_id` for another interaction is `CONFLICT`; a failed delivery records nothing and the Run keeps waiting.

## WorkSwarm review fixes

In `dcac1285` / `19bec595` (review F1–F3, F7, F8): an older WorkSwarm generation is rejected once a newer one exists, and once the newer one is READY the older instance accepts only Stop and release (a FAILED or UNKNOWN newer start leaves it live); a quiescent release is persisted and that generation is never started again; `bee_id` (and `seed_beebou`'s `bot_id`) must be a bounded plain token before any path is built.

## Partitions / destinations

| Partition | Destination | Needs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `config/`, `directory/{definitions,repository}.py` | HIVE-BOT Bot Repository | none |
| `directory/ports.py`, `roster.py` | HIVE-BOT (consumer of #1311) | `SQLiteSessionRepository.read_bot_binding / owner_of_session / publish_bot_definition / verify_activation_claim` (dev B), as separate reader/publisher/verifier Protocols |
| `workswarm/` | WorkSwarm Harness behind #1309's unified proxy | #1309 H-A1/H-A2 proxy signatures and the WorkSwarm Gateway transport; both are **SUBSTITUTE** ports here |
| `directory/directory.py` (B1 `BotDirectory` producer) | HIVE-BOT BotDirectory | `dm_beebou.receiving.ports` from #1226; **on the stacked branch `hive1-worker-b1`, not in this PR** |

On main, `temp/beebou/src` is absent, so importing `dm_beebou` is AR01 "unresolved". The B1 producer therefore lives on `hive1-worker-b1` (= the integration branch + this PR + one commit), which the coordinator combines into `hive/hive1-integration`. It folds into this PR after #1226 lands. That code needs **Python 3.12+** (`dm_beebou` uses `type` aliases); this PR's code runs on 3.11+.

## Verification

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `python3 tools/architecture/check.py --policy docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json --root .` | exit 0 (this branch); exit 0 on `hive1-worker-b1` with python3.13 |
| `transition.py --check …` | `hive-worker: 4 components, 0 adapters` |
| `PYTHONPATH=temp/hive-worker/src python3 -m unittest discover -s temp/hive-worker/tests -p "test_hive_worker_*.py"` | 63 tests OK (py3.11 and 3.13; `minimumTests` 63); 80 on `hive1-worker-b1` with real `dm_beebou` and the real #1311 migration ledger (`minimumTests` 80) |
| `tests/server/test_installed_package_proof.py` (py3.13) | 37 passed. Under local py3.11 its 18 pip-install cases error the same way on clean main (local env) |
| `tests/server/test_suite_manifest.py`, `test_contract_package.py` | 82 passed |
| `tests/server/test_a01_bootstrap_mode.py::…old_unenrolled_policy` | fails identically on clean main 8aa4e264 (pre-existing) |

HIVE-SC-01 Worker assertions covered:

| Assertion | Test | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Empty roster generates | `test_empty_roster_generates_one_archived_definition` | PASS |
| Same-ID retry, including across reopen | `test_same_operation_retry_replays_original_id_after_reopen` | PASS |
| Same op ID in other scopes gives different IDs | `test_same_operation_in_other_scopes_yields_distinct_ids` | PASS |
| Changed payload conflicts | `test_same_operation_with_changed_payload_conflicts` | PASS |
| Cross-account rejection | repository, gate and roster tests | PASS |
| Old-generation rejection | `test_old_generation_open_and_write_are_rejected` | PASS |
| Concurrent generation has one winner | `test_concurrent_generation_from_one_roster_version_has_one_winner` | PASS |
| Definition close/write races (thread races on real SQLite) | `GateRaceTests` | PASS |
| Retire vs first admission | `test_retire_closes_store_binding_before_marking_retired` | PASS against SUBSTITUTE Store |
| Active reuse, archived revive by original ID, old revision rejection | `hive1-worker-b1` directory tests | PASS against SUBSTITUTE Store |

H-A4 coverage (all with a SUBSTITUTE runtime):
- readiness witness only after READY; UNKNOWN on launch error or no readiness
- exact-Run step consumption; pending supplements held while waiting for the original answer
- Stop and release witnesses; old-generation and released controls rejected; another Bee unaffected
- per-generation private Local Memory

**Real participants:** Bot Repository on real SQLite (multi-connection thread races, reopen).
**Substitutes:** the Store (`tests/hive_worker_substitutes.py`, in-memory, until dev B's #1332 is combined), the WorkSwarm runtime, and the Backend/Host (#1309).
**NOT_RUN:** the real Store, Backend/Host and WorkSwarm Gateway, the installed-wheel G1 scenario run (QA #1314), and model/device participants.

**HIVE1 candidate — do not merge before #1316 G1/G2; combined into `hive/hive1` by the coordinator.**

Implements #1311 (HIVE-STORE) for Phase 1 of #1316. The SQLite Session Store becomes the sole writer that #1226's receiving side and #1268's Bee lifecycle consume. The Store packages don't import `dm_beebou`: inputs are duck-typed and outcomes are built through an injected codec.

## What the Store now provides

| Contract | Entry (on `SQLiteSessionRepository`) | Persisted facts |
| --- | --- | --- |
| H-C6 directed admission (#1226 `AdmissionOwner`) | `reconcile_delivery`, `finish_delivery`, `consume_delivered_inputs`, `read_delivered_input` | `dm_hive_deliveries` (receipt keyed by scope + sender namespace + `message_id`, fingerprint), `dm_hive_tasks` (original `task_ref`), `dm_hive_inputs` (EVENT role, bot author/origin, consume witness) |
| Binding source for #1268 | `read_bot_binding`, `owner_of_session`, `publish_bot_definition`, `verify_activation_claim` | `dm_hive_bot_bindings`, `dm_hive_bot_sessions`, `dm_hive_retired_bots` |
| H-C3/H-C4 activation and slots | `activate_bot`, `confirm_slot_release` | `dm_hive_activation_claims/ops`, `dm_hive_slots`, `dm_hive_evictions` |
| H-C7 quick reply vs normal claim | `repository.hive_replies`: `claim_quick_reply`, `commit_quick_reply`, `claim_normal_turn`, `record_quick_displayed`, `withdraw_quick_replies`, `read_reply_projection` | `dm_hive_reply_records` (one record per original message: quick claim/commit/displayed and normal claim) |
| H-C5 Bee memory handover (`HiveMigrationLedger`) | `read_migration`, `read_eviction_migration`, `list_open_migrations` (Host, all scopes, restart recovery), `record_ingest_accepted`, `record_publication` / `record_no_publication`, `record_cleaned` | `dm_hive_migrations`: `SEALED_PENDING` (written in the seal transaction) → `INGEST_ACCEPTED` → `PUBLISHED` / `SETTLED_NO_PUBLICATION` → `CLEANED`. Forward-only compare-and-swap; an exact replay returns the original receipt; a different value → `CONFLICT`; a new step after `CLEANED` → `CLOSED` |
| Task view | `task_get`, `task_list` (paged, `complete` flag), `read_task_digest`, `dispatch_status` (absent receipt → `unknown`) | derived from tasks, receipts and inputs |
| H-C8 busy controls | `repository.hive_busy`: `queue`, `claim_next_turn`, `steer`, `record_steer_applied/unapplied`, `preempt`, `record_run_end`, `start_successor`, `read_control`, `open_interaction`, `submit_answer` | `dm_hive_controls`, `dm_hive_turn_queue`, `dm_hive_runs`, `dm_hive_run_reservations`, `dm_hive_interactions` |

How the ordering works: every Store write runs in one `EngineStore.transaction()`. Its first statement takes the WAL write lock (`store_write`). Re-reconcile, the binding read, the generation, watermark and scope checks, and the writes all happen after that lock. A binding change (activation, eviction, `publish_bot_definition`) is itself a Store write, so it is serialized against the admission commit. No cross-owner pre-read is treated as atomic. Host facts (step consumption, Run end and isolation, release witness, context consumption, answers) are accepted only through `HostAuthority.authenticate`.

Placement: new logic is in the new files `session_proximity/hive_store.py`, `hive_busy.py` and `hive_migrations.py`. Repository changes are limited to constructor kwargs and delegations, and `dm_sessions.types.MessageRole` gains `EVENT`. Schema goes through the existing `ensure_schema` path as `dm_hive_*` tables, outside the `dm_session_*` catalog that the hosted v8 upgrade validates. Tunables live in `session_proximity/hive_store.toml`; a missing or invalid file raises `HiveSettingsError`. The toml is in the built wheel (checked with `uv build --wheel`).

## Tests (real temp SQLite)

```
cd harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests
python -B -m unittest test_session_proximity_hive_admission test_session_proximity_hive_busy test_session_proximity_hive_replies test_session_proximity_hive_migrations -v
```

All four files match the enrolled `bridge-session-proximity` discovery (`test_session_proximity*.py`). Each case uses its own `TemporaryDirectory()/workspace.db`. Races run on separate threads with separate `EngineStore` connections, released by a barrier. Lost-ACK cases commit in a child process that exits before returning, and the parent then reopens.

| Assertion | Test | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SC01-S1 lost ACK + reopen → original `task_ref`, changed payload → `id_conflict`, cross-scope refused | `test_sc01_s1_…` | PASS |
| SC01-S2 binding revision changes between resolve and commit → `UNAVAILABLE`, no rows; same ID re-resolves | `test_sc01_s2_…` (sequential + parallel) | PASS |
| SC01-S3 new-task admission vs idle-LRU eviction claim: one winner; slot stays `RELEASING` until release witness | `test_sc01_s3_…` | PASS |
| SC01-S4 revival by original ID → new generation/session; old binding's first dispatch refused; one session per generation | `test_sc01_s4_…` | PASS (Store binding; real #1268 BotDirectory not wired here) |
| SC01-W6 seal → `SEALED_PENDING`; delayed ingestion, lost ACK (crash child) repeat → original receipt, restart listing resumes across scopes and pages, revival before ingestion keeps the original `migration_id`, conflict and other terminal refused | `test_sc01_w6_…` (5 tests) plus the `LedgerRuleTests` | PASS — Store seam only, controlled Host; driver and controlled provider are #1268's, real provider #1312 NOT_RUN |
| SC02-S1 steer `APPLIED` only on consumption witness; natural end → `UNKNOWN`; `UNAPPLIED` needs both proofs | `test_sc02_s1_…` | PASS — Store seam only, controlled Host |
| SC02-S2 FIFO across original Run end (parallel end + queue) | `test_sc02_s2_…` | PASS |
| SC02-S3 natural end before vs after reservation → `TARGET_STALE` vs `PREVIOUS_ENDED`; Stop → `STOPPED` | `test_sc02_s3_…` | PASS |
| SC02-S4 two devices preempt one Run → one `STOPPING`, one `CONFLICT`, same-ID replay | `test_sc02_s4_…` | PASS |
| SC02-S5 Stop ACK loss → reconcile by original ID; successor started once (crash child + parallel retries) | `test_sc02_s5_…` | PASS |
| SC02-S6 answer-first vs preempt-first, duplicate answer replay, parallel order | `test_sc02_s6_…` (2 tests) | PASS — Host interaction owner is a controlled substitute |
| H-C7 quick first / normal first / parallel / crash after commit before send / moved watermark / reset + source withdrawal | `test_session_proximity_hive_replies` (6) | PASS |
| Task view paging, completeness, cross-scope, digest, unknown dispatch | `test_task_view_…` | PASS |
| Status ledger, EVENT provenance, steer association, rejection replay, `UNKNOWN`, retire, pre-Hive DB, settings, EVENT rendering | remaining cases | PASS |

Regression baseline, run locally (Python 3.12): `test_session_proximity_integration` (23), `test_session_proximity_upgrade`, `test_session_proximity_hosted_replay` and `test_session_proximity_repository` all pass. In the full `test_session_proximity*` discover, 431 tests ran and 8 failed: `hosted_bindings` runtime-origin probes, `legacy_receipts` and `a01_consumer`. The same 8 fail identically on base `8aa4e264` locally, because they need Python 3.13 and installed packages.

#1226's pending Store cases run against this branch merged with `origin/hive/hive1` (`c69d1b13`). `BindingRevisionTests`, `StatusQuotaTests` and `EventProvenanceTests` all pass (6/6) once `wire_store` is filled in. `PendingStoreInterfaceMarkers` fails by design as soon as these methods exist. The coordinator applies the promotion diff (wire_store + rename + marker removal) to `hive/hive1`, together with the #1226 owner. This PR doesn't touch `temp/beebou` or `tests/server/*beebou*`.

## Known gaps

- **Architecture gate AR10:** the two new files need inventory rows (`session-proximity-hive-store` and `session-proximity-hive-busy`, both checked, plus the repository's `allowed` list). Under the repo rule that is a separate reviewed `module-ownership.json` change that merges first. With those rows the gate reports 0 findings. Until then this PR's architecture check shows the two AR10 findings.
- `NOT_RUN`: the real Host (#1309) and interaction owner for SC02-S1/S6 and the H-C7 device-displayed witness (controlled Host here).
- Hosted v9/v10 upgrade does not migrate `dm_hive_*` tables. They live in the legacy-path database only.

recent_merged.body:
**HIVE1 QA — do not merge before #1316 G1/G2.** This reaches main through the G2 integration PR #1336 (merge commit), after G1 is judged; the coordinator decides when.

## What

One command runs the G1 acceptance for [#1316](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1316) / [#1314](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1314) and writes a machine-readable report:

```sh
python3 tests/scenarios/run_hive.py --gate G1 --report hive-g1.json --markdown hive-g1.md --prepare-deps .hive-deps-venv
```

- **Scenarios.** HIVE-SC-01 (SC01-W1–W7, S1–S4, D1–D2) and the HIVE-SC-02 Store segment (SC02-S1–S6), stepwise, each assertion `PASS` / `FAIL` / `BLOCKED` / `NOT_RUN` with a reason, participants (real / substitute / missing), evidence and the `message_id → bee_id / Session → task_ref` trace.
- **No fake PASS.** `hive/model.py` refuses a PASS without evidence, or with a missing participant, or with a substitute the owner issue does not allow. Producer entries live in `hive/producers.toml`; a module counts as real only if it imports from the selected owner roots with every listed interface. An editable install of another checkout does not count.
- **Installed-package proof (HIVE1-PKG-1–3, #1314).** Builds the contracts and Bridge wheels from the checkout with the hash-locked tools, then verifies, cleanly installs and probes them. It uses only the existing `scripts/ci/server_package_proof.py` / `server_contract_package.py` functions (`verify_wheel`, `PIP_INSTALL`, `verify_installation`, `PROBE`, `probe_beebou`); neither file is edited. The scenario phase then imports owners **from those installed sites**. Substitute recorded in every receipt: one local host, not the CI two-container separation.
- **Nightly-ready.** Same command, plus `--wheelhouse`, `--prepare-deps` and `--require-pass`; the report schema is `dm.hive.scenario-report/1`.
- **Composed steps.** SC01-W6 and SC02-S6 are `composed`. Owner tests alone cannot pass them: the runner's own step must run through the real participants.
  - **W6:** evict a Bee, revive it before ingestion starts, lose the provider ACK, then restart the Store, provider and Bee root. The step checks one delivery and one publication per original `migration_id`, and that the real #1311 ledger reaches `CLEANED`. It uses #1268's migration driver and #1268's controlled Memory provider, which HIVE-SC-01 allows.
  - **S6:** run answer-first, preempt-first, and a repeated answer after a restart, through #1309's `HostAnswerService` on the real Store and WorkSwarm adapter. No substitute is allowed for the Host interaction owner.
- **CI enrollment (#1331 review F4, user-authorized).**
  - `tests/scenarios` is enrolled as server suite `hive-scenarios`, with markers `test_hive_runner.py` and `test_hive_admission_steps.py` and at least 20 tests.
  - The same row is pinned in `server_contract_package.py` `INCOMING_REGISTRY`, ahead of the appended temp rows. Selector tests in `tests/server/test_suite_manifest.py` cover the pin, the selection and a missing marker.
  - PR suites read the base registry, so the suite starts on main after #1336 lands.
- **Docs.** `docs/scenarios/hive-scenario-runner.md` covers the command, assertion registry, rules and report format; README, test-mapping, the HIVE scenario page and UPDATES are updated.

## Results

This branch is based on main and holds only the QA files. Scenario results need the producers, so G1 runs on a combination with this branch merged in. G2 lands everything on main through Draft integration PR #1336.

**Current G1 run (scenario code at `598a54f5`; later commits are docs only): 22 PASS, 0 FAIL, 0 BLOCKED, 0 NOT_RUN.**

- **Combination:** `hive1-runtime-c1` `a0e196ff` merged with this branch at `598a54f5`, giving head `cb6d92ff`.
  - `a0e196ff` is `hive/hive1-staging` plus the #1332 migration ledger, the #1333 migration driver and the #1341 Host answer edge.
- **Also run on:** `hive/hive1-staging` `bef46e2b` + `a0e196ff` + `598a54f5` (head `101c6607`). Same result: 22/22, and runner unit tests 20/20.
- **Run settings:** `--source wheel`, Python 3.13, the command above plus `--prepare-deps`.
- **Package proof:** owners import from the verified installed sites. HIVE1-PKG-2 covers the transition packages `dm_beebou`, `dm_hive_worker` and `dm_hive_runtime`, along with main's.

| Result | Assertions |
| --- | --- |
| PASS | SC01-W1–W7, S1–S4, D1, D2; SC02-S1–S6; HIVE1-PKG-1–3 |

- **Substitutes.** Each is labelled in the report, as #1314 allows:
  - the #1226 FIXTURE directory on S1/S2/D1;
  - the WorkSwarm readiness witness on W3;
  - #1268's controlled Memory provider on W6;
  - #1311's controlled Host credential where the Host port is called;
  - #1268's substitute WorkSwarm runtime below the real adapter on W6/S6;
  - the owner-test stand-ins, listed per assertion.

  S6's Host interaction owner is real.
- **Where the receipt lives.** The JSON and Markdown reports are in the HIVE1 shared notes, and the run history is in `docs/scenarios/hive-scenario-runner.md`. The coordinator registers receipts in #1314.
- **Earlier runs, superseded.**
  - `60c03bac` (#1226 only): PKG-1 PASS, the rest BLOCKED.
  - `2ed58a2a`: 19 PASS, 1 FAIL. The FAIL was SC01-D2, a genuine `source_forbidden` finding that #1268 fixed with `seed_beebou`.
  - `f6308ffb`: 20 PASS, 2 BLOCKED, with W6 and S6 waiting on their producers.
- **Plain main.** The runner completes in checkout mode with every row BLOCKED or NOT_RUN and an owner reason, and no import crash.

## Tests

- **Runner unit tests:** `python3.13 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/scenarios -p 'test_hive_*.py' -v`.
  - 20/20 on the combination.
  - On plain main, 17 pass and 3 skip: the admission-step mechanics need #1226. #1226 is on main once #1336 lands.
- **Gate tests:** `tests.server.test_contract_package`, `test_suite_manifest`, `test_installed_package_proof` and `test_context_source_profile` pass, 130 tests. `tests/architecture` passes, 221 tests.
- **Architecture check:** `tools/architecture/check.py` with main's policy finds nothing.
- **Lint:** `uvx ruff check tests/scenarios --select F,E9,B` is clean.

## Notes

- **#1226 dependency.** The SC01 admission steps use #1226's receiving core and FIXTURE directory once #1226 is in the tree. Without it, those roles are BLOCKED and the related mechanics tests skip.
- CI `gate-report` is currently cancelled repo-wide by a base-snapshot download timeout (#1281). Treat such a cancel as infrastructure, not a result.

WIP · #1223 / #1228 / DM31-HIVE

Beebou 的命名投递核心位于 `temp/beebou/src/dm_beebou/delivery/`。Bridge 静态打包，Session Manager 准备受理，持久写入仍归原 Store writer。会话与执行 selection 继续归 A10 / `server/router`。

- [Delivery v0.15](docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-delivery-design.md)、[故障处理 v0.8](docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-failure-handling.md)、[P0–P7](docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-implementation-plan.md)、[架构评审 PPT](docs/implementations/contracts/dm-v31-system-gaps-architecture.pptx)、[Core Feature PPT](docs/implementations/contracts/dm-v31-beebou-feature-design.pptx) 已纳入本分支。材料来自评审提交 `2b9f359a`，补正现行目录和验证入口。
- 候选提供 B1/C3、配置校验、dispatch / report、同 ID 重试和接收对账，以及问答期限和恢复策略。新增 pending status 上限 4、累计上限 8 的配置校验。实际计数、去重、来源投影和绑定 CAS 由原受理事务实现。详见 [B1/C3 和逐 owner 迁出条件](docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-bot-handoff.md)。
- #1264 已同步 Delivery 的模块名、DM31-HIVE 归属和 Bridge 来源清单。两边 22 条登记完全一致。

验证（`6805577c` / CPython 3.12.13）。从 checkout 外非 editable 安装真实 wheel，验证 16 个模块、6 份资源和 91 项 Beebou 测试。124 项包回归、3 项构建上下文检查、2 项架构反例通过。用 #1264 候选可信侧扫描完整源码 313 个文件，无违规。五份 PPTX 与评审源字节一致，校验了容器结构与文档相对链接。此前用真实临时 SQLite 验证现有 Repository 和 Store writer 的排队、跨域拒绝、回放和冲突。

待办。#1264 尚待 G01/G09 正式接收与受保护 Linux 验收。Bot 独立 Issue 和负责人、共享契约的 owner 接受、原 Store 的 Bot 来源与受理接口、真实 Bot/手机/模型/部署验证均待完成。额度 owner 与 `quota_exhausted` 的真实覆盖仍待部署侧确认。此 PR 保持 Draft。

## Checklist
- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] I understand that a bug report lacking environment information and a minimal reproducible demo may be hard to reproduce and could be closed.

## 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

In the DigitalMate mobile chat, when an answer renders a Mermaid `sequenceDiagram`, the diagram card shows the chart correctly but keeps a large empty area below the last visible line. The last line is the bottom repeated participant-label row ("请求方 / 云端 / 端侧授权层 / 用户"); below it the card holds a blank band roughly one-plus text-line tall before the next paragraph ("读法三条…"). As a result the card looks like it does not fit its content, and the gap between the diagram and the following text is much larger than normal paragraph spacing.

This is a display-only issue: the diagram content and the surrounding text are correct, only the trailing whitespace / layout is wrong.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Open DigitalMate mobile and ask a question whose answer contains a Mermaid `sequenceDiagram` (for example: "把端侧授权层、云端、请求方三方之间的授权与撤销流程画成一张时序图").
2. Wait for the answer to render the sequence-diagram card.
3. Look at the bottom of the diagram card: after the final participant-label row there is a large blank region before the following paragraph.

## Expected result
- The diagram card height should follow the actual rendered SVG content (or the trailing blank be trimmed), so that the following paragraph sits immediately below the chart with normal spacing.

## Actual result
- A large blank area (visually around one-plus line height, clearly larger than normal spacing) remains below the diagram, inside/around the card; the content does not hug the chart bottom.

## Possible cause (inferred, not code-verified)
- The sequence-diagram container likely uses a fixed / minimum height or an oversized bottom padding / margin and does not size to the rendered SVG; alternatively the bottom participant-label row is laid out twice while extra vertical space is still reserved. This is inferred from the rendered screenshot, not confirmed against the front-end code.

## Detailed Environment Information Description
- App: DigitalMate (package `com.jiuwen.digitalmate`), mobile
- Platform: Android phone (mobile client)
- Timezone: Asia/Shanghai
- Observed at: 2026-11-08 22:19:48
- Component: chat answer rendering — Mermaid `sequenceDiagram` card

## Additional Information
- The bug is purely visual and appears whenever a `sequenceDiagram` is rendered in an answer card; the amount of blank space depends on how the diagram is laid out, not on user input.
- Other Mermaid diagrams in the same conversation may share the same card-rendering path; not yet verified.

## Version Information
- App version / build: DigitalMate 0.1.9 (Android mobile client).

## Screenshots / Recordings
![Sequence-diagram card with excessive blank space below the chart (22:19:48)](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-933-screenshots/.screenshots/sequence-diagram-blank/01_blank_221948.jpg?raw=true)
closed_recent.title: [Bug]: Mermaid sequence-diagram card leaves excessive blank space below the chart

### Checklist

- [x] 已核对已有图片预览需求 #932，本单聚焦已经显示在助手回复中的生成图片无法点击放大这一具体问题。
- [x] 已附用户提供的实际表现截图与复现步骤。
- [ ] 当前 main 或最新版本的代码复现尚未执行，不能据此判断根因及修复状态。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**问题：** 助手生成的图片已经在对话回复中显示，但用户点击图片后无法放大查看，无法方便地核对图片细节或完整内容。

**复现步骤：**
1. 在 Digital Mate 对话中输入“请生成一张关于春节的图片”。
2. 等待助手在回复中显示生成图片。用户截图中为红金配色的春节主题海报。
3. 点击回复中的图片，尝试打开大图或进行缩放查看。

**实际表现：** 根据用户反馈，点击图片不支持放大查看。截图证明图片已以内嵌形式显示；点击无放大是用户报告，本次未进行设备复现。

**期望表现：** 点击生成图片进入大图预览，支持缩放和拖动查看细节，并能返回原对话；返回后保持滚动位置和输入草稿。点击图片与下载操作应明确区分，不应以仅提供下载替代大图预览。

**建议验证范围：** PNG/JPG 等位图，以及实际支持的 SVG/矢量图片呈现路径；先确认该示例真实产物格式，不仅凭回复文案判定。此问题不评价生成内容质量，也不要求更换图片生成模型。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 产品：Digital Mate 手机端。
- 场景：助手生成图片后，在回复气泡内点击图片查看。
- 截图状态栏时间：19:18；未显示拍摄日期。
- 手机型号、HarmonyOS 版本：截图未提供，待补充。
- 网络与云侧环境：尚未确认。

### Version Information

截图未显示 App 版本、构建号或对应代码提交，待复现时补充。不将本会话此前安装的调试包版本直接当作该截图的版本。

### Screenshots / Recordings

![Digital Mate 生成的春节海报已在回复中显示，但用户反馈点击无法放大查看](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/4b0a50a17829632d20a921f1d90998089484a91b/docs/issue-evidence/ucd-20261107/generated-image-no-zoom-20261109.jpg?raw=true)

### Additional Information

关联 #932（图片输入与输出支持图片预览）。该需求包含输入/输出预览的整体范围；本 Issue 单独跟踪“已有生成图片无法点击进入大图”的可复现交互问题。

验收建议：
- 点击实际生成图片可进入大图查看，缩放与拖动正常，比例正确。
- 长图、大图及回复仍在生成时的点击行为稳定；未就绪时给出明确状态。
- 多图点击打开正确的图片，不串图；历史恢复后仍可按权限打开。
- 断网、图片删除或权限失效时有明确错误与重试/返回路径，不出现空白页面。
- 关闭预览回到原对话，不丢草稿、不改变原滚动位置；保留现有下载能力。
