### 🚀 Background Description

#946 合入 `main` 后，普通 CI 的 `architecture-conformance` 和 `server-ut-st` 都未分配 runner，执行步骤数均为 0。GitHub 的失败注释指向账户付款或支出上限。两项检查当前使用 `ubuntu-latest`，需要迁到 CI专用服务器，恢复 PR 的服务端检查和门禁汇总。 [失败运行 42647584474](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/42647584474)

### Design Ideas

1. 由 CI 基础设施负责人选定 CI专用服务器，提供隔离、可重置的 Linux x64 运行环境。runner 以非 root 用户运行，能访问本机 Docker，并能以非交互方式挂载和卸载 `server-ut-st` 使用的受限 tmpfs。运行环境需要能访问 GitHub、固定摘要的 Python 镜像和依赖源。
2. 由 DigitalMate 仓库管理员注册 self-hosted runner，设置专用标签并确认在线。更新工作流中两个 job 的 `runs-on`，由 GitHub Actions 直接派发。保留现有 job 名称、离线容器限制、报告校验和门禁判定。分支保护和 required-check 设置另由 #746 跟踪。

### Test Design and Test Plan

1. 验证 runner 在线，能拉取固定镜像、安装依赖并创建和清理受限 tmpfs。
2. 发起一次新的 server-only `workflow_dispatch`，记录测试 SHA，确认两个 job 均由 CI专用服务器的 runner 执行并上传架构和服务端测试报告。
3. 用一次新的 PR 事件确认两个普通 job 都在 CI专用服务器上执行，`gate-report` 汇总实际结果。记录 run 链接、runner 名称和结论。

### 🚀 Background Description

**G09 prerequisite fulfilled (2026-11-07 readback):** [#745 completed scoped CI acceptance](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/745#issuecomment-6709027699) on merged main `9761dd09a41bbd732085e8bca0e1a556b420ef21`, including actual merged active-caller/report/owned-cleanup adoption. The closed native G09 edge is retained as fulfilled history, not an unresolved blocker. Remaining open native prerequisites: [A03 #751](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/751). **This issue remains OPEN** for its own stated acceptance; no production, HAP/device or full-migration result is inferred.
<!-- /DM31:G09-FULFILLED:9761 -->

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-G03`.

**Outcome:** Only the declared owner writes each domain; failed final persistence never publishes success.

**Owner:** Store owner. **Batch:** P1: authoritative spine and first phone vertical. **Size:** 1 working day; existing leaves reused, prerequisites excluded.

**Not responsible for:**
- Do not ban all SQLite
- Do not redesign checkpoint semantics

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** Produce the stated contract, inventory, checker or independent evidence artifact using `.github/ci-gates.json::gate catalog` as the concrete source. Preserve the accepted owner and scope; this preparation/verification task does not claim code migration.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** tools/architecture/domains.py; tests/architecture/test_domains.py; tests/server/st/test_store_authority.py (planned artifacts; retain existing shared drivers/assertions)

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [.github/ci-gates.json](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/.github/ci-gates.json) — `gate catalog`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Architecture reference [server/agent_service/session_store/proxy.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/session_store/proxy.py) — `SQLiteSessionStoreProxy`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [server/agent_service/attachments/store.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/attachments/store.py) — `AttachmentStoreProxy`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [server/mobile_gateway/navigation.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/mobile_gateway/navigation.py) — `_NavigationIndex`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [docs/specs/host-operation-lifecycle.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/specs/host-operation-lifecycle.md) — `Four host-issued operations`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Memory/source/attachment/navigation ownership and crash-recovery behavior

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Cross-domain SQL and leaked private connection authority

**Writable boundary:**
- tools/architecture/domains.py
- tests/architecture/test_domains.py
- tests/server/st/test_store_authority.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-A03](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/751), [DM31-G09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/745) (**FULFILLED/CLOSED**; retained dependency history)

**Blocks:** [DM31-G08](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/771)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A04](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/752), [DM31-A05](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/753), [DM31-A06](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/754), [DM31-A07](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/755)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Legal Manager-to-Store fixture passes
- Gateway-to-run-table and leaked-connection fixtures fail
- Final-write failure visible through service entry; zero completed terminal
- Projection owner and rebuild semantics explicitly recorded

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 scripts/ci/server-tests.py --suite store-authority --require-tests --fail-on-skip

**Assertions:** - server-tests.py --suite store-authority --require-tests --fail-on-skip (proposed)
- Architecture legal/illegal domain fixtures

**Participants:** Actual scanner and legal/violating fixtures; runtime suites use real owning public components/SQLite with controlled providers. G05 physically omits Core in its isolated installation. No phone/device claim.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** migrated-store-public-contract, temporary-file-sqlite. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** AR03, AR09.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

### Checklist
- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

用户反馈「提 issue 的过程非常非常久」，需要对最近一次提交 issue（#1056，盯乐队/历史会话关联那条）做一次耗时统计与性能定位，作为性能问题上报。

**测量方法**
- 数据来源：本会话原始运行时间线（raw session timeline 的 `events.jsonl` 事件时间戳），时间换算为 Asia/Shanghai（北京时间，UTC+8）。
- 统计对象：#1056 这一整轮「用户发出提 issue 请求 → issue 创建成功 → 回复完成」的全过程。
- 只统计该轮实际用于「准备截图 / 组织正文 / 调用接口创建 issue / 生成回复」的耗时，不含用户自己思考和截图的时间。

**关键数据（#1056 实测）**

| 指标 | 数值 |
| --- | --- |
| 全轮总耗时 | 273.8 s ≈ 4 分 34 秒 |
| 任务开始（用户请求时间） | 2026-11-10 17:31:18 |
| issue 创建成功（接口返回） | 17:33:45（自开始 +2 分 27 秒） |
| 回复完成 | 17:35:51（issue 创建后 +2 分 07 秒） |
| 模型往返轮次（model calls） | 23 次 |
| 工具调用总数 | 32 次（bash 20、tool_search 7、read_file 5） |
| 首次模型响应延迟 | 11.3 s |
| 最长模型往返间隔 | 44.5 s（17:34:28 → 17:35:12） |
| 其它超过 15 s 的间隔 | 30.4 s、27.7 s、19.4 s、17.8 s、16.8 s |

**阶段拆解**
1. 17:31:18 开始 → 17:33:45 issue 创建：147.1 s（约 2 分 27 秒）。这一段主要消耗在进行多轮工具调用（先查模板、准备/整理截图、草拟正文、校验 body），并穿插多次模型往返。
2. 17:33:45 issue 创建 → 17:35:51 回复完成：126.7 s（约 2 分 07 秒）。创建成功后仍在继续多轮工具调用（补充校验、确认标签/状态、核对链接等）并反复走模型往返，才输出最终回复。

**性能定位（初步分析）**
- 全轮共有 **23 次模型往返**，其中多次单次间隔超过 15 s，最长 44.5 s；模型往返是主要耗时来源之一。
- 全轮共 **32 次工具调用**，其中 **bash 20 次**，且大量为串行执行（准备截图、拼装/写入正文、创建 issue、校验等各自独立成步），单步之间还要等待模型决定下一步，放大了总时长。
- issue 真正创建成功只用了约 2 分 27 秒，但创建之后又花了约 2 分 07 秒做后续校验与收尾，说明「创建后的校验/确认链路」也偏长。
- 整体看，「一次提 issue」被拆成了过多轮模型决策 + 过多串行 shell 步骤，缺少可一次性完成的聚合操作，导致全程接近 4.5 分钟。

**复现步骤**
1. 提出一个需要「准备截图 + 按模板写正文 + 创建 issue」的提 issue 请求。
2. 观察从用户请求到 issue 创建成功、再到最终回复输出之间的耗时与步骤数。
3. 实测（#1056）：总耗时约 4 分 34 秒，23 次模型往返、32 次工具调用（其中 bash 20 次）。

**期望行为**
- 提 issue 这类固定流程应尽量收敛为少量步骤、可在一次或少数几次工具调用内完成，减少不必要的模型往返与串行 shell 步骤。
- 常见的准备（读模板、组织正文、校验字段、上传截图、创建 issue、校验结果）应能聚合执行，缩短整体耗时。

**实际行为**
- 单次提 issue 耗时约 4 分 34 秒，经历 23 次模型往返、32 次工具调用（bash 20 次），创建 issue 后仍有约 2 分钟收尾。

### Detailed Environment Information Description
- App 版本：0.1.9（com.jiuwen.digitalmate）
- 系统：鸿蒙 7.0（HarmonyOS 7.0）
- 平台：鸿蒙手机（HarmonyOS 7.0）
- 网络：正常（可联网检索、可正常调用 GitHub 接口创建 issue）
- 时区：Asia/Shanghai（北京时间，UTC+8）
- 场景：对 #1056（盯乐队 / 历史会话关联）提 issue 全过程的耗时统计

### Additional Information

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

#1192 新增的 Composio 接收库在启用或核对 SQLite 回滚日志模式时，通过局部变量向 `db.execute` 传入两条固定的 PRAGMA 之一。源文件进入可信过渡登记后，现有 Session Store 域扫描对这个调用报告 AR03 `<dynamic SQL>`。三项现有架构测试的正向基线因此失败。

在精确 Git 提交的干净源码根目录执行。

```sh
python3.13 -I -S -B - <<'PYTHON'
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
sys.path[:0] = [str(root), str(root / "tests/architecture"), str(root / "tools/architecture")]
suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName("test_domains")
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
raise SystemExit(not result.wasSuccessful())
PYTHON
```

预期原 35 项通过，合法 Composio 自有 SQLite 无 AR03，原未知/越界写入拒绝继续生效。实测 32 项通过、3 项失败，exit 1。三项失败均呈现同一条扫描记录。

```text
FAIL: test_real_schema_owner_and_existing_public_manager_pass
FAIL: test_sql_values_and_comments_do_not_invent_writers
FAIL: test_unrelated_sqlite_table_is_not_banned
AR03 <dynamic SQL>
temp/composio-mail/src/dm_composio_mail/receiving/handoff.py:48
Ran 35 tests
FAILED (failures=3)
```

使用同一源码的 `transition.admit_features` 与 `domains.scan` 复验也只出现这一新增发现。未组合注册表的 Domains CLI 在三次基线均因原 `chat_context.py` 缺登记先退出 2，另由 #1285 跟踪。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

macOS arm64，CPython 3.13.13，SQLite 3.50.4。精确 Git 源码对象导出，仅标准库和自有临时目录，原测试与实际已登记策略。设备、真实邮箱、部署及隔离 Linux 全量未运行。

### Additional Information

Composio receiver/handoff 是自有写入面。其 `initialize` 决定执行 `PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE` 或只读 `PRAGMA journal_mode`，不存在外来 SQL 值。按两个固定调用表达清楚现行意图，保留原文件范围和 owner、初始化/重开、DELETE/FULL、失配拒绝及全部架构检查。关联 #767、#1192 和 #1279。

### Version Information

实际 main `4b83ad09f2e7c69d282bf1037d46252b0679b537`，tree `6b12c579ed1004d9a52989b360ee4c88ef01148d`。#1192 合入 `31fca63d5469d6d571d6830c5ff454830d27d151` 同样三项失败。其父 `c26c27fa206907542f4cd6e506833e92aab863f5` 35/35 通过，扫描为 95 checked/245 legacy/0 findings。后两提交为 116 checked/245 legacy/1 finding。

### Screenshots / Recordings

![三处精确主线源码的 Domains 和同一原选集实跑记录](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/ba9509c06b419f2be474c96f501e12ecaa4d39e7/main-4b83-composio-store-domain.png?raw=true)

#### Final objectives, acceptance criteria and benefit reporting (confirmed 2026-11-09)

**Overall objective:** Preserve supported functionality, client compatibility and data semantics while migrating the server to components with clear responsibilities, a single writer for each authoritative state domain, and collaboration through public contracts. Complete source-directory and documentation-governance convergence, make common feature changes and component substitutions local in scope, and demonstrate through actual execution that critical paths have no significant performance regression.

This section consolidates maintainer-confirmed final deliverables and reporting requirements for this master tracker and Q11 #828. **Accepted requirements do not establish completed implementation or verification.** The existing frozen baselines, supported scope, contracts, client acceptance and stricter gates below remain binding. This section authorizes no new product semantics, relaxes no existing gate, reopens no accepted task, and does not accumulate all final acceptance under a single foundation component such as A02. Each child task closes against its original, explicit deliverable boundary; its owning task retains any outstanding final integration obligation, summarized here.

**1. Required deliverables and evidence-based acceptance**

| Objective | Observable acceptance criteria | Primary evidence and ownership |
|---|---|---|
| Clear component responsibilities and dependency boundaries, independently verifiable and replaceable through contracts | Components in migration scope have named owners, public interfaces and declared acyclic dependencies. Each authoritative state domain has one writer. Cross-component calls use public proxies, without accessing another component's private objects or authoritative tables. The actual default production entry reaches the new owner; migrated capabilities have no duplicate authority, silent legacy-executor fallback or reconnectable bypass. Representative implementation substitutions use established extension interfaces without modifying callers' internal logic. Independent deployment of every component and zero dependencies are not required. | Ownership/interface inventory, real call and write traces, boundary counterexamples, substitution and component tests; existing architecture, component and G05/G10 gates apply. Transitional legacy deviations still require an owner, cleanup task and bounded exit condition; they do not establish final migration completion. |
| Remove duplicate responsibilities and retired execution paths; converge the source layout | Every affected old path has an explicit migrate, retain or retire disposition. Server layout converges on the accepted architecture-foundation target while preserving unrelated `digitalmate/` client code, business code and dependencies with pinned provenance. Entry points, builds, imports, tests and deployment use the correct paths. Deletions require reference, call-path and functional evidence. Do not remove functionality to meet a line-count target or mechanically copy an entire branch. | D01 #845 path dispositions, entry mapping, clean installation/build and execution verification; code measurements are reported separately under the rules below. |
| Bounded impact and verification cost for common changes | Compare 3–5 representative changes before and after migration, such as model/tool adaptation, implementation substitution and an internal component-rule change. Internal changes stay with their owner; adapter changes use the adapter and necessary registration without modifying unrelated core code. Genuine shared-contract changes still require owner coordination; there is no promise that every request changes only one component. Developers can locate owners, contracts, entries and verification commands from documentation. | For each case, record baseline/candidate implementations or a reproducible change exercise, affected components/owners/files, unrelated core changes, verification environment/steps/time and component-level testability. Directory counts alone do not establish development efficiency. |
| Preserve functionality, client compatibility and data semantics | Retain the original frozen-baseline, supported configuration/API, full default Harness and unchanged-HAP A/B acceptance obligations, including files/artifacts, history, answer/retry/continue/cancel and the other established capabilities. Preserve persisted records and identities. Simplified probes, fake owners and component tests cannot replace actual client acceptance. | Existing Q04–Q10, capability matrix, identical HAP/driver/assertions, real production participants and deployment evidence; retain original failures and disposition differences individually. |
| Explainable and traceable failure, cancellation and recovery behavior | Verify duplicate requests, lost post-commit receipts, concurrency, Stop and unknown-outcome handling under existing contracts. Execution authority cannot resume after Stop. Correlate requests with M/S/R, attempts/actual implementations, commits and outcomes to identify the responsible component. Prove only the accepted recovery and bounded history-retention scope, without extending it to automatic continuation after arbitrary crashes. | Normal and fault evidence through real owners/persistence, Q03 tracing, existing lifecycle/Store contracts and negative cases; identify controlled substitutes and their scope. |
| Reproducible delivery and authoritative contributor guidance | Trace source, dependencies, build configuration, images and actual installed/runtime identities; verify clean deployment and existing rollback boundaries. AGENTS.md contains stable principles and protocol entry points while retaining effective constraints. Documentation establishes authoritative sources, navigation, old-document dispositions and repaired links under `protocols/specs/adr/procedures/lessons/verification/updates`, distinguishing proposed, accepted, implemented and verified status. | Existing build/deployment and G05 verification, D02 #847, D03 #848 and D01 final reference reconciliation; historical evidence proves only its named revision and scope. |
| No significant critical-path performance regression | Measure server overhead under comparable environments and workloads, reporting actual end-to-end behavior separately. Meet existing stricter service objectives and deadlines. Freeze baselines, measurement methods and tolerances before the final comparison; do not infer performance from architecture or widen thresholds after observing failures. | Comparative report under the performance rules below, included in Q11's final verdict; no unmeasured claim of “no regression.” |

**2. Required factual benefit reporting, without promised improvement percentages**

- **Code reduction:** Fix start/end SHAs and the first-party production-code counting scope. Separately report (1) evidenced removal of duplicate, unreachable or retired code, (2) added contract, adapter and reliability code, and (3) net production-code change. Report changes outside the first two categories separately so totals reconcile. Moves, copying followed by deletion, and formatting-only changes do not count as deduplication benefits. Count tests, documentation, generated code and third-party code with pinned provenance separately. Supply the counting tool, configuration, exclusions and representative deletion evidence. No reduction of N lines or N% is promised; a net increase does not automatically fail acceptance.
- **Development cost:** For the representative cases above, report change impact, environment preparation, required verification steps and elapsed time. Distinguish human work, tool waiting and test execution, and state sample limitations. Do not directly translate agent concurrency, model differences or one exercise into developer-productivity gains. Report measured improvement, no improvement or trade-offs without promising a productivity percentage.
- **Performance:** Keep hardware/resource limits, data volume, concurrency, workload and warm-up strategy comparable for server measurements. Use fixed model/tool responses to isolate external variability. Cover applicable queuing/submission, history reads, cancellation acknowledgement and execution-scheduling overhead. Report p50/p95, applicable throughput under fixed-load and saturation conditions, peak memory, and success/error/timeout rates so dropped work cannot appear as a speed gain. Separately report real end-to-end time using the same client and scenarios, explicitly identifying model/network and other external effects instead of combining the two into one conclusion. Record sample counts, repetitions, variability, commands and raw results.
- **Performance tolerances for baseline calibration only:** Evaluation may start from “p95 latency and peak memory increase by no more than 10% relative to baseline; throughput remains at least 95% of baseline.” These are **candidate tolerances, not active gates, passing results or exemptions from existing stricter objectives**. First measure baseline noise and applicable service objectives. The responsible owner then specifies absolute deadlines, applicable metrics and final thresholds, freezes them, and runs the candidate comparison. Record and disposition every unmet condition. Test-scanning/CI speed improvements count only toward verification cost, not product runtime performance.

**3. Consistent acceptance and progress reporting**

1. Trace every conclusion through “requirement/objective → owner and task → exact baseline/candidate SHA → actual entry and participants → commands, environment, results and evidence → outstanding work/blocker and next responsible owner.” Label evidence as source, component, integration, deployment or unchanged-HAP scope; these scopes are not interchangeable. Retain initial failures and subsequent runs without overwriting history.
2. Keep `proposed / accepted / implemented / verified` distinct, and keep execution outcomes `PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT_RUN / INVALID` distinct. Completed documentation, a merged PR, increased test counts, reachable infrastructure or a successfully built image does not automatically establish production migration or client acceptance.
3. Close child tasks against their original acceptance criteria and backfill post-merge evidence, residual work and downstream dependencies. Do not expand a foundation package merely to close the master tracker. Report overall task counts, source integration, deployment and client acceptance separately. Without new formally tracked tasks, this section changes no denominator and manufactures no completion count.
4. The final #737 / Q11 #828 report consolidates the required deliverables, measured benefits and unresolved differences above. No minimum positive reduction in net code, development effort or additional runtime cost is promised, but the corresponding measurements and reproducible reports are required. Outstanding unrun, invalid or blocked mandatory acceptance prevents an unconditional refactor-completion claim. Existing difference-disposition and authorization rules continue to apply; retain visible limitations and their scope.

### Proposed Solution

**Architecture:** Message/Session/Run are core identities. Router selects Session and execution path; Session Manager owns admission/recovery; SQLite Store owns authoritative DM records; backend owns execution coordination/controls/final publication; Harness owns loop policy; Runtime owns same-process Python assembly/readiness/lifecycle. Every parent/child/summary/compression/vision/skill model/tool/context effect follows HostAPI. Public proxies mediate cross-component operations. Exact Registry factories bind sessions; replacement works without installed default Core. Room is a compatibility projection. Artifact bytes survive execution workspace release. Gateways dispatch/normalize evidence, host hooks own application policy, BudgetProvider alone owns balances, Store owns attempt/turn accounting. Stop permanently closes execution authority; late accounting cannot reopen it or change terminal outcome.

**Main reuse strategy:** retain the pinned normal DeepAgent/task-loop/ReAct algorithms, prompt attachment logic, default general-purpose children and six controls, six office skills, pure file/image/office validation and provider business leaves. Both ordinary/simple main modes currently select `agent.work.normal`; do not mistake simple heuristics for a current model-only path. Team is off by default but supported explicit configuration must have a migration path. Rehome model/tool dispatch, SDK checkpoint/history, child persistence, compaction inference, vision reads and skill process I/O to their host/provider owners. Do not retain WorkSwarm supervisor, Session DB, EngineService or DeepAdapter global bootstrap as a second execution authority. Existing UI and wire consumers remain the comparison target.

**Authority decision status:** A19's bounded checkpoint/history/Stop decision is COMPLETED at actual main `bc441941` / tree `1a2e7a08` ([acceptance](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/740#issuecomment-6717030859)). Original human bounded-Stop approval remains separately attributed from coordinating acceptance under standing user authorization after independent assistant review of the supported codec/state/content, process-reopen storage, explicit capacity/settings and constrained recovery matrix. Concrete version/types/vectors/numeric settings and actual fault/runtime proof are A30 pre-enable work, not unresolved A19 policy decisions. Its target remains NOT_IMPLEMENTED/NOT_VERIFIED and runtime NOT_RUN. A20 still defines same-S binding, cancelled-input context visibility and supplement consume/Stop/final ordering. R2 automatic fallback remains proposed. Candidate #723 fresh B/R_B is not supplement M_B→R_A. Routing greeting/capacity differences need paired main behavior disposition. No test fixture chooses these product semantics by default. Within accepted boundaries, proposed paths/AST checks/explicit reply designation and main-based integration are planning choices documented with rationale.

**Migration and rollback risks:** old binaries can ignore new selection restrictions; compatibility checks and old-writer quiescence must run before alias/traffic activation. Preserve versioned readers, bound providers, pending controls and unsettled accounting on downgrade. Unknown outcomes never cause automatic legacy fallback/replay. Reuse actual ADX grants/workspace/model-key routes and verify intended gVisor runtime; source configuration is not deployment proof. Target build must report actual Python 3.13.16 and Core 8f9f1126 module origins/overrides, not ambient SDK availability or a source overlay mislabeled as a new image.

[Acceptance](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/845#issuecomment-6706806927). [Acceptance](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/847#issuecomment-6702499741). |

### Test Verification

**Two independent release gates:**

1. **Architecture and production assembly:** AR01–AR10 static import/export/dependency/cycle/private-access/DB-domain/Harness-I/O/legacy-executor/install-origin rules plus legal and violating fixtures. Runtime ST from actual default public entry verifies Router→AS→HostAPI→Store, authenticated scope, exact versions/selection, Stop fences, physically Core-free replacement and dispatch exclusively at provider boundaries. Deliberate bypass mutants must fail. Real owners/SQLite are not replaced by fakes when asserting ownership.
2. **Frozen-main behavior:** same HAP hash, driver SHA, case/assertion versions and comparable data; only backend identity changes. Capture old/new source/image/build/configuration and run IDs. Each new pass traces phone M→new S/R→Host call→authoritative record. Official historical 7c build and alternative compilation evidence stay separate.

Retain PASS, FAIL, environment-BLOCKED and NOT-RUN separately; also preserve validator INVALID where applicable. Old failures are not hidden or waived by a new pass. Real-provider, component, phone and deployed-image results have distinct scope. Every batch reruns impacted cross-component tests on the integrated head. Independent QA does not approve its own implementation.

**Early counterexample gates:** #712 before-admission metadata validation and known pre-execution failure classification are independently corrected candidate findings, still require main regression. #723 is bounded same-S feasibility only. Real pre-R authentication scope/BGE attempts, physical retry identity, null/missing versus zero, true pre-completion reply deltas, atomic budget reserve/settle, unknown liability, post-Stop settlement and production outcome/accounting inspect all receive explicit tasks. TEST-ONLY writers, parent-only proxy injection and minimal Core examples cannot satisfy these gates.

**CI reuse and enforcement:** retain Node/Hypium/ArkTS and existing `pr-ready`; reuse credential-free server regression selection and case assertions. New Python architecture/server suites are not already covered by them. Missing/skipped/cancelled/zero-case mandatory suites fail the new aggregate. Trusted base owns policy/scanner configuration; rule changes require trusted review and candidate self-tests. Historical survey access reported branch protection disabled, CODEOWNERS absent and ruleset reads403; these are frozen planning observations, not current administration proof. The latest [G09 acceptance readback](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/745#issuecomment-6709027699) records branch-protection access404/unavailable, which does not establish that no rules exist. G10 still requires administrator activation/readback and a negative merge test before enforcement may be claimed.

**Evidence-pending / not separately published:** no new main Bug/UX finding has sufficient standalone reproduced visual evidence in this survey. Existing bugs remain linked. Candidate-only gaps are migration regression requirements, not relabeled main incidents. Any later main defect without screenshot/recording remains in this register until the Bug template can be satisfied; nothing is silently deleted.

**Definition of done:** closing every child is necessary but insufficient. Independent full architecture/production-assembly verdict, complete frozen-main comparison with accepted dispositions, supported conditional paths, pinned build provenance and compatibility/rollback/old-writer checks must pass. No code implementation, feature parity or deployment is claimed by publishing this plan.

<!-- DM31:GOVERNANCE-FINAL-ACCEPTANCE -->

**Final governance acceptance** also requires actual directory convergence with exhaustive source disposition and no stale supported entry/import/build/deploy/test references; merged stable AGENTS guidance with the original mandatory repository rules preserved; and substantive documentation authority/navigation, complete original-file disposition, repaired moved links, and status/evidence consistent with actual main. D02/D03 initial developer guidance proceeds now. Final D01 runtime and D03 affected-reference reconciliation remain tracked until verified. These requirements are native blockers on Q11 and retain all production/behavior gates above.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem
在**没有主动发起任何任务、也没有进行任何操作**的情况下，免费积分被持续消耗直至几乎耗尽（设置页显示“免费积分 0.4 / 30”，剩余/总数）。同期对话中反复出现“回复失败 / 本轮任务执行失败，暂时无法确认具体原因。请先检查已完成的工作，再决定是否重试；如持续出现，请联系服务管理员。”，既看不到失败原因，也无法判断积分因何被扣。

复现步骤：
1. 正常登录 App（账号与安全页：云端连接“已连接”、任务提醒“已开启”、已绑定手机号，版本 0.1.9）。
2. 不主动发起任何任务或对话，静置一段时间。
3. 期间界面弹出“任务执行失败 / 回复失败”。
4. 进入 设置 → 免费积分，发现剩余积分明显减少甚至耗尽（0.4 / 30）。

期望行为：
- 未发起任何任务时不应产生积分消耗；
- 任务失败或重试不应重复扣费，失败任务应退还积分；
- 提供积分消耗明细（时间、关联任务、扣费原因），可逐笔核对。

实际行为：无操作情况下积分被扣至 0.4 / 30，同时伴随多条“回复失败/任务执行失败”。

### Detailed Environment Information Description
- 客户端：DigitalMate 移动端 App（包名 com.jiuwen.digitalmate，截图为该 App 界面）
- App 版本：0.1.9
- 账号：hlsuustc
- 免费积分：0.4 / 30（剩余 / 总数）
- 云端连接：已连接；任务提醒：已开启；已绑定手机号
- 操作系统/版本：HarmonyOS（鸿蒙）
- 网络 / 模型服务配置：待补充

### Additional Information
对话中出现一条提示，提到 #951、#952、#953 很可能来自同一次后端重启/连接重置，建议合并排查。怀疑本问题与“后端重启或长任务失败后仍在后台重试/空转，导致积分被持续扣除”有关。建议重点排查“任务失败、连接断开或空转时是否仍在计费/重试扣费”的计费逻辑。

### Version Information
App 版本：0.1.9；系统版本：HarmonyOS（鸿蒙）；模型服务版本：待补充

## 🚀 Background Description

在 DigitalMate（应用标识 com.jiuwen.digitalmate）内「添加图片」时，选择来源的弹窗只有「最近 / 浏览」两种文件来源（顶部另有「搜索文件」），没有「拍照 / 相机」入口。用户无法直接调用相机拍摄新照片后发送，只能从已有的截图、相册或文件里挑选。

拍照上传属于基础能力：缺失时用户需要先退出对话、打开系统相机拍好、再回到「最近」里翻找刚拍的照片，链路长、体验割裂。希望补充拍照入口，并在需要时申请系统相机权限。

相关：附件上传与删除交互优化 #1347。

## Design Ideas

- 在图片选择弹窗（当前「最近 / 浏览」页签旁或底部操作区）新增「拍照」来源，点击直接进入相机预览并拍摄；拍完的照片作为待上传图片加入列表。
- 相机权限独立于相册/文件访问权限，按系统规范在首次点击「拍照」时申请；若被拒绝，给出明确提示，并保留「从相册/文件选择」的原路径。
- 与 #1347 的批量上传 + 删除交互保持一致：拍照得到的图片同样先进入「已添加」列表，再统一上传；删除遵循「立即移除 + 可撤销」。

## Involved Public APIs

涉及客户端（Client/Shell）图片选择组件新增「相机」来源、相机权限申请与拍摄结果回调；不涉及服务端公开 API 变更（以实际实现为准）。

## Description of Relevance to Other Modules

与附件上传/删除交互（#1347）、图片预览与压缩、系统权限管理相关；拍照产物应与相册选择产物走同一上传链路与状态机。

## Test Design and Test Plan

- 冷启动后首次点击「拍照」：正确弹出相机权限申请；允许后进入相机；拒绝后有提示，且仍可从相册/文件选择。
- 拍照后照片进入「已添加」列表，可统一上传、可删除、可撤销。
- 已有相机权限时直接进入相机，不重复弹窗。
- 权限被系统永久拒绝时，给出前往设置的引导。
- 不同系统（Android / iOS）下权限申请与相机调用表现一致。

## Additional Information

- 环境：Android 客户端，应用 com.jiuwen.digitalmate；截图时间 2026-11-14 11:58。
- 截图：图片来源弹窗只有「最近 / 浏览」两个来源，无「拍照」入口。

![camera-option-picker.jpg](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-screenshots/issue-assets/camera-option-picker.jpg?raw=true)

### 🚀 Background Description

<!-- DM31:Q10 -->

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-Q10`.

**Outcome:** Every frozen current-main case has actual A/B evidence or explicit blocking disposition; combinations use latest integrated head.

**Owner:** Independent QA coordinator. **Batch:** P4: independent integration and cutover evidence. **Size:** 1 working day; existing leaves reused, prerequisites excluded.

**Not responsible for:**
- Do not promise all 36 executions fit in one day
- Do not recreate existing #571/#565/#500 work

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** Produce the stated contract, inventory, checker or independent evidence artifact using `tests/e2e/workflow/ACCEPTANCE.md::Registration and consecutive stability` as the concrete source. Preserve the accepted owner and scope; this preparation/verification task does not claim code migration.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** tests/e2e/results/v31-migration/coverage.json; tests/e2e/results/v31-migration/combinations.json (planned artifacts; retain existing shared drivers/assertions)

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [tests/e2e/workflow/ACCEPTANCE.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/tests/e2e/workflow/ACCEPTANCE.md) — `Registration and consecutive stability`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [tests/e2e/workflow/stability.mjs](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/tests/e2e/workflow/stability.mjs) — `stability gate`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [tests/cases/case-catalog.yaml](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/tests/cases/case-catalog.yaml) — `case catalog`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- All case versions and original stability/lane requirements

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Disabled-by-default cases omitted from full-parity claims
- Historical reports counted as latest-main passes

**Writable boundary:**
- tests/e2e/results/v31-migration/coverage.json
- tests/e2e/results/v31-migration/combinations.json

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-Q06](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/823), [DM31-Q07](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/824), [DM31-Q08](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/825), [DM31-Q09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/826), [DM31-G11](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/747), [DM31-M25](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/821), [DM31-A25](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/820)

**Blocks:** [DM31-Q11](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/828)

**May proceed in parallel:** Disjoint owner modules and fixture preparation once their public contracts exist; no concurrent edit to this task’s writable files.

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Account for all 36 frozen cases plus migration-specific cases
- Run any remaining cases through existing QA work owners with dedicated resources before closure
- E4/E5/E6 original consecutive stability gates remain intact
- Rerun affected pairs when main/integration head changes
- Baseline failures versus new regressions separately owned; no silent exemption
- Run source-mapped API/configuration contract fixtures for all registered action families, including M31–M47 and opt-in team. Dormant/rejected/testing-only actions retain their evidenced disposition; every action row points to a migration issue and explicit acceptance result.

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Checks:** - Existing catalog/provenance/stability validators
- Integrated combinations selected in G11 with fresh exact-head evidence

**Participants:** Independent QA, same frozen HAP and original driver/assertions; actual old/new backend builds. Controlled input/fault fixture is named per case; it cannot replace actual phone or new production owner. Exclusive resource lease needed for execution.

**Evidence:** A/B backend identity and M/S/R/Host/Store trace; PASS/FAIL/environment-BLOCKED/NOT-RUN separately; retain baseline failures.

**Commands (existing exact-case pair flow):**

```sh
node tests/e2e/workflow/migration/run-ab.mjs --plan /absolute/path/pair.json
node tests/e2e/workflow/migration/run-ab.mjs --execute /absolute/path/pair.json --side A
# Verify A recovery/release and the separately leased B route before B.
node tests/e2e/workflow/migration/run-ab.mjs --execute /absolute/path/pair.json --side B
```

The [existing pair procedure](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/c19f1370542946bd67f87ded6ff010c1a3607afd/docs/procedures/migration-ab.md) selects one exact current `caseFile` per operator-owned private pair plan; there is no `--group complete-corpus` selector. These plans are execution inputs under Q04's existing resource/recovery contract, not additional committed Q10 source files or permission to modify the wrapper. Q04's operator and Q10's independent QA coordinator must record the selected current-main A and latest integrated B heads, re-freeze/check the actual manifest and paired HAP/driver/assertion/calibration/build/backend identities, and obtain the actual grants before execution. Historical source pins above remain provenance, not substitutes for the selected pair freeze. Q10 still reconciles all 36 current workflows, disabled/supplemental cases, migration-specific cases, registered API/configuration families and integrated combinations through their existing owners. Original lane and applicable E4/E5/E6 same-version/same-build/same-condition two-consecutive-complete-pass requirements remain intact; pending tooling work or a focused smoke does not supply a full-group PASS.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** remaining-corpus-execution-evidence, release-dedicated-resources, current-integrated-head. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** AR08, AR09, AR10.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).


<!-- DM31:CURRENT-MAIN-E5E6:76728bca -->
**Required current-main re-freeze delta (not migration A/B evidence):** main `76728bca7e00cd571589e4b8c3111d7c5a5003c2` incorporates [E5 #713](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/713), merge76728bca, and [E6 #714](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/714), mergee2d8f9d3, after the Q02 offline tool freeze. Re-freeze the actual selected current A before Q04/Q10 execution; preserve the old frozen manifest/tool-source receipts as historical evidence. Pin and review the changed `case-catalog.yaml`, `case-versions.json`, COLDSTART-01 v3 workflow/calibration, `run-workflow.mjs`, provenance/lifecycle/UI assertions and evidence helpers, migration-manifest tests, release-install/privacy fixtures and E5/E6 guides. Hash actual case/driver/assertion/calibration/HAP/build/install/backend identities and keep the same applicable bytes on both sides; do not weaken the old immutable baseline or silently substitute cases.

Carry original results with their scope: [E5 source record](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/76728bca7e00cd571589e4b8c3111d7c5a5003c2/tests/e2e/results/e5-565-20261106/README.md) has five local passes and **SILENCE-01/TIMEOUT-01 FAIL** on emulator App0.1.0/build10008 with isolated Bridge/WorkSwarm and scripted model faults; remote cloud/model versions and repeat stability are unverified. SILENCE-01 terminal failure loses the previously displayed partial text; TIMEOUT-01 shows a generic failure instead of the expected timeout message, despite one native retry completing the original task. Preserve these failures/retests as baseline outcomes or explicit independently reviewed dispositions, not silent exemptions or migration regressions inferred without comparison.

[E6 source record](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/76728bca7e00cd571589e4b8c3111d7c5a5003c2/tests/e2e/results/e6-565-20261106/README.md) records one local API26 debug10007→10008 upgrade and one debug10008 consent/sign-in case as local passes. Release acceptance is separate: embedded HAP signing verification failed, the10026 release HAP was rejected at setup before installation/profiling, and a positive signed-release/AppGallery path plus full first-launch/device-session inventory remain unverified. These debug outcomes do not establish approved release HAP/install evidence. Actual migration paired execution, grants, release observations and Q03 traces remain NOT_RUN here; original Q04/Q10 dependencies and stability/independent-QA gates remain intact.
<!-- /DM31:CURRENT-MAIN-E5E6:76728bca -->


<!-- DM31:CURRENT-MAIN-E4:8384a698 -->
**Additional current-main re-freeze input — E4 [#670](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/670), merged `8384a698ae7ec2f588e5b806e2a23b783e9db967`:** review/pin its changed case catalog/version inventory, seven E4 case definitions and canonical calibrations, driver/runner/provenance/schema/setup, resource/file/UI/trajectory assertions and claim-review/scoring controls, fixtures and original receipts. Do not substitute retired calibration/version files or weaken the historical Q02 freeze. The later [#874](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/874), main `b2b4059d16daa267ba736f946bab0f348dad39ca`, changes the actual client `DigitalMateHome/Index.ets`; record the selected current client/build/HAP identity too. Actual A/B must freeze the later selected A, affected driver/assertion/calibration/HAP/install/backend inputs and applicable inventory, not treat these historical sources as an already executed pair.

[E4 source outcomes](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/8384a698ae7ec2f588e5b806e2a23b783e9db967/tests/e2e/results/e4-565-20261106/README.md) are scoped to API23 emulator debug0.1.0/build10008; cloud/model versions unknown and repeat stability unmeasured. Five cases passed locally. Keep **PERM-01 FAIL**: the earlier native revocation was rejected before task creation with a generic retry; later isolated MCP denial/restoration does not verify provider UI or the ordinary WorkSwarm path. Keep **REMINDER-01 local E2E PASS versus deployment/system-alarm BLOCKED** (deployed scheduler HTTP401, alarm declined/inventory unavailable). Retain **earlier deployed FILE-02 FAIL** (FIRST retained/separate final copy) separately from the isolated scripted-model writer/delivery-reader local PASS. FILEDELETE's local linked gateway-recovery passes do not clear its earlier whole-device-network BLOCKED trial where the endpoint remained reachable. Other local delivery/export/room-guard results retain their exact fixture/build/source scope. Preserve original failures/blocked evidence or explicit owner dispositions, never infer migration regression/pass from unmatched configurations. Q04/Q10 migration execution and original independent/stability gates remain NOT_RUN/unfulfilled.

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

#1337 的 ReportStore 在读取自有 SQLite `report_mail` 时拼接一个固定过滤片段，已登记过渡源码进入 Session Store 域扫描后，该调用被标记为 AR03 动态 SQL。原 scope/goal 使用绑定参数，`pending` 只决定是否追加 `processed=0`。

在下方精确 Git 提交的源码根目录，执行原可信入口的过渡注册合成及原 Domains 扫描。

```sh
python3.13 -I -S -B - <<'PY'
import sys
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "tools/architecture"))
import domains, manifest, transition
policy = manifest.load_policy(root / "docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json")
effective, _ = transition.admit_features(root, policy)
report = domains.scan(root, effective, "session-store-schema")
for result in report["findings"]:
    print(result["rule"], result["path"], result["line"], result["target"])
raise SystemExit(bool(report["findings"]))
PY
```

预期原合法的 report 私有查询通过，原不透明写入的拒绝保留。上一主线合成查 116 项、1 finding（既有 #1357）。实际查 124 项、2 findings，额外产生：

```text
AR03 temp/report-goals/src/dm_report_goals/store.py 152 <dynamic SQL>
```

原 `DomainWriterTests.test_real_schema_owner_and_existing_public_manager_pass` 也报告被查进程 exit 1。与既有 Composio 控制分列后，当前私有接收树只余 ReportStore 这条诊断。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

macOS arm64，CPython 3.13.13，精确 Git 导出、私有临时目录、标准库。无真实邮件、PPT、设备、生产或隔离全量。

### Additional Information

仅把两个原 SQL 读取分支以确定的字面调用表达，保留相同排序、scope、bind、原筛选、事务和自有 writer。继续使用原域扫描和全部断言。关联 #1337、#1376、#1279；#1357 是已有 Composio 独立结果。

### Version Information

实际 main `00910be5f914c40ef9239dc56ddbb6bf520e7cc8`，tree `01b4c4bbf2abaef138d040d32594140f5bcb1fd7`。上一实际主线 `4b83ad09f2e7c69d282bf1037d46252b0679b537`。

### Screenshots / Recordings

![原域检查实际前后和真实测试终态](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/39bbcf3cda0dcb3f233ea3a06b35342229969440/report-goals-ar03.png?raw=true)

## 现象

UI 悬浮层级叠放错乱：多个浮层压在同一位置，导致文字重叠、按钮被遮挡。

从截图看，具体有两处叠层冲突：

1. **通知气泡盖住正文**：顶部“soou 想问你 / Beebou 有事项等你处理”的提示条，直接叠在“查苏州洲际酒店…需要先确定入住日期。已知信息：卫生级，Booking 评分 9.2（109 条评价）、Trip.com 评分 9.7（12439 条）…”这段问题正文之上，两段文字互相穿插，正文已经读不成句。
2. **悬浮按钮压住发送键**：那个圆形向下箭头浮在灰色“发送回答”按钮正中，把主操作按钮挡了一半。

## 原因推测

属于前端 **z-index / 绝对定位的层级或避让计算错误**：悬浮通知、滚动到底部按钮的定位没有避开内容区和底部操作栏，也可能是软键盘弹出后没有重新布局，导致浮层按旧坐标叠了上去。

## 影响

正文不可读、主按钮被挡难以点击，影响正常阅读与提交回答。

## 复现

见所附截图（两处叠层冲突）。



## 环境
- 系统：HarmonyOS 7.0（鸿蒙 7.0）
- 设备：手机端

### 🚀 Background Description

父 RFC #1228。Hive 集成协调、Packaging 和 QA owner。为 Bee/B1 与 Store 首批成果及双 Harness 完整链路建立两次可复现验收。

### Design Ideas

从已记录 main 生成集成分支（HIVE1 为 `hive/hive1-integration`），固定各 PR/提交组合并在其上验收。检查 temp 过渡自登记和实际 wheel 来源；核对现有 #1264 与可信基线的差集、现有 package-proof 修复候选。关口通过后由集成分支经单个 PR 以 merge commit 整批合入 main（HIVE1 为 [#1336](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1336)）。阶段证据分别归到参与工包。

[Hive 开工设计稿](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228#issuecomment-6852742965) · [H-C8 和 H-T9 评审版](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228#issuecomment-6854412462) · [自然快回与平滑升级修订](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228#issuecomment-6852965471)

### Involved Public APIs

第一阶段核对真实 BotDirectory、Session Manager / SQLite、激活与绑定以及同 ID 回执。WorkSwarm 可使用时走实际启动与派单。若相应接口尚未接好，用明确标记的受控执行者验证 Store/B1 接缝。第二阶段从实际入口执行 Home 直答和 Beebou → Bee → 终态 → 用户，并保留消息、绑定、执行/通知身份。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

按 #1268 与 Store 工包完成首阶段。完整阶段加入 Runtime、Beebou、#1226 和相关客户端。#1295/#1296/#1297 独立交付并随完整验收对齐自己的实际 gate。

### Test Design and Test Plan

固定 base/head、参与者、临时数据库、wheel、命令和结果。第一阶段至少覆盖重复受理、跨用户旧代次拒绝、slot 竞争、steer 下一 step、FIFO、并发抢占及问答。第二阶段重跑实际双 Harness、断线/回执、历史可用，并在真实模型和 HAP 留独立证据。

验收记录必须包含 base/head、实际入口、真实与替代参与方、命令、退出状态及未运行项。接口和持久契约按对应 owner 评审记录。


**开发期 Scenario 交付与实际运行。** 按 [#1316 的 Scenario 矩阵](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1316)（「开发同步交付端到端 Scenario」一节） 从第一版候选接收 HIVE-SC-01–06。每个 Phase / Step 用实际入口跑对应段，组合验收时按固定 SHA 重跑完整路径，合入后复跑受影响用例。按 ID 和断言记录真实参与者、替身、缺失证据或未运行原因。场景 owner 和 #1314 将同一批已可执行的用例接入对应 Nightly suite，交选择参数、实际运行链接和逐用例报告。

#### 断言登记（各工包首版 PR 交付，#1314 汇总执行）

断言 ID 在所属工包正文定义，开发期、组合验收和 Nightly 共用。场景说明见 #1316 的 Scenario 矩阵和入库的 [HIVE-SC-01–06](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e804ef48b5cfd3b2b1882e5b8ec538e8d7dd42e0/docs/scenarios/server-hive-delivery-v3.1.md)（`e804ef48`，[openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate#1324](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1324)）。

| Scenario | 关口 | 断言 ID（定义处） | 组合所需的真实参与方 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| HIVE-SC-01 定向受理与 Bee 复活 | G1 | SC01-W1–W7（[#1268](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1268)）、SC01-S1–S4（[#1311](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1311)）、SC01-D1–D2（[#1223](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1223)） | BotDirectory / Bot Repository、Session Manager / SQLite、安装包；WorkSwarm 未接通时就绪见证用受控执行者并标注 |
| HIVE-SC-02 忙时控制与问题答复 | G1 Store 段，G3 执行段，G5 客户端段 | SC02-S1–S6（#1311）、SC02-R1–R3（[#1309](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1309)）、SC02-B1（[#1310](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1310)）、客户端断言（[#1243](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1243)） | G1 只证明 Store 接缝；G3 需真实 Host/Harness；G5 需真实 Gateway/HAP |
| HIVE-SC-03 双 Harness 与用户终态 | G3 | SC03-R1–R3（#1309）、SC03-B1–B8（#1310）、SC03-D1–D2（#1223） | 候选 wheel/CLI、Registry/Backend、两种实际 Harness、Manager/Store；模型与天气等外部工具可受控 |
| HIVE-SC-04 客户端、产物与真实评估 | G5 | [#1242](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1242)、#1243、[#1244](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1244) 正文 | 实际 HAP、真实下载、真实 Beebou/Host 轨迹 |
| HIVE-SC-05 旧库与记忆升级 | G5 | SC05-M1–M5（[#1312](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1312)） | 旧库副本、History/Store、Memory provider |
| HIVE-SC-06 切流与旧 Router 退场 | G6 | SC06-C1–C5（[#1313](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1313)） | 退场候选安装包与配置、真实入口调用计数 |

#### 组合与阻塞

| 批次 | 固定组合 | 当前阻塞 | 决定人 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| HIVE1（G1/G2） | #1268 + #1311 候选，按需加 #1226 `a28d1a99` 与打包候选 | 两个候选尚未提交；现行自登记未完成（#1226 缺 `temp/beebou/ownership.json`）；Bridge 安装证明单独跟踪 #1323，按实际通过范围记录。#1264 为独立门禁提案 | architecture-gate owner、Packaging owner |
| HIVE2（G3/G4） | HIVE1 合入后的 main + #1309 + #1310 + #1226 | 双 Harness 装配与 Host grant 未实现 | Runtime/Host、Beebou Harness owner（均未具名） |

#### 已复核的基线（2026-11-13）

- `main@b67218b3` 源码导出运行 `node tests/e2e/workflow/run-workflow.mjs --validate`：workflow 契约 31/31、daily 基线 1/1 通过。只校验定义，不执行设备。
- #1226 head `a28d1a99` 源码树，Python 3.12：`PYTHONPATH=temp/beebou/src python -m pytest temp/beebou/tests -q` 104 passed。Bot 目录与绑定为替身；非安装态 wheel 运行。
- 其余 WIP（#1295、#1296、#1297）的结果以各 PR 和 [#1228 并行轨道进度](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228#issuecomment-6847321919)为准，本次未复跑。HIVE-SC-01–06 全部 `NOT_RUN`。

### Additional Information

开发 AI 每完成一个可验证步骤或遇到阻塞，请立即在 [开发进度 RFC #1316](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1316) 评论区按模板更新，并在本工包保留证据链接。设计和接口变更见 [设计 RFC #1228](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228)。

items.author: huben0423-hw
items.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Worker 方案二（2026-11-14 已决定）。** 活跃 Bee 可复用。驱逐结束该 Bee 的运行身份，旧 Profile 仅供 Beebou 生成新 Bee 时参考。新 Bee 使用新 `bee_id`、新 Session 和独立 Local Memory。历史任务、问题卡及回执仍归原 ID，旧 ID 不能再激活或接新单。本决定取代 [#1228 原先确认的 H-D2 原 ID 复活](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228#user-content-hive-decisions)。按 H-D2 跑过的[已有候选回执](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1314#issuecomment-6866097111)不能作为本决定的通过证据，SC01-W5 需按方案二重验。

关联 RFC #1228（HIVE-BOT），协作 Feature #1223，接收端草案 #1226。本 Issue 跟踪 Worker Bot 设计、模块交接和验收。下列 R1–R7 是本文的追踪编号。当前为设计评审，真实 writer、模型、设备与部署验收待执行。

## Worker 范围与上下游交接

Beebou 通过 Bot 工具查看 Session Manager 对外提供的 Bee Profile、在办任务摘要（tasks at hand summary）与当前状态。Profile 来自 BotDirectory，Session Manager 提供在办事实。存在合适的活跃 Bee 时复用其 ID 和当前 Session，补充原工作走 `steer + task_ref`。确认活跃候选均不合适时，Beebou 可参考同一授权范围内的旧 Profile，按本次需求生成新定义。Bot 模块校验、登记并返回新 ID。目录不可用或分页缺项时先核实。新 Bee 取得 slot 并确认就绪后才能派发。

每只活跃 Bee 有一个当前 DigitalMate Session。Worker 负责 Profile、B1 查询、输入装配、每只 Bee 的 WorkSwarm 执行隔离、问题卡续做、报告与记忆交接。Beebou 的选用与生成保留为上游流程，快回及主循环归其负责人。当前图与文档见[评审材料](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1268#issuecomment-6850823962)。

## RFC 要求如何落地

| 追踪项 | Bot 侧交付及协作方 | 验收观察点 |
|---|---|---|
| R1 构造与名册 | 提供活跃 Bee 的 Profile，配合 Session Manager 暴露在办摘要。已驱逐 Bee 的 Profile 仅供参考 | 活跃命中复用原 ID 和 Session。参考旧 Profile 新建时取得不同 ID，旧 ID 拒绝新派发，同一次创建重试返回同一新 ID。驱逐后身份已按方案二决定 |
| R2 绑定与运行能力 | B1 由接收端调用 `resolve(scope, bot_id)` 返回 `BotBinding`。Backend 消费 profile、Harness 和已验证的能力声明 | 新任务进入指定 Bee 的当前 Session，绑定过期不能首次提交 |
| R3 轮换与历史归属 | 接收端调用目录的 `owner_of_session(scope, session_ref)` 得到 `BotOwner`。旧 Session 仍可反查；Store writer 校验原提交、任务与版本 | 提交后丢 ACK 再试找回原任务；S1 换成 S3 后，T7 的 Q9 仍按原等待点处理 |
| R4 任务与上下文 | 派发带目标、约束、完成标准和可分享来源。每个任务按当前权限准备输入 | T8 的实际模型输入不含 T7 已撤权的来源，报告保留发送方 |
| R5 Bot 本地记忆 | Session Store 下的 Session Context、Local Memory 和 Global Memory 插件分层存取。驱逐时将获准片段交给共享层 | 跨 Bee、跨用户、重启与 Session 轮换后检查实际检索结果及模型输入 |
| R6 问答与 Inbox 知会 | 交互 owner 同事务提交原答复与 Beebou Inbox 知会引用。Main 在正常轮次读新增、持久提交后确认；仅知会不触发派单或 steer | Bee 凭 Q9 继续；重复答复只续做一次，Main 离线不阻塞 Bee |
| R7 真实接入与跟踪 | 在 `temp/beebou/src/dm_beebou/` 过渡区按 v3.1 owner 分区，用注入端口连接既有名册、writer 与执行适配器。P0/P1 可先开发，P3/P4 联调，P7 移除兼容适配 | 分别留真实 Main + Bee 派发、问答、故障重试和隔离轨迹；替身结果单独记录 |

## 关键模块时序

### 新任务受理（R1、R2、R3）

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant B as Beebou
    participant M as 接收端 Session Manager
    participant D as BotDirectory
    participant S as Session Store writer
    B->>M: 经 Bot 工具和 Delivery 派给 bee.report（M1）
    M->>S: 核对原投递回执
    alt 相同请求已经受理
        S-->>M: 原 task_ref
        M-->>B: 原回执
    else 首次受理
        M->>D: 校验 Bot 来源，查询 resolve(scope, bee.report)
        D-->>M: BotBinding（S1、r7、运行绑定）
        M->>S: 同事务复核 M1 与 r7，入队并记录回执
        S-->>M: T7 或绑定过期
        M-->>B: 成功时返回 T7
    end
```

绑定变化且尚未提交时，使用同一 M1 重新对账后解析。Backend 经统一 Harness 接口取得合法执行认领后驱动本 Bee 的隔离执行 Session。接收端及 writer 草案见 [#1226 Draft `a28d1a99` 的 receiving/service.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/a28d1a9939f71cb99fa2e4bad81f04dc439b3ac6/temp/beebou/src/dm_beebou/receiving/service.py) 和 [receiving/ports.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/a28d1a9939f71cb99fa2e4bad81f04dc439b3ac6/temp/beebou/src/dm_beebou/receiving/ports.py)，未合入、非生产接口。

### 历史归属与原问题答复（R3、R6）

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant B as 报表 Bee
    participant M as 接收端
    participant D as BotDirectory
    participant I as 交互模块
    participant S as Session Store writer
    participant U as 用户
    B->>M: 从 S1 的原执行报告 T7（当前绑定已是 S3）
    M->>S: 核对原投递回执
    M->>D: owner_of_session(scope, S1)
    D-->>M: BotOwner（bee.report、S1 等）
    M->>S: 经目标绑定校验任务和源执行，提交报告
    U->>I: 在 Q9 原问题卡上答复
    I->>S: 同事务保存 T7 的答复与 Inbox 知会引用
    S-->>I: 已提交
    I-->>B: 经执行适配恢复 T7 的原等待点
```

`owner_of_session` 校验 Bot 来源归属，不能单凭归属授权任务操作。用户答问题卡走可信交互引用，直接定位 Q9/T7。

## 生命周期、问答和三层记忆

1. **活跃池与容量。** 共 N 个 slot。容量范围内，已激活的 Bee（包括空闲 Bee）保持驻留。需求适合已有活跃 Bee 时直接复用。有空位时可启动新 Bee，即使其余 Bee 都在忙。只有新建且满槽时才驱逐空闲候选中最久未使用的一只。执行中、等待答复、有排队工作或未决执行效果的 Bee 受保护。满槽且无可驱逐对象时拒绝本次启动，返回 `CAPACITY_BUSY`，客户端据此弹窗提示用户稍等。
2. **驱逐后的身份（方案二，已决定）。** 关闭旧 Bee 的新受理，持久登记获准封存材料与摄取义务，隔离旧执行，确认释放后交回 slot。旧 Profile 在授权范围内可查作参考，旧 ID 仅用于追溯和对账。下次同类需求新建 Bee。新 Bee 独立初始化 Profile、Session 和 Local Memory。
3. **三层记忆都在 Session Store 下。** Session Context 保存当前工作上下文。Local Memory 由 Harness 维护，按当前 Bee 隔离，保留热原文和按任务分类的条目。Global Memory 插件接收可共享片段，保存来源及权限。驱逐时从私有 Local 中提取获准片段，异步经 Plugin Gateway 交给 Global Memory。发布后 Beebou 和 Bee 均可按权限查询，读取无需旧实例在线。旧材料保留和清理条件待 Memory / Store owner 确认。摄取重放按原迁移 ID 去重。
4. **原问题答复与报告。** 交互模块同事务提交原答复和 Beebou Inbox 的知会引用。Bee 原等待点独立恢复。静默知会不会触发派单。进度与完成报告沿 `report(status|done)`，用户终态通知以平台提交并投递的事件为准。

## Bee 状态与生命周期（Worker 方案二）

共享接口 H-C1–H-C5 的输入与回执以 [#1228 H-C1–H-C8](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228#user-content-hive-contracts) 为唯一来源，本节只写 Worker 侧的状态、时序和验收。设计源为 Harness 设计稿 [§4.3](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e804ef48b5cfd3b2b1882e5b8ec538e8d7dd42e0/docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-bee-harness-design.md#43-时序图--查询生成重新激活与任务受理)、[§4.4](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e804ef48b5cfd3b2b1882e5b8ec538e8d7dd42e0/docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-bee-harness-design.md#44-时序图--slot-满时的驱逐与记忆迁移)、[§6](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e804ef48b5cfd3b2b1882e5b8ec538e8d7dd42e0/docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-bee-harness-design.md#6-bee-与记忆的状态转换)（评审提案，`e804ef48`，[openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate#1324](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1324)）。

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> PendingFirstStart: 登记新定义，取得新 bee_id
    PendingFirstStart --> ACTIVATING: 申请首次启动
    ACTIVATING --> ACTIVE: 就绪见证，提交新代次与活跃绑定
    ACTIVATING --> PendingFirstStart: 已确认启动失败，可重试本次创建
    ACTIVE --> EVICTING: 空闲 LRU 驱逐认领（H-C4）
    EVICTING --> ProfileReference: 封存并确认释放，旧 ID 停止接单
    ProfileReference --> [*]: Profile 可供新建参考
    ACTIVE --> RETIRED: 显式退役
    RETIRED --> [*]
```

上图和下表区分“首次启动待完成”和“曾运行后已驱逐”两种情况。`PendingFirstStart` 与 `ProfileReference` 仅为图中说明，持久编码待评审。

| 状态 | 触发与提交 | 对选路与受理的影响 | 写入方 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 首次启动待完成 / 驱逐后的 Profile | 新创建请求登记定义 / 旧实例完成驱逐 | 前者可按原创建回执重试首次启动。后者仅可参考 Profile 和核对历史，禁止激活旧 ID | 定义由 Bot Repository 保存，运行状态由 Session Store 提供 |
| `ACTIVATING` | Store 条件提交唯一激活认领，占用空 slot 或等待交接 | 可查原认领；派发须等活跃绑定 | Session Store |
| `ACTIVE` | Backend 提交与认领匹配的就绪见证，Store 发布活跃绑定和新代次 | 接收任务；Run、队列、待答、未决效果和运行许可共同决定能否驱逐 | Session Store；Backend 出见证 |
| `EVICTING` | Store 对仍空闲的 LRU 候选提交驱逐认领，绑定原 slot、旧代次和目标 | 拒绝对旧代次首次受理或启动，保留同 ID 已提交回执 | Session Store |
| `RETIRED` | 独立退役控制 | 历史与对账可查，选路排除 | Bot Repository / Session Store |

**有效信息门闩。** 写入门闩与内容 CAS 都由 Bot Repository 持久化。Backend 经 Store proxy 验证原认领后传入 `scope / bee_id / generation / claim_id`。Bot Repository 只为高于已见代次的认领开门；同代关闭先持久记录，迟到的同代开启和写入一律拒绝。Host 在 Store 确认 `ACTIVE` 后才开放该代写入。封存前取得受验证的最终有效信息版本。

### 查询、复用活跃 Bee 或创建新 Bee（方案二）

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant H as Beebou Harness
    participant B as HostAPI / Host
    participant P as Plugin Gateway
    participant T as Bot 工具 provider
    participant R as BotDirectory
    participant D as Delivery
    participant S as Session Manager
    participant DB as Session Store
    H->>B: tools.call 查询候选
    B->>P: 派发已授权的工具
    P->>T: 查询名片与任务摘要
    T->>R: 读取活跃名片与可参考的旧 Profile
    T->>S: 读取任务摘要与当前状态
    S->>DB: 读取权威任务事实
    Note over H,B: 候选回到 Harness，经 Model Gateway 推理
    alt 复用活跃 Bee 或补充原任务
        Note over H,T: 已有 bee_id，原任务补充带 task_ref
    else 需要新 Bee
        opt 找到合适的旧 Profile
            Note over H,T: 仅用于构造新定义
        end
        H->>B: 请求登记新定义
        B->>P: 转发授权的登记调用
        P->>T: 交 profile 与有效信息初值
        T->>R: 校验并登记新 profile 与有效信息
        R-->>T: 新 bee_id 和定义版本
        T-->>P: 定义回执
        P-->>B: 返回登记结果
        B-->>H: 新 bee_id 和定义版本

        H->>B: 按本次创建回执请求激活新 bee_id
        B->>P: 转发授权的激活调用
        P->>T: 交 bee_id 与定义版本
        T->>S: 请求激活目标 Bee
        S-->>T: 活跃绑定、待确认或容量忙
        T-->>P: 返回激活回执
        P-->>B: 返回同一回执
        B-->>H: 目标状态
    end
    opt 目标可派单
        H->>B: tools.call dispatch
        B->>P: 授权派发
        P->>T: dispatch 指定 bee_id 和模式
        T->>D: 附稳定 message_id 的命名投递
        D->>S: 解析受理
        S->>DB: 提交 new 或绑定原 task_ref 的 steer
        S-->>D: 持久回执
    end
```

### slot 满时的驱逐与记忆迁移（设计稿 §4.4）

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant S as Session Manager
    participant DB as Session Store
    participant B as Backend / Host
    participant O as 旧 WorkSwarm
    participant N as 目标 WorkSwarm
    participant P as Plugin Gateway
    participant M as Global Memory provider
    S->>DB: 条件认领空 slot 或锁定空闲 LRU
    alt 满载且锁定了旧 Bee
        S->>B: 交驱逐认领与旧代次
        B->>O: 停止接单并封存 local memory
        O-->>B: 封存材料及已提交有效信息版本
        B->>DB: 同事务持久封存引用与摄取义务
        DB-->>B: 已提交
        B->>DB: 隔离旧执行代次
        B->>O: 释放实例资源
        O-->>B: 释放见证
        B->>S: 确认释放
        S->>DB: 记录旧身份结束，保留历史归属并转交 slot
    else 满载且无候选
        S->>S: 返回容量忙
    else 有空位
        S->>S: 沿用已认领的空 slot
    end
    par 启动目标 Bee
        opt 已认领 slot
            S->>B: 交启动计划
            B->>N: 按新 bee_id 和定义启动
            N-->>B: 实例就绪
            B->>S: 返回就绪见证
            S->>DB: 提交活跃绑定和新代次
        end
    and 已提交事件的异步处理
        opt 存在待处理摄取义务
            B->>P: 以原迁移 ID 交付摄取事件
            P->>M: Ingestion 摄取已封存材料
            M-->>P: 持久摄取回执
            P-->>B: 返回受理回执
            B->>P: 用原迁移 ID 查询处理结果
            P->>M: 查询发布或结算状态
            M-->>P: 已提交结果
            P-->>B: 返回终态回执
            B->>DB: 记录终态回执，按约定保留策略处理材料
        end
    end
```

| 迁移状态 | 推进条件 | 失败或结果未知 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SEALED_PENDING` | Store 同事务提交封存引用与待摄取义务 | 以驱逐认领对账，确认前保留原 Local Memory 和 slot |
| `INGEST_ACCEPTED` | Global Memory provider 确认持久接收同一 `migration_id` | 查询原 ID 或幂等重投，保留封存引用 |
| `PUBLISHED` / `SETTLED_NO_PUBLICATION` | provider 提交可读版本或可核验的无发布终态，Store 记录回执 | 查询原 ID，结果明确前封存引用可恢复 |
| `CLEANED` | 保留检查后清理临时封存，保留迁移回执 | 重试原清理义务 |

### 失败与并发

- **新任务受理与驱逐认领竞争。** 在 Store 同一排序点定序。受理先提交则驱逐认领失败；驱逐先提交则后到的首次派发得到明确状态变化，调用方重读。空闲候选须无执行、待答、排队、取消中、未知效果或未确认释放。
- **启动失败或未知。** 已知失败时 Backend 确认资源可释放，Store 撤销激活认领、释放 slot、回到首次启动待完成状态。结果未知时保留认领和 slot，按原实例身份与代次对账。
- **封存或释放未完成。** 维持原材料，恢复同一次驱逐。顺序固定为先持久封存并登记摄取义务，再确认释放、转交 slot。Global Memory 发布可晚于新实例启动。
- **登记重放与并发生成。** 同 `operation_id` 回放原 `bee_id`；名册版本已变且未提交时先重读，避免同职责重复生成。
- **全池无可驱逐对象。** 当新建需要 slot 时返回 `CAPACITY_BUSY`，用户看到稍等提示。若本次新定义已登记，稍后按同一创建回执尝试首次启动。
- **跨用户、旧代次。** 结构和权限隔离；旧代次的迟到写入、有效信息更新和派发全部拒绝。

## Worker 验收（HIVE-SC-01，HIVE1 Step 1.1 / 1.3）

以下是方案二的验收预期。原组合的 W5 验证的是 H-D2 的原 ID 复活，不能计作本决定通过，需按方案二重跑。

| 断言 | 步骤与可观察结果 | 真实参与方 / 允许的替身 | 当前 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SC01-W1 | 空名册经 H-C2 登记一只 Bee，返回稳定 `bee_id` 与定义版本，等待首次启动；同 `operation_id` 重放返回同一结果，改参冲突 | 真实 BotDirectory / Bot Repository | `NOT_RUN` |
| SC01-W2 | H-C1 可见活跃 Bee 的 Profile、在办任务摘要和状态。已驱逐 Bee 的 Profile 仅供参考。分页截断、目录不可用和读取失败可区分 | 真实 BotDirectory | `NOT_RUN` |
| SC01-W3 | H-C3 激活后 `resolve(scope, bee_id)` 返回本次代次与 Session；历史 `owner_of_session` 仍可反查 | 真实 BotDirectory + #1311 Manager/SQLite；WorkSwarm 未接通时就绪见证可用受控执行者，单独标注 | `NOT_RUN` |
| SC01-W4 | 容量未满时驻留并使用空位。满槽时仅选空闲 LRU，驱逐和新受理竞争只有一个赢家。全部受保护时返回容量忙，客户端联调观察稍等弹窗。确认释放前保持原占用 | 真实 Manager/SQLite（#1311），弹窗以客户端联调为证 | `NOT_RUN` |
| SC01-W5 | 方案二：活跃复用保持 ID 与 Session。驱逐 A 后参考其 Profile 创建 B，断言 B 与 A 的 ID 不同，B 有新 Session 和独立 Local Memory。原 ID 无法重新激活或接新单，历史归属仍可反查，迟到写入被拒绝 | 真实 BotDirectory + Store；WorkSwarm 隔离用真实 adapter，否则记 `BLOCKED` | `NOT_RUN` |
| SC01-W6 | 封存后延迟摄取、丢 ACK、重启，按原 `migration_id` 只发布一次。旧实例离线后 Beebou 和其他 Bee 均可按权限查询片段，越权查询被拒绝 | Memory provider 可用受控替身，真实 provider 由 #1312 验收 | `NOT_RUN` |
| SC01-W7 | 两个用户各有同名 Bee，名册、记忆和任务互不可见 | 真实 BotDirectory + Store | `NOT_RUN` |

- **命令。** BotDirectory / WorkSwarm adapter 的单测与 SC-01 场景入口随首版 PR 新增，PR 正文写明确切命令；`main@b67218b3` 尚无对应用例。#1316 现有基线 `node tests/e2e/workflow/run-workflow.mjs --validate` 只校验 workflow 定义。
- **证据。** base/head SHA、真实与替代参与方、Bot Repository 与 Store 行（定义版本、代次、slot 认领、迁移状态）、命令与退出状态、`NOT_RUN / BLOCKED` 原因。结果发到 [#1316](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1316)，组合验收归 [#1314](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1314)。

## 已决定

| 事项 | 决定 | 决定人 / 日期 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 驱逐后的身份与历史可见性 | 采用方案二：旧 Profile 仅供新建参考；新 Bee 使用新 `bee_id`、新 Session 和独立 Local Memory；旧 ID 仅用于追溯和对账，不能重新激活或接新单。历史任务、问题卡及回执仍归原 ID。本决定取代 #1228 H-D2。 | 产品负责人，2026-11-14 |
| 有效信息结构 | 字段结构固定，只能改已有字段的值，不能自行增加键。新增字段须升模板版本。Worker PPT 第 8 页「Bee 可增加键」不再采用。 | 产品负责人，2026-11-14 |

## 仍待 owner 决定

| 事项 | 冲突或缺口 | 决定人 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 三层记忆原件 owner | R5「都在 Session Store 下」与 Store 模块契约「原件归各 owner、Store 只存引用」冲突 | Store owner、[#999](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/999) Memory owner |
| 名册唯一 writer | 开工评审版 H-B1 提议 Bot Repository；A04 / A05 / 新组件尚未指定 | 项目负责人、HIVE-BOT |
| 过渡区登记 | 现行门禁使用 `temp/beebou/ownership.json` 自登记；逐分区列目标 owner、唯一 writer、adapter 与实际 caller。#1264 为独立门禁提案 | #1268 / #1223 交登记，Architecture / Packaging 核验 |
| 待答期间 Session 轮换 | 推迟轮换或允许切换并定向恢复；R3 验收按后者书写。方案二下旧 ID 不再激活；本项只决定等待中是否允许 Session 轮换 | HIVE-BOT、交互 owner |
| Inbox 知会写入点、去重键、读取游标 | R6 验收先于接口 | 交互 owner、Store owner |


## 待评审、联调和完成条件

- 决策树第 2 项：本地记忆首版仅注入授权的结构化条目，或支持原生检索候选后逐条核权。
- 决策树第 3 项：等待回答期间推迟 Session 轮换，或允许切换并提供旧等待点的定向恢复。
- 需 Host / Manager / 交互 / Store 对齐新增独立工作的受理、结果知会何时持久投递和幂等确认；与 Client / Gateway 对齐首版问题卡入口和 RFC 显式 Bee Session 输入的关系。
- [ ] 冻结 B1、受理 writer 与适配器交接，在过渡包中从空名册生成一只真实 Bee，确认就绪后跑通派单。
- [ ] 故障注入覆盖丢 ACK、轮换竞争、重复答复与通知、新建与空闲 LRU 驱逐并发、释放未知和异步记忆重放、等待中保护。
- [ ] 两只 Bee 及不同用户的同名 Bee 经真实 Harness 验证私有记忆隔离；单独留存运行版本与证据。
items.title: [HIVE-BOT] v3.1 Worker Bot（Bee）设计：Session 绑定、WorkSwarm 实例、记忆与 Inbox 知会

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] 已提供环境信息与最小复现描述。

## 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

重新打开 / 重新进入会话后，界面仍残留上一轮失败的「进行中」中间态，且不会自动复位：

- 顶部浮层残留「进行中」提示：一张截图显示「任务未完成 · 这个是啥」，另一张显示「Beebou 正在核对发送结果…」；
- 同一界面上，下方又挂着一条红字错误条「回复失败」，内容为「本次执行因云端执行服务不可用而中断，请稍后重试；如持续出现，请联系服务管理员。」

即「进行中提示」与「回复失败」两个状态同时挂在界面上，看起来是卡在了上一轮失败的中间态，没有随重新进入会话而清理/复位。两张截图分别为 03:43 与 03:44（隔约 1 分钟），状态完全相同，说明它不会自行恢复。

复现步骤：
1. 上一轮回复因「云端执行服务不可用」而中断，出现「回复失败」提示；
2. 退出并重新打开该会话页面（重进会话）；
3. 顶部仍残留「任务未完成 · 这个是啥」/「Beebou 正在核对发送结果…」这类「进行中」浮层提示，下方同时挂着「回复失败」错误条。

期望行为：
- 重进会话应显示已结束的历史：失败那条要么作为一条已定格、可重试的错误消息保留，要么被清除；
- 不应再显示「正在核对发送结果」这类「进行中」提示；
- 「回复失败」错误条不应一直悬挂在界面上，应随状态结束而收起或转为可重试的定格错误。

```
回复失败
本次执行因云端执行服务不可用而中断，请稍后重试；如持续出现，请联系服务管理员。
```

## Detailed Environment Information Description

- 平台：Android 客户端，应用标识 com.jiuwen.digitalmate
- 截图时间：设备状态栏 03:43、03:44（对应文件名 20261114_154349 / 20261114_154407，Asia/Shanghai 15:43、15:44）
- 网络：移动网络（截图显示 5G）
- 应用版本号：0.1.10

## Additional Information

与本仓库 #1349（附件上传失败后会话被卡住）疑似同源：两者都指向「云端执行服务不可用」后的失败态处理不到位。区别在于 #1349 表现为失败附件滞留输入区、阻塞继续回话；本条表现为重开会话后「进行中提示」与「回复失败」错误条双双残留、未随重进会话复位。建议一起排查失败态在会话恢复/重进时的清理与状态复位逻辑。

## Version Information

- 应用版本号：0.1.10

## Screenshots / Recordings

![reopen-residual-154349.png](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-screenshots/issue-assets/reopen-residual-154349.png?raw=true)

03:44 截图（残留「Beebou 正在核对发送结果…」+「回复失败」红色错误条）：

![reopen-residual-154407.png](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-screenshots/issue-assets/reopen-residual-154407.png?raw=true)
