items.author: Evelynn-V
items.body:
## Summary

Refs #464 and #1010. The two reported forms have regression coverage; end-to-end device and live-model acceptance remains outstanding.

After a conversation is summarized, routing snapshots carry only the topic card and summary (`retrieval=True`), so the previous assistant bubble is not part of the routing document. When that reply proposed a concrete action but the summary does not repeat its wording, a short confirmation such as `加上` / `加吧` / `发吧` has no lexical or semantic evidence to continue the discussion. The router then returned NEW, the turn ran without plan history, and the assistant re-asked which domain and which PR to act on.

This change binds a message that only confirms or continues the previous turn and names no subject of its own to the recent focused conversation. Because the selected conversation is admitted with its full exchanges, the turn again sees the previous proposal (the named PR and label) instead of losing it.

The rule deliberately stays narrow:

- requires an existing focus (`focused_conversation_id`),
- requires the focus to be inside the existing recency window,
- ignores messages with attachments,
- ignores the focused snapshot when it is `control_only`,
- also recognizes a bounded label instruction with a recent, uniquely identified PR in the visible original exchanges; ambiguous or ineligible cases use ordinary routing.

`Basis.FALLBACK` is used for the EXISTING decision to keep the public `Basis` contract unchanged.

## Review follow-up

- **F1 (compound confirmations) — fixed.** `_is_continuation_only` accepts a message whose clauses, split on punctuation/whitespace, all match the continuation vocabulary; a trailing courtesy word (`谢谢` / `多谢` / `please` / `pls`) is stripped first. A clause with its own subject (`好的，帮我订机票`) still keeps the whole message on ordinary routing.
- **F2 (Chinese negatives) — fixed.** `取消` / `不用` / `不了` / `不行` / `否` now bind like their English counterparts (`cancel` / `no`).
- **F3 (subject-bearing label follow-up) — implemented with bounded evidence.** Recent visible original exchanges supply a unique PR for the reported `Markt the ready label` case, including when the continuity judge is unavailable. This selects a conversation, not an action authorization. Multiple PRs and missing, stale, archived, control-only or attached context do not use this fallback. Live product acceptance is still required.
- **F4 (polite confirmations and `开始`) — fixed.** `_COURTESY_SUFFIX` now strips `please` / `pls` and re-normalizes the clause so the separating whitespace does not survive, and `开始` joins the subject-free continuation verbs. Covered by `yes please`, `sure, please`, `ok please`, `开始`, `开始吧`, `好的，开始吧`, `开始吧谢谢`, `好，开始 please`; `please add the label` and `开始处理购物清单` still route NEW.

## Tests

Added to `tests/session_proximity/test_routing.py`:

- `test_bare_continuation_binds_the_focused_discussion_after_its_reply_is_summarized` (covers `加上`, `加吧`, `发吧`, `好的`, `继续`, `收到`, `sounds good`, `go ahead`, `取消`, `不用`, `开始`, `开始吧`, `yes please`, `sure, please`, `ok please`)
- `test_compound_confirmation_clauses_bind_the_focused_discussion` (covers `好的，加上吧`, `好，加上`, `加上吧谢谢`, `好的、加上`, `加上,发吧`, `好的！加上吧`, `好的，开始吧`, `开始吧谢谢`, `好，开始 please`, plus the `好的，帮我订机票`, `please add the label` and `开始处理购物清单` counterexamples)
- `test_bare_continuation_does_not_follow_a_stale_focus`
- `test_bare_continuation_still_needs_a_focus`
- `test_short_instruction_with_its_own_subject_does_not_bind_focus`

Commands run (`PYTHONPATH=harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src`, `PYTHONUTF8=1`):

- `python -m unittest tests.session_proximity.test_routing` — 36 tests, OK
- all `tests/session_proximity/test_*.py` modules — 96 tests, OK (1 benchmark test skipped: local Ollama not reachable)
- `tests.session_proximity.test_contracts.ImportIsolationTests` — OK (the suite's `path.read_text()` needs `PYTHONUTF8=1` on this Windows host; without it the pre-existing locale decode issue appears)

Not executed: `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_session_proximity*.py` integration tests, because this environment lacks the harness runtime dependencies (`aiosqlite` first). No build or runtime verification of the HarmonyOS client was performed.


## Follow-up verification at 7834bbb7

- python -m unittest discover -s tests/session_proximity -p 'test_*.py': 99 tests passed, one local Ollama benchmark skipped (before the final additional negative case); targeted routing: 40 passed.
- Repository integration: 15 passed, including real SQLite retrieval, no-judge routing and rebuilding the selected conversation history. Model provider serialization: 7 passed using a controlled provider.
- Architecture manifest and static gate: passed, zero findings.
- Interpreter: E:/miniforge3/python.exe; mandate loaded from the repository vendor wheel. The broader source-discovery run did not pass: three imports required missing telethon and three installed-package/provenance checks failed under this source environment.
- Not yet verified: live model, deployed server, HarmonyOS emulator and the actual GitHub label operation. No screenshot or end-to-end acceptance is claimed.

## Summary

Group the DigitalMate product-center artifacts by the authoritative session-affinity topic instead of showing one flat list. The artifact center is a read-only projection: `DigitalMateConversation.artifactTopicAssignments()` maps `taskId -> conversationId -> conversation title` from the existing `session_proximity` snapshot, walks `parent_task_id` for child artifacts, and degrades missing or cyclic parents to 未归类. Display identity is always the ID-based key, so retitling a conversation changes only the label.

`ArtifactPresentation.artifactTopicGroups()` is a pure, unit-tested function: same-topic tasks merge, same-title conversations stay separate, same-name files are not deduped, files sort by generation time with a stable fallback, and search matches the topic title (all files) or individual file names (only matches). The page renders expandable topic rows with count and latest time, preserves loading/retry/empty/no-result states, and reuses the existing preview/open/download/delete actions. No second artifact write path, no new download, and no change to session-affinity classification or routing.

Closes #1048

## Validation

### Unit tests

- `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-artifact-topics.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-artifact-versions.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-artifact-center-delete.test.mjs` on head `487f8fe9` (DevEco bundled Node v24.14.1): 39/39 pass (19 new tests).
- Full Node suite (`tests/unit/*.test.mjs`, `tests/unit/ascf-device/*.test.mjs`, `tests/e2e/workflow/workflow.test.mjs`) was run earlier on this branch: 2170 tests, 2117 pass, 45 fail. All 45 are environment-only: missing `typescript`/`playwright`/`ws` (no `node_modules` in either checkout) and a Windows temp-copy `EIO`; the same `Cannot find module 'typescript'` failure reproduces on the untouched primary checkout. Not re-run for the screenshot-only commit `487f8fe9`.

### HarmonyOS emulator verification

Built, installed and exercised the real artifact center on a DevEco emulator; the evidence below comes from the app UI, not from unit tests.

- Source: branch head `487f8fe9` (feature commit `7e46943e`).
- Build: `hvigorw.bat --mode module -p module=entry@default -p product=default -p buildMode=debug assembleHap --no-daemon` with DevEco Studio 26.0's bundled hvigor 6.26.8, `DEVECO_SDK_HOME` = bundled SDK, `JAVA_HOME` = bundled JBR.
- Device: DevEco emulator `Mate 90 Pro`, HarmonyOS 6.0.0.130(SP7DEVC00E130R4P11), API 22. Installed app `com.jiuwen.digitalmate` 0.1.0 (versionCode 10013, a local build-only bump to allow the install; not part of this PR).
- Signing/login: the HAP was signed with local debug material, whose certificate is not registered with AGC, so Huawei account login fails with 华为账号参数无效. Verification therefore used phone-number login.

Confirmed on device:

1. Entry: BeeBou avatar → AgentDetails → 产物中心 tab, search box `搜索话题或文件名`.
2. Two PPTs generated in one conversation merge into a single topic row showing `2 个产物 · 11/10 15:22`, and the two same-named `微服务架构核心组件.pptx` rows (15:22, 15:19) are both listed — same-name artifacts are not deduped.
3. A different conversation stays a separate group with `1 个产物`.
4. Collapse/expand is per topic: the two-file topic collapses while the other topic keeps its own state; the count and latest time stay on the header.
5. Search by topic-title token shows that topic and all of its files; search by file-name token shows only matching files and keeps the topic heading; no match shows 没有匹配的产物.
6. A collapsed topic is expanded automatically when the search matches inside it.
7. Preview opens, download saves through the system dialog, and the downloaded PPTX renders its two pages — the existing open/download path is unaffected.

Screenshots (also committed under `.github/issue-assets/1048/`):

Topic groups with independent collapse state:

![产物中心：两个话题分组与独立折叠状态](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_artifact-topic-groups.jpg)

Two same-named artifacts merged into one topic from two tasks of one conversation, next to a separate conversation:

![同一会话两次生成合并为一个话题，同名文件各自保留](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_same-name-artifacts.jpg)

Collapsing the two-file topic hides its files and keeps the header count/time:

![折叠两文件话题](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_topic-collapsed.jpg)

Search by topic title:

![搜索话题标题](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_search-topic-title.jpg)

Search by file name:

![搜索文件名](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_search-file-name.jpg)

Search expands a collapsed topic that contains a match:

![搜索时自动展开命中话题](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_search-expands-collapsed-topic.jpg)

No match state:

![没有匹配的产物](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_search-no-result.jpg)

Artifact actions menu:

![产物操作菜单](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_artifact-actions-menu.jpg)

Preview page opened from the topic row:

![打开产物预览](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_artifact-preview.jpg)

After download, the PPTX renders its two pages in the preview:

![下载后预览渲染](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_artifact-downloaded.jpg)

Not exercised on device: the 未归类 group (needs abnormal backend data), two conversations with identical titles (covered by unit tests only), artifact delete/restore, and delayed-affinity re-projection timing. The package was installed over an app signed with a different certificate, so the emulator app data was wiped during setup; all artifacts in the screenshots were generated during this verification.

## Version history (blocked server dependency)

- Client keeps only the last receipt per `(taskId, path)` (`DigitalMateConversation.ets:1100-1106`).
- Server drops old receipts for a rewritten path (`engine_service.py:3837-3840`), and `artifact.read` verifies the current file hash against the receipt (`engine_attachments.py:288-296`), so an overwritten old version fails with "This file changed since the task finished".
- Cross-task versions are separate artifacts and stay separately visible and deletable. Same-task overwritten history is intentionally not shown or faked. Independently reading historical versions needs a server-side versioned read; that acceptance item remains incomplete.

## Migration record

- Baseline: `origin/main` `c6845d4b` after rebasing the branch (earlier base `4ed211e0`).
- Authoritative writer: session proximity remains the sole owner of conversation identity and titles; this PR adds only a read-only projection. Legacy `topic_id`/`thread_id` data keeps a stable fallback key. No server or persistence changes.

## What this fixes

Issue #381: a task failure surfaced the internal component name **Orbit** and told the user to “让 Orbit 修正请求”, which no user can act on. The string originates in the cloud pipeline, but the client had no last line of defence and rendered it verbatim in the bubble.

This is a client-side filter at the existing display boundary, not a server change:

- New `digitalmateInternalComponentDiagnostic(text)` detects the narrow pattern “Orbit + 让Orbit修正/重试/修正请求” (not every mention of the word).
- New `digitalmateInternalFailureText()` returns actionable copy: “这一步没有成功，请稍后重试或换个问法；如果仍然失败，可以联系服务管理员。”
- `digitalmateUserVisibleText()` now applies it after the existing environment-diagnostic filter.

**Reachable call path:** `digitalmateUserVisibleText()` is called when projecting stored messages (`DigitalMateConversation` line 483), when projecting streamed text (line 894), and through `visibleTaskText` for task summaries; notifications use `digitalmateTaskFailureText` for failed tasks. No new module and no unreferenced code: the function was already on every user-visible text path.

Fixes #381

## Red-first, as real commits

- `dd407ed` — **test only**: 3 tests added to `tests/unit/digitalmate-user-text.test.mjs`.
  `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-user-text.test.mjs` → **11 pass / 2 fail**, exit 1. Both failures are real assertions on existing code, not ENOENT:
  `AssertionError: The input was expected to not match the regular expression /Orbit|修正请求/. Input: '这次请求尚未完成。…Orbit 向应用发送的请求不符合要求。请让 Orbit 修正请求后再试。'`
- `b76b57e` — implementation only. Same command → **13/13 pass**, exit 0.

## Tests run

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-user-text.test.mjs` (red) | 11 pass / 2 fail, exit 1 |
| same (green) | 13 pass / 13, exit 0 |
| `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-*.test.mjs tests/unit/cloud-*.test.mjs` | 1013 tests, 1010 pass, 3 known env failures (`typescript` ×2, `playwright` ×1) |
| `node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs` | 1637 tests, 1598 pass, 32 fail, 7 skipped |
| baseline `04621bb` | 1634 / 1595 / 32 / 7 |

Delta is exactly the 3 new tests; the 32 failures are the known environment gaps.

**Not run locally:** `hvigorw`/ArkTS build (no HarmonyOS toolchain here). CI `ArkTS Code Check` and `node-ut` run on this head.

## CI

- `node-ut`: **success**
- `ArkTS Code Check`: **success**
- `hypium-ut`, `auto-review`, `claude-mention`: skipped by repo defaults

## Review

No independent review is possible: the DigitalMate Reviewer bot has no GitHub identity/token in this environment, so it cannot post. **No review was posted, no self-review was dressed as independent, and no review id is invented.** Review is reported as `not run`.

## Privacy / security / rollback

- No secrets, no prompt/response bodies, no new imports, no permission widening.
- The filter only replaces a narrow internal-failure sentence; a genuine user question such as “Orbit 是什么？” is preserved (covered by a test).
- Rollback: `git revert dd407ed..b76b57e`.

items.body:
## 决定：URL 边界与 #408 同构（方案 a），另补回基线本来就排除的 `]` 和 `}`

执行过程提取来源链接时，采用 #408 在 `CloudMessage.ets:143` 定下的那条边界——`https?:\/\/` 后不允许空白、引号、尖括号、`(`/`)` 以及 CJK/全角标点区段（`\u2000-\u206f`、`\u3000-\u303f`、`\u3400-\u4dbf`、`\u4e00-\u9fff`、`\uff00-\uffef`）。理由：`brief()` 遮的是同一类工具文本，本函数从同一份 `step.text` 里取链接，两处边界一旦分叉，同一句中文里的同一个 URL 会在遮罩面和点击面得到两个不同结果。

在这条边界上只有三处**为「可点击」服务**的差异，都写进了代码注释：

1. **补回 `]` `}`**：基线原类 `[^\s"'<>\]\}]+` 本来就排除这两个字符，而 `#408` 的遮蔽类省掉了它们。遮蔽时多带一个字符无害；这里要把 URL 交给 `openLink`，`见 [https://example.com/a] 结束` 就会点开 `https://example.com/a]`（404）。所以边界用「#408 的类 + `\]` `\}`」。
1b. **CJK 汉字留在地址里**（评审 High，已在 `376d004` 修）：#408 的类停在中日韩汉字上，那对**遮蔽**是对的（它替换字节），但对**要打开的链接**会把 `https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/中文` 砍成站点根 `https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/`（实测），这比「吞一句正文」更糟。所以地址里允许 CJK 汉字、只以 CJK/全角**标点**收尾——这正是气泡自动链接 `CloudMarkdown.ets:75` 已经在用的同一套切法。标注一句残余：`https://example.com/a其中3条`（汉字紧贴 ASCII 且无标点）仍会被吞进地址，与气泡行为一致，属已知取舍。
2. **成对括号回接**：边界把 `(` 整组切掉，而维基式地址 `https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Function_(mathematics)` 的括号属于地址。这里在边界之后仅回接**配平**的括号组（含嵌套）；不配平的 `(`/`)` 仍留在地址外。
3. **ASCII 句末标点**：`.,;:!?*` 不属于地址（`。`、`，` 已由区段排除）。尾部连续剥掉；路径里的 `/`、`%`、`=`、`&`、`#`、`?` 不动（有测试钉住）。`https://x.com/a?` 这类空查询会被剥成 `https://x.com/a`，打开的是同一页面，判断为可接受。

没有把 `CloudMessage.ets` 里的字符类抽成共享常量：该文件正被 #408 占用，本轮不碰（这是本轮唯一的重复，注释里写明指向 `CloudMessage.ets:143`）。

## 改了什么

- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/CloudHome/CloudExecutionViewModel.ets`：`executionResources()` 的链接提取改用上述边界，并在入结果集合前做配平括号回接与句末标点裁剪；`seen` 去重、`titles` 映射（查不到时回退到未修剪的原始匹配）、文件路径提取、其他规则都不变。
- `tests/unit/cloud-execution-view.test.mjs`：新增 6 个测试（边界、括号、合法 URL 语法、去重计数、文本紧邻中文、`]`/`}` 包裹），**没有改动任何既有断言**（diff 里 `^-[^-]` = 0）。

修好后：来源行展示与点击打开的 URL 一致；同一 URL 带不同尾部标点只算一个来源。

## 可达链与单一数据通路（release 路径）

- 渲染：`CloudMessageCard.ets:392-405` → `onOpenProcessLink(link.url)`；详情面板 `Index.ets:1996-2001` → `openProcessLink(item.url)`
- 打开：`Index.ets:1927-1938`，只校验 `/^https?:\/\//` 就 `host.openLink(url)`
- 计数：`CloudExecutionViewModel.ets:237`（`executionWebSourceCount` 内部 `flatMap(step => executionResources(...))`）、`:254-256`（`executionDetailLabel` 同样 `flatMap(executionResources(...))` + `new Set(...)`）——**没有第二条正则**，计数跟着同一个函数走

## 证据（`main@7fbaa28`，node v24.22.2）

命令：`node --test tests/unit/cloud-execution-view.test.mjs`

| 状态 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 未修（仅加断言） | `32 tests / 26 pass / 6 fail` |
| 修复后 | `32 tests / 32 pass / 0 fail` |
| M1 边界换回旧字符类 `[^\s"'<>\]\}]+` | 6 红（边界、括号、计数、中文路径/正文、括号注释、标题） |
| M2 `balancedParenTail()` 直接 `return end;` | 1 红（只有括号那条） |
| M3 去掉 `trimSourceUrl` 尾部剥离 | 1 红（只有边界那条） |
| M4 从边界里删掉 `\]` | 1 红（只有 `]`/`}` 包裹那条） |
| M5 从边界里删掉 `\u3000-\u303f`（中文标点区段） | 4 红（边界、计数、中文路径/正文、标题） |
| M6 去掉括号组里的 `#` 守卫 | 1 红（只有「括号注释不回接」那条） |
| 还原 | 30/30 绿 |

每次变异后都回读了被改行（例：M4 回读 `219: const SOURCE_URL: RegExp = /https?:\/\/[^\s"'<>()\}\u2000-…]+/g;`，M5 回读同位置只剩 `\u3400-\u4dbf`），确认改动真的落盘再跑测试。

既有 importers 回归：`cloud-chat.test.mjs` 157/157、`cloud-page-state.test.mjs` 22/22、`execution-status-header.test.mjs` 2/2。

未运行：`hvigorw` 构建、真机 Hypium、全量 `tests/unit`（只跑与本文件相关且会 import 它的用例）。

## 提交

- `a27aa09e545488bcca1ba8642449b7ef6f6679d2`：边界 + 括号 + 尾部标点 + 4 条测试
- `0766d416949d02bad9c8bdef6ed37be5ba28e017`：补回 `]`/`}` + 2 条测试（M4 的落点）
- `376d004493d853a5c3b95043ed660d04b0cca4b7`：CJK 汉字留在地址里（评审 High）+ 括号注释守卫 + 2 条测试（M5/M6 的落点）

## 冲突面

42 个 open PR 里没有任何一个改动这两个文件（#408 占 `CloudMessage.ets`、#472 占 `A2uiHome/Index.ets`，都不重叠）。

Fixes #498

<sub>Fledge · DigitalMate · Lead · implemented</sub>

items.body:
## 背景

bot（`agent-CI-Infra-bot`）的检视打标原先是通用规则：按 `type/*`、`priority/*`、`area/*` 这类斜杠轴选标签，并把 `priority/medium` 当默认。这与本仓库实际标签体系不匹配——这里是 `priority:P0/P1/P2`、`client`/`backend`/`hybrid`、`source:*`、`channel:*`。结果是模型选出的名字大多落在 `repository_labels` 之外，被控制面静默丢弃，等于不分类。

## 本 PR 做了什么

- 新增 `.bot/rules/labels.md`。这是 bot 文档规定的仓库级规则路径（`docs/rules.md`），整份覆盖内置 `labels.md`，每次检视都会注入。
- 规则内容对齐 #996 的 `.agents/skills/digitalmate-issue-triage`：只处理未指派且类型为 bug / UX / Experience feedback 的 Issue；四个维度（技术范围、优先级、source、channel）各最多一个值；优先级必须恰好一个 P0/P1/P2；只用现有标签，不新建、不改名；不覆盖人工已给的维度。
- 保留首行 `review_label: bot-reviewed`，检视标签行为不变。
- 全部标签名已对照仓库线上 43 个标签校验，无自造名称。

## 与 #996 的关系

#996 的 skill 已经在 main 上，bot 会把 `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` 作为按需 skill 索引（`docs/rules.md`）。但 skill 是按需读的，而 `labels.md` 是每个任务都注入的规则层。两份配合：本文件负责“每次检视必须怎么选标签”，skill 负责“分诊细节和责任田”。

## 生效方式

规则只从默认分支读（PR 内的改动不影响当次任务）。合入 `main` 后，下一次 Issue 检视即按新规则打标。注意：本 PR 改了 `.bot/`，bot 检视这个 PR 时会在总结里提示“改变了 bot 行为，需要人决定”，这是预期行为。

## 范围影响

feature / documentation / RFC / Competition feedback 等类型不再添加分类标签，只保留 `bot-reviewed`；这与 #996 skill 的 issueScope 一致。如果希望 feature 也自动分类，需要在后续 PR 里放宽本文件的处理范围。

items.body:
## What

Keep complete JSON object/array replies byte-for-byte intact during web citation presentation. The bridge currently treats URL values as prose citations and silently deletes them when they are absent from its native source registry.

Observed in three search conformance trials: the model retrieved the document through Python/bash and returned the correct answer, source URL and evidence. After an earlier `fetch_webpage` call, the legacy completion cleanup changed every `"source":"http://web-search:9001/documents/..."` value to `"source":""`. Retrieval, answer and evidence checks passed, but all three source checks failed.

The candidate guards the legacy cleanup and opt-in web presentation entry points. It does not infer verified sources from shell text, add source bindings, relax prose citation validation, or change stored benchmark scores. Malformed JSON and prose containing JSON-like fragments still follow existing cleanup.

Related infrastructure: #783 (DM31-M12); this PR does not complete that migration task.

## Routing and scope

- Source: main `77a425ec9e41f114c63574f0d2a8a4bd96549023`; candidate `aade5ab65716dc035e5edf52668eb4acc52909bd`.
- Supported path: existing `server_engine.server.Bridge._execute_jiuwen`, both legacy and free-search presentation modes.
- Owner: registered `legacy-mobile-gateway` / Mobile Gateway owner (DM31-M01); source/citation migration carry-forward belongs with DM31-M12.
- Writable files: `server_engine/server.py` and the existing `test_web_reply_presentation.py` only. No new module, published interface, Store writer, schema, adapter, or runtime activation.
- Transition: no new adapter to retire. Carry the structured-output regression into the future source/presentation owner at its cutover.

## Before and after

Before: `{"answer":"code","source":"http://web-search:9001/documents/record","evidence":"A fact."}` becomes the same JSON with an empty source.

After: the entire JSON response is preserved. It still has no verified source binding. Ordinary unread prose links continue to be removed.

## Verified

Interpreter: isolated CPython 3.12.15 environment; editable contracts and engine from this exact checkout, bridge dependencies from its pyproject, vendored Mandate wheel, pytest 9.2.0. No production deployment. Offline tests used no credentials; the later live test used the configured model provider through Nullius’s relay without exposing credentials to DigitalMate.

- Red: the six JSON presentation cases fail on unmodified main. Both real Bridge completion regression cases also fail on main (exit 1), including the legacy path that produces the observed empty source.
- Green: focused presentation, unread-citation, source-link and reply-stream tests passed. The expanded nine-file regression selection completed with **204 passed, 8 skipped, 7 failed, 236 subtests passed** (exit 1).
- All seven remaining failures reproduced on unmodified main: one removed search-setting field rejected by configuration, and six SearchSessionTest setup failures from an undefined `ScriptedBackend`. They were not modified or waived.
- Bridge tests use the real execution/completion code and temporary source store. ScriptedBackend supplies controlled tool/model events, and runtime connectivity is stubbed. These are not live model or actual shell retrieval tests.
- Private replay of the three recorded final model answers preserves all three URLs in both presentation modes. The recorded retrieval/answer/evidence checks were already true. This is replay evidence, not a newly scored live run; original results remain unchanged and no run data is included here.
- Architecture manifest check passed (54 owners, no exceptions); Python 3.12 architecture scan found zero findings across 278 files / 32 checked files; all 92 architecture tests passed (exit 0).
- `git diff --check` passed.

Expanded test command (from repo root):

```sh
python -m pytest \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_web_reply_presentation.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_engine_unread_citations.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_engine_source_links.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_reply_stream.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_engine_web_search.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_engine_web_fetch.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_web_failure_messages.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_search_policy.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_source_links.py -q
```

The first constrained test attempt could not bind localhost HTTP fixtures; the expanded counts above are from the rerun with those fixture sockets permitted. The first architecture scan used an unsupported Python 3.9 parser; the reported clean scan and tests use Python 3.12.

## Risk / unverified

Complete JSON is treated as data rather than citation markup, analogous to existing protection of code examples. An unverified URL can therefore remain as a JSON value; it must not be interpreted as a verified source. Existing source bookkeeping is unchanged. Maintainer review of this presentation distinction is needed.

This bounded fix does not add provenance tracking for arbitrary Python/bash retrieval and does not fix citation loss in ordinary prose. The live Docker/Muse run and image build below are complete. Phone/HAP tests, full engine suite, deployment, and independent review remain unverified. Keep this draft until the applicable review and runtime gates are satisfied. Revert this commit to restore previous presentation behavior; no data migration is involved.


## Live verification — 2026-11-09

Built the complete upstream Dockerfile at PR head `aade5ab65716dc035e5edf52668eb4acc52909bd` (APT mirror set to deb.debian.org), then ran Nullius’s unchanged agent.search/v1 kit with `meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor` through OpenRouter. The existing ACP adapter was retained; the test explicitly selected the candidate image. No catalogue proof or original run result was updated.

- Initial three-check run: **find-source passed**, **disambiguate passed**, **follow-reference ended with HTTP 400: Provider returned error** before producing its final answer. This is a 2/3 initial run, not a clean 3/3 suite.
- Retried only follow-reference once using the standard shard selector, with the same candidate image/model: **passed**.
- All three completed checks passed all four verifier conditions: answer, exact source URL, evidence, and ordered HTTP retrieval. The reference check also retrieved the intermediate page before the final source.
- Therefore every search check has a live passing result with this candidate, with one provider-error retry explicitly retained. The initial run remains failed 2/3; results were not merged or rewritten to hide the interruption.

These are real model calls and real Docker agent/tool/fixture execution, not replay or a scripted backend. This bounded kit result does not establish public-web GAIA performance, phone behavior, or general prose citation provenance.

items.author: aitianshi
items.body:
Closes #698

## What

A task's selected project directory was stored but dropped before the Bridge opened its WorkSwarm session. File operations could consequently use a generated task folder instead of the selected directory.

Forward `Task.project_path`, select or create the native WorkSwarm project, and pass its binding during session creation. Include the normalized directory in scope ownership so a continuation cannot reuse a session from another project. Preserve projectless identities and `work` mode; refuse incompatible existing bindings.

## Validation

- Reproduced the forwarding failure against unmodified main `fc08933b4a3fa1ac5e95f9843afe7a756ddda42d`, without a model call.
- 105 WorkSwarm tests passed, including forwarding, same/different-project reuse, restart, rotation, missing-directory rejection, binding drift and lost-create-response recovery.
- 37 existing conversation and task-clear tests passed.
- Contributor guide Node command: 2,658 passed, two skipped, no failures, with CI-pinned test dependencies.
- Docker native API check passed: explicit directory binding, unchanged `work` mode, same-project session reuse and different-project isolation. The v0.1.8 runtime used the changed product service source read-only, with networking disabled and no model calls.
- `git diff --check` passed.

[Reproduction, commands, limits and visual evidence](docs/developer_guide/evidence/project-workspace-binding/README.md).

## Risk and limits

Explicit project requests now register/select a WorkSwarm project and require an existing absolute directory. An existing project in another mode is rejected rather than modified. The directory becomes part of session identity; switching projects starts a distinct session. Projectless sessions retain their existing identities.

No prompts, model settings, tools, vendored execution sources or execution modes were changed. Live model-driven file editing and HarmonyOS device behavior were not tested. This PR does not claim improved answer accuracy.



## Main branch integration

Conflict resolved in `5753a89b61f47187fe7a0f6c069d7f49acef6cf5` by merging main `3088fdf9f8b0ae16eacecdaf842addd7d6e893bc`. Both project binding and upstream runtime-generation tracking are retained. The new regression verifies project-preserving reconnect and durable runtime-generation acquisition.

Post-merge validation: 65 adapter/project/unload tests and 49 project/conversation tests passed (the groups overlap). A broader discovery had 116 passes and one launcher-policy error because the local environment lacks the newly required installed WorkSwarm runtime overlay. This prerequisite was not bypassed. CI is rerunning on the new head.

items.author: Jianyu010
items.body:
Selecting EARLY versus LATER within one product session previously changed only routing and produced no selected-quote distinction in model input. This core slice adds optional canonical QuoteSelection(source_submission_id, part, expected_sha256), with no submitter-supplied source text, owner, room or S/R. The expected digest is SHA-256 of the exact authoritative selected UTF-8 text, not a preview or a permission token.

Manager owns validation/policy and canonical M identity. Router uses the originating M to choose S. Inside Store's existing BEGIN IMMEDIATE admission transaction, duplicate M is reconciled first; a new M then rechecks the owner-scoped source M/S/R, part, digest and selected text before committing its binding and sealed typed input. A nullable quote_manifest independently binds quote identity, with old rows defaulting to no quote. The run start snapshot carries unchanged user text plus a versioned quote data envelope. Existing HostAPI context.read and direct-model execution consume that same sealed view; Core/HostAPI implementation did not need a second quote path.

The transaction checks rollback, source changes around admission, exact same-M replay/conflicts, concurrent M, parent disappearance and old data. Ask references the original visible text, not an embedded earlier quotation; reply requires a completed answer. Quote plus attachments and competing explicit routes are rejected in this first text-only scope. Current-call owner/read authorization remains required: an M or digest never authenticates a caller, and cross-owner replay/context reads fail. Gateway wire/room/publication code is untouched and legacy quoted wire sends remain disabled. Active-window/paged-history lookup limitations are separately retained in #660.

Execution evidence and open gate:

- Before the instruction to move execution to adx-jiuwen-test-3, all 419 server tests passed, zero skips,43.200s at b933d8c9 on base1ae18423. Those tests used an ephemeral local Docker delivery image, NOT remote gVisor. They include real Runtime, actual Core/HostAPI and direct ModelGateway over real loopback HTTP with controlled providers, plus existing ask_user/Stop/tool denial/attachments/Office regressions.
- The branch is now rebased on architecture f25f53595279742c5e7e812127f395db1ebc8426 (#661/#662 included). Integrated server execution on that head has NOT run. Per user direction, no further local server/test was started; the lead owns remote gVisor execution and independent review. Static Python parsing and diff checks pass.
- The previous long-lived own dm-room-637-independent QA container was identity-checked, manifest-frozen, stopped and retained with state plus a hashed offline copy. Other live endpoints/devices were untouched.

Implementation is split into admission, Runtime consumption and consistency-hardening commits. docs/specs/authoritative-quote-input.md describes the contract; docs/verification/authoritative-quote-input.md names the exact evidence source and a remote handoff command. This is an initial reviewable draft, not a remote-pass, production quote-wire or phone acceptance claim. Full wire alias/opaque ingress correlation remains later work.

items.author: Jianyu010
items.body:
The frozen phone quote selector currently has no safe published-reference read operation. This accepted first slice adds Gateway-owned read-only resolution for exact published {room_id,message_id} and legacy {task_id,part} selectors. It calls public Runtime.read_submission with the verified owner and published M, checks M/S/R, part eligibility and exact authoritative text, and returns only the selected text plus checked identities.

Unknown/restarted-away mappings fail unavailable; cross-owner/principal/room and client authority fields fail before history access. Modern/legacy selectors of the same source are aliases. EARLY remains the selected source even when the frozen caller's follows points at a later turn. No ID-prefix decoding, other component private state, lease, source-version token or quote submission is introduced. Only projection.py gains an additive public read operation; shared Gateway dispatch, navigation/protocol, Runtime/Router/Manager/Store and their types remain unchanged. The branch is rebased onto merged #640. Production quoted task.create stays UNSUPPORTED.

Validation at integrated architecture base 1ae184231f49f5791f1bc534f3f06574b78b4978 (includes #640): all 55 Gateway UT and 53 Gateway ST pass, zero skips (0.284s and 14.445s) in the pinned delivery image. This includes 11 new UT and 7 new ST covering real public Runtime/SQLite publication, same-S source/part distinction, wrong scope, missing source, facade reopen with empty projection, authorized non-home room publication from public history, substituted history identities/text/type, UTF-8 output limits, rich-reader field isolation and disabled production submission. Resolver reads add zero model/classifier work. Existing artifact WSS/Core, attachment, date, replay, disconnect and authority revocation regressions also pass with their controlled providers.

Independent review found an admitted-state gap; a real Runtime test pauses on_admitted before claim and reproduced RED, then passed after accepting admitted asks. Replies still need a completed authoritative answer and published result. The updated code was freshly rerun; peer review of the fix was requested but the team tool hit its thread limit, so no independent fixed-head approval is claimed.

Authorization is the existing trusted AccountAuthority call path, not construction of a VerifiedScope dataclass. Revocation observed before request authorization denies; later revocation can race with reads/admission; delivery reauthorization can suppress a response without undoing acceptance. The output has a64KiB UTF-8 ceiling, but the unchanged history facade reads the full record first; no bounded-allocation claim is made. Publication is transient and is not rebuilt by guessing IDs after restart. This is a component read slice, not phone quote acceptance or atomic admission. #657's proposal is separately revised to remove a mandatory lease, settle retry/alias/follows correlation, and leave atomic sealing plus both execution paths for later owner-approved work.

## Summary

Add an explicitly configured, single-grant QA AccountAuthority and synchronous Office permission provider. The provider checks a private grant file on every decision, binds the credential to a configured owner, principal, binding and dedicated workspace, and fails closed for expiry, revocation, invalid configuration and non-boolean permissions. It provides no issuer or production AGC verification.

## Verification

- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/server/qa_identity -v` — 12 passed, including the actual transport handler with an in-memory socket and cloud factory loading.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/server/mobile_gateway/ut -v` — 52 passed on local Python 3.11.
- The adjacent `test_wire` system suite was inadvertently run with in-process loopback fixtures; it reported one failure and two errors with a local Core API mismatch (`_HostAbilities.remove`). This is not delivery-runtime or remote acceptance evidence.

## Scope and limits

Account and binding are checked at authentication; the Office contract exposes only the run owner and cannot independently inspect account or binding. This requires a dedicated QA process/workspace, a private grant provisioned outside the image, a separately trusted issuer, and independent review. No deployment, phone, production AGC, or model acceptance is claimed.

## 问题

读屏在每个返回按钮后面多停一个「图片」节点，同一个控件被念两遍；心上事列表里每条记录后面也一样多一个停靠点。父节点已经有可读名，缺的是把纯装饰的箭头图标移出无障碍树：

- `pages/A2uiHome/components/common/A2uiButtonView.ets` 的 `shape === 'back'` 分支：`Button` 内 `Image($r('app.media.icon_back'))`，父 `Button` 已有 `.accessibilityText(label || '返回')`。该组件被 6 个返回按钮复用（`ComposioAuthPage`、`HomePage`、`TrainPresalePanel`、`ConfigPage`、`A2uiHome/Index.ets`、`SharedWaterfallCard`）。

items.author: HugoXK
items.body:
Fixes #449

## 问题

英文设备的用户走的是同一条云端连接状态链路，但连接横幅的文本与动作按钮都是硬编码中文：读屏聚焦横幅时整块播报未翻译的中文状态（例如「正在连接云端…」），英文用户看到的按钮是「重新加载」「正在连接」「立即重试」，既读不懂当前状态，也不知道按下去会重连。连接链路其余文案都经 `digitalmateUserFacingError()` / `digitalmateBusinessError()` 收敛成可读句子，唯独这一处把中文字面量直接渲染进 `Text` 与 `Button`，没有任何语言分支。

## 修法

- `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets`：`digitalmateConnectBanner()` 与 `digitalmateUserFacingError()` 增加可选 `language` 参数（默认 `'zh-CN'`），`en` 开头（`/^en\b/i`）输出英文，其它语言逐字节维持现状；新增 `digitalmateConnectionActionLabel(kind, language)` 统一产出三个按钮文案（`reload` / `connecting` / `retry`）。`digitalmateBusinessError()` 的透传分支保持原样——服务端业务原文不翻译。
- `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionBanner.ets`：组件字段初始化器里取一次 `digitalmateClientContext().language`（不进 `aboutToAppear`，既有 banner fixture 不受影响）（仓库现有唯一语言入口，与 `model/DigitalMateDeviceContext.ets` 同源），把该语言传给横幅文案、`accessibilityText` 与三个按钮文案；显隐条件、重试逻辑、样式与 5 秒 slow 定时器不变。
## 未纳入本 PR

- 客户端自有文案经调用方传入、仍未英文化的一批：`'正在同步云端会话…'`（会话加载中）与网关恢复态的两句 `'正在恢复云端连接…'` / `'云端连接暂不可用，请重试连接'`（`pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets` 的 `beginGatewayRecover()` 与横幅入参）。这句是客户端自有文案，但走的是 `digitalmateBusinessError()` 的业务消息透传分支，因此本 PR 的 `language` 参数管不到它——英文设备在这一态仍会看到中文状态，按钮已是英文 `Reload`。
- 本轮不改的原因：该文件同时被多项未合入 PR 占用（本 PR 开题时抓取的占用快照命中 `#334`、`#391`、`#441`、`#474`、`#481`、`#555`），改它会与这些 PR 直接冲突。
- 已建独立 tracking issue 跟进：见 #564（含改法、验收标准与前置占用清单）。
- 范围确认：`#563` 的生产代码只改 `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` 与 `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionBanner.ets`，不碰 `pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets`。

- **二次本地化兜底（F1）**：调用方会先把错误本地化成中文再存进 `this.error`（`pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets`、`DigitalMateConversationBinding.ets`），横幅再以英文渲染时原本会原样透出中文。现在 `DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` 持有本模块**自有文案**的 zh→en 对照（10 条 + `正在重新连接云端（第 N 次）…` 正则），英文路径先查表再走正则；`state === 'open'` 的业务透传分支只在命中自有文案时才替换，**服务端 / 模型原文照旧原样透传**。英文路径同时把 `证书|certificate|SSL|TLS` 提到 `网络|…` 之前，避免 TLS 失败被报成「网络不可用」；中文路径的判定顺序一字未改。
- 共 2 个生产文件，不动 `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConversationBinding.ets`（被 #481 占用），不碰 `cloud-adapter/.../CloudMarkdown.ets`（#547 / #403）。

## 可达性

1. `entryability/EntryAbility.ets` 冷启动 `loadContent('pages/A2uiHome/Index')`。
2. `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets` 的 `CloudConversationBody()` 在 `cloudBackend === 'digitalmate'` 时渲染 `DigitalMateConversationBinding`；该后端是默认值（`resources/rawfile/app_config.example.json` 的 `"cloudBackend": "digitalmate"`）。
3. `DigitalMateConversationBinding` 的 `build()` 里 `if (this.state !== 'open' || this.error)` 渲染本组件，而 `state` 初值为 `'closed'`——冷启动第一帧横幅必然出现；断开、超时、重连中也走同一分支。
4. 全屏会话页 `pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets` 也直接使用同一组件，两个入口共用这份文案。

## 测试

先红后修：`tests/unit/connection-banner-bilingual.test.mjs` 把 `DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` 去掉类型后在 vm 里**真执行**（不复制实现），并静态守卫组件装配。

```text
# 红基线 eb1408de（= f69d6335 + 只有测试）
$ node --test tests/unit/connection-banner-bilingual.test.mjs
✖ every Chinese sentence the module emits is translated when it is fed back in English
✖ a caller that localises the error first still gets English from the banner, and server text is untouched
✖ the four stored Chinese errors still read in English when a caller pre-localised them
ℹ tests 10 · pass 7 · fail 3
```

```text
# 最终 head 5de0ad69
$ node --test tests/unit/connection-banner-bilingual.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-connection-ux.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-connection-banner.test.mjs
ℹ tests 21 · pass 21 · fail 0 · skipped 0
```

基线不动：`node scripts/check-a11y.mjs` → `Files with unnamed tap targets: 28 known, 0 new or worse, 0 stale.`

残留（未验证，不当成已验证）：英文串若再被喂回 `digitalmateUserFacingError()` 会被二次分类——`'Reconnecting to the cloud (attempt 2)…'` 含 `econn`（Reconnecting 的子串）、`'Secure connection failed…'` 含 `network`，都会被判成网络失败。当前路径不可达（banner 的 `connecting` 分支直接返回，不做二次分类），中文侧不受影响，故本 PR 不改；但不视为「已验证安全」。

未验证（不伪造）：真机 TalkBack / VoiceOver 的实际朗读与 `.accessibilityGroup(true)` 下的焦点顺序——沙箱没有 HarmonyOS 设备，只做了源码级执行断言。另有一处新增调用语境：本 PR 让组件在**字段初始化器**里调用 `digitalmateClientContext()`，即仓库里第一次在 UI 构造期调用 `i18n.System.getSystemLocaleInstance()`（其余 6 个调用点都在提交/发送路径），其构造期异常行为未经真机验证。

## 回归护栏（变异验证）

`DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` 的每一处英文分支都有断言钉住，删掉即变红（每条都实跑过）：`digitalmateEnglish()` 恒 false → 3 红；只删 `digitalmateConnectionActionLabel('reload'|'connecting'|'retry', language)` 的 language 实参 → 各 1 红；只删 `.accessibilityText(...)` 的 language → 1 红；字段初始化器硬编码 `'en'` 或 `'zh-CN'` → 各 1 红；英文证书优先分支 `if (english && …)` 改成 `if (false && …)` → 1 红；open 态英文改走通用映射 → 1 红。

最后一条对应断言 `a server business message in the open state stays verbatim even when it mentions a mapped keyword`：open 态的服务端业务原文即便含 `网络` / `超时` / `证书` 等被映射的关键词，英文下也必须逐字节原样透传（本 PR 只翻译模块自有的 10 条规范句与重连模板，不翻译服务端与模型输出）。

## 范围

基于 `main@f69d6335`，3 文件 `+558/−22`：生产 2 个文件 `+97/−22`（`DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` `+84/−17`、`DigitalMateConnectionBanner.ets` `+13/−5`），测试 1 个文件 `+461/−0`。Reviewer 最终 delta 评审：**93/100，`Scored on 5de0ad69`**。

items.author: HugoXK
items.body:
## What this fixes

A turn that stops receiving events while the websocket stays healthy leaves the UI in "running" indefinitely. Reconnect reconciliation only runs when the connection drops (`CloudChatManager.reconcileAfterReconnect`), so a silent turn is never checked and the user is left with a half sentence and no way to tell whether the answer is still coming — the exact现场 in #379 (回复只有「我核对一下具体是谁说的。」，之后无任何输出，也没有失败提示或重试入口).

The session now watches that silence itself: after one minute without any event on a turn that still owes output, the conversation raises a single `warn` notice ("云端仍在处理，近一分钟没有新的输出。可以继续等待，或停止任务后重试。"). It never changes the run state, never fabricates a failure, and disappears the moment the cloud says anything again.

Fixes #398. Fixes #379 (user-visible report of the same quiet-turn hang). See also #373 (execution-time opacity).

## How it works

`CloudSession`:

- `watchQuiet()` restarts the silence clock and drops a shown hint. It is called from `beginTurn()` and on every frame the session accepts in `apply()`, so only a genuine gap counts.
- The timer fires at most once per quiet stretch (`quietHint` latches until the next event), only while `state` is `running` or `sending` — a paused turn, a turn waiting on an unanswered question, a stopped turn and a finished turn all have their own state and never see the hint.
- `settleQuiet()` stops the clock and removes the hint on `finishTurn()` and on `beginTurn()` of the next turn, so nothing leaks across turns.
- The hint is only placed when `notice` is empty: a real error/notice is never overwritten.
- The threshold is a constructor parameter (`new CloudSession(id, quietHintMs)`), defaulting to the exported `QUIET_HINT_MS = 60000`; tests pass a short value instead of sleeping a minute.

No new protocol, no server change, no new dependency, no logging of prompt/response content, no permission change. Rollback is a revert of two files.

## Tests (failing first)

`tests/unit/cloud-session-quiet-watch.test.mjs` — 7 cases, real `CloudSession` through the existing `tests/support/cloud-test-loader.mjs`, no device or backend.

Red first: before the change the suite failed with `assert.ok(session.notice)` — a silent running turn produced no notice at all.

| Case | Expectation |
| --- | --- |
| running turn, no events | `warn` notice containing「仍在处理」, `state` stays `running` |
| output resumes | notice cleared at once, bubble text continues normally |
| turn finished before the threshold | no notice, `state` is `idle` |
| turn waiting on the user (`chat.ask_user_question`) | no notice (`state` is `waiting`) |
| a real notice already shown | untouched (`连接已中断` stays) |
| silence continues | notice does not repeat |
| next turn starts | no leftover notice from the previous turn |

Green after the change: 7/7. Whole `cloud-*` unit set on this branch: 517 pass / 3 fail, and the 3 failures are the missing local devDependencies (`typescript` ×2, `playwright` ×1) that `ut.yml` installs — none of them touches `CloudSession`.

## Non-goals

- No automatic failure state, no new terminal state, no retry RPC: the client cannot verify the turn is dead, and inventing a failure would be worse than the silence.
- No server-side change; if the cloud really stops answering, a proper terminal event still has to come from the backend (#367/#379).
- No change to execution/step presentation (that is #373/#375).

## Risk

The only risk is a false alarm during a legitimately long non-streaming tool phase (#322): the notice is worded as "still working", changes no state, blocks no input, is cleared by the next event and appears once per quiet stretch, with a one-minute threshold. Worst case the user sees one informational line on a long turn.

## 改了什么（生产 +2 / −0，一个文件）

`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/SkillCenter/Detail.ets`

- `:465` `Toggle({ type: ToggleType.Switch, isOn: this.enabledState })` → 修饰链加 `.accessibilityText('启用该技能')`（名字落在 `:466`；`Toggle` 在 base `48435d43` 与 head 都是 `:465`）；
- `:471` `Text('···')`（base 上是 `:470`，本 PR 在它上方插了一行后为 `:471`；`.bindMenu(this.overflowActions())` 在 `:476`）→ 修饰链加 `.accessibilityText('更多操作')`（名字落在 `:475`）。

## 用户问题

技能详情页（`main_pages.json:10` 注册，`SkillCenterView.ets:29` 经 `router.pushUrl` 进入，渲染条件 `this.phase === 'ready'`，无 debug 闸门）顶部两个控件没有可读名：开关只播报「开关，开 / 关」，`···` 被念成「点 点 点」。`···` 是「发布到技能市场」「卸载」的唯一入口，读屏用户因此找不到卸载入口，也判断不出开关在控制什么。

## 测试

新增 `tests/unit/skillcenter-detail-a11y.test.mjs`（当前 head 上 187 行；红 commit `bb5c0f70` 上是首版 176 行，`626e5d20` 按评审 F1 放宽了 `Text('···')` 定位器的引号）。它复用 `scripts/check-a11y.mjs` 导出的 `stripComments` 与自写的链扫描，把名字断言在**该控件自己的修饰链**上——写在文件别处不能糊弄过去；同时断言两个定位点各只有 1 处、仍在 `if (this.phase === 'ready')` 块内、且没有互相借用名字。不依赖网络与 ArkTS SDK。

```
红基线 bb5c0f70（只有测试）: tests 3 / pass 1 / fail 2
  ✖ the enable switch is named 启用该技能 on its own chain
  ✖ the overflow trigger is named 更多操作 on the chain that opens the menu
修复后 626e5d20:            tests 3 / pass 3 / fail 0
用最终测试文件在 48435d43 上重跑: tests 3 / pass 1 / fail 2（同两条红名，与红基线一致）
node --test tests/unit/a11y-gate.test.mjs → tests 22 / pass 22 / fail 0
node scripts/check-a11y.mjs → Files with unnamed tap targets: 28 known, 0 new or worse, 0 stale.
git diff bb5c0f70 74376ff3 -- tests/unit/skillcenter-detail-a11y.test.mjs → 空（红→修之间测试文件未动）
626e5d20 是评审后的一条 test-only 跟进：git diff --quiet 74376ff3 626e5d20 -- '*.ets' → PROD-UNCHANGED，只让 locator 同时接受 '···' 与 "···" 两种引号（评审 F1：避免格式化后误报「控件不存在」而不是「名字不对」）。
```

`check-a11y` 数字不变是预期：门禁的 `UNNAMEABLE` 只含容器与裸形状，`Toggle` 与作为可点目标的 `Text` 不在其中；`--json` 上该文件仍是 `taps 11 / unnamed 4`，总数 28，`violations []`、`stale []`。

## 回归护栏（变异验证，都在本分支实跑）

| 变异 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| M1 删掉 Toggle 的 `.accessibilityText('启用该技能')` | 1 红（switch 断言） |
| M2 删掉 `Text('···')` 的 `.accessibilityText('更多操作')` | 1 红（overflow 断言） |

| M6 同上改双引号且删掉名字 | 1 红，报「必须带 `.accessibilityText('更多操作')`」，不是「找不到控件」 |

每次变异后还原并复跑 3/3 绿；每次回读被改行逐字符确认只动了预期字符。

## 未纳入本 PR

`Detail.ets` 另有 4 个无名可点目标（`node scripts/check-a11y.mjs --json` 实测：该文件 11 个可点、4 个无名，`heads` 为 `Stack`/`Stack`/`Row`/`Stack`），属于 `tests/unit/a11y-baseline.json` 里已复核的既有基线债务；本轮**不动基线**（该文件被 open PR #551 占用，另 #557 也改它），也不在本 PR 修这 4 处。基线文件本身就是这份债务的台账。

- Test / Security 的回执见 PR 评论；生产码自 `74376ff3` 起的增量与对 `626e5d20` 的复跑结论同见评论。

`risk: low` — 只加两个修饰属性，不改结构、事件、样式与文案；无新依赖、无权限/配置/网络变更，不触碰被其它 PR 占用的文件。回滚 = 关闭本 PR，无数据迁移。

## 做了什么

主屏任务浮层 `WaterfallTaskOverlay.ets` 的三个可点控件，父节点都有 `.accessibilityText(...)` 标签，但**父节点内部的纯装饰图标**没标 `.accessibilityLevel('no')`，读屏念完标签后会紧接着再停一个「图片/符号」（ArkUI 里 `.accessibilityText` 不合并子树）。同文件另外三处（`statusIcon()` 的两个图标、预览行的 `chevron_down`）已经标了 `'no'`，所以这是漏标，不是新规矩。

本 PR 只补三处，不动布局、尺寸、文案、`onClick`：

- 收起按钮里的 `SymbolGlyph($r('sys.symbol.xmark'))`
- 结果摘要行里的旋转箭头 `Image($r('app.media.arrow_up'))`
- 继续追问按钮里的 `Image($r('app.media.arrow_up'))`

因为这三个图标没有 `onClick`，不属于 `check-a11y` 的 unnamed tap target，`tests/unit/a11y-baseline.json` **一行未改**。

## Reachability（release 路径）

`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:9244` 实例化 `WaterfallTaskOverlay({...})`，随 A2uiHome 首页渲染；任务执行中/结束时浮层出现在主屏上方。整条链上没有任何 debug 闸门或 build 变量开关。

ℹ tests 7 · pass 4 · fail 3
✖ the sheet close button hides its decorative xmark glyph
  AssertionError: the sheet close button: its SymbolGlyph child at line 164 has no .accessibilityLevel('no'),
  so the screen reader announces a bare symbolglyph right after the wrapper label
✖ the result summary row hides its decorative arrow
  AssertionError: the result summary row: its Image child at line 182 has no .accessibilityLevel('no'), …
✖ the follow-up send button hides its decorative arrow
  AssertionError: the follow-up send button: its Image child at line 197 has no .accessibilityLevel('no'), …
exit=1
```

这三条是「缺 `.accessibilityLevel('no')`」的断言失败，不是节点没定位到（每条都回显了它切到的节点与行号）。红证据所在的提交是 `dc93bd821eb75dfab88661329abf2432f698bce4`（本分支第一个 commit，只含测试文件），该 commit 在 fork 上可直接取。

**绿（本 PR head）**

```

ℹ tests 7 · pass 7 · fail 0   exit=0

$ node --test tests/unit/waterfall-task-overlay-a11y.test.mjs tests/unit/a11y-gate.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-task-card-a11y.test.mjs
ℹ tests 34 · pass 34 · fail 0

**载重（变异检查）**

```

ℹ tests 7 · pass 7 · fail 0
# M1 只删掉 xmark 那行的 .accessibilityLevel('no')
✖ the sheet close button hides its decorative xmark glyph
ℹ tests 7 · pass 6 · fail 1
# M2 还原
ℹ tests 7 · pass 7 · fail 0
```

**gate**

```
$ node scripts/check-a11y.mjs
Files with unnamed tap targets: 28 known, 0 new or worse, 0 stale.   exit=0
```

修复前后都是这条（这三个图标不是 tap target），`tests/unit/a11y-baseline.json` 未改动。

## 改动范围

- 允许改（本 PR 实际改动）：`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/components/WaterfallTaskOverlay.ets`、新增 `tests/unit/waterfall-task-overlay-a11y.test.mjs`。

- 基于 `3802d46e`，改动 2 文件、`+207 / −1`（其中生产代码 +3/−1）。

## 风险与回滚

- 风险：low。只加三个无障碍属性，无逻辑分支、无数据/网络/权限改动，不改变布局与命中区。
- 回滚：`git revert 4efccba`（或整分支关闭），无数据迁移。
- 未覆盖：沙箱无 ArkTS SDK、无真机，**没有在设备上录过 TalkBack/VoiceOver 的实际播报顺序**；结论来自源码级静态断言 + ArkUI `.accessibilityText` / `.accessibilityLevel` 的语义。真机上若发现图标仍被朗读，需要补一次设备核对。

items.body:
## What

Every self-hosted gate job now resolves `runs-on` from a `RUNNER_*` repository variable, keeping the current labels as a literal fallback:

```yaml
runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(vars.RUNNER_CI_NODE_UT || '["self-hosted","Linux","X64","dm-nodeut"]') }}
```

Changing which machine runs a job no longer needs a workflow edit or a pull request. Setting the variable applies to the next workflow run; jobs already running keep their assigned runner.

This branch now includes `main` after #526 consolidated `ut.yml` into `ci.yml`; the routing catalog follows the new `node-ut` / `hypium-ut` / `st` / `gate-report` jobs.

## Changes

- `.github/ci-runners.json`: job → variable → default-label catalog for all 15 self-hosted jobs.
- `scripts/ci-runners.mjs`: `list`, `set`, `reset`, `apply`; supports dry-run, comma lists, JSON arrays and runner groups.
- Converted `ci.yml` (`node-ut`, `hypium-ut`, `st`, `gate-report`), `code-check.yml`, `server-regression.yml`, `eval.yml`, `nightly.yml` and `bench.yml`. GitHub-hosted jobs are unchanged.
- `tests/unit/ci-runner-routing.test.mjs`: keeps each workflow fallback in sync with the catalog, and covers the CLI against a mock Actions variables API.
- `docs/developer_guide/ci.md`: usage, caveats and the full variable table.
- **Also:** `Eval contract (replay)` no longer runs on pull requests. The replay fixtures validate the eval harness, not the product, and its `actions/checkout` step repeatedly timed out on the self-hosted runner. It remains available on pushes to main (eval paths) and `workflow_dispatch`. Covered by a unit test so the PR trigger does not come back.

## Usage

```bash
node scripts/ci-runners.mjs list
node scripts/ci-runners.mjs set ci_node_ut self-hosted,Linux,X64,dm-utility
node scripts/ci-runners.mjs apply /tmp/runner-routing.json
node scripts/ci-runners.mjs reset --all
```

## Behavior and caveats

- With no variables set, behavior is unchanged: every default is the label set that was hard-coded before.
- Changing a default still needs a PR; switching machines does not.
- `pull_request_target` workflows execute the default branch's workflow file, so the runner-routing mechanism becomes effective on PRs once this merges.
- The target runner must already carry the configured labels (or belong to the named runner group).
- Changing variables needs repository admin; `--dry-run` previews the plan.

## Verification

- `node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs tests/unit/ascf-device/*.test.mjs tests/e2e/workflow/workflow.test.mjs`: 2526 tests, 2524 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed (after merging main).
- `actionlint` on the changed workflows: no new findings (only pre-existing shellcheck warnings).
- YAML parse check on all workflow files and `.github/ci-runners.json`.

items.author: HugoXK
items.body:
Fixes #521

## What this changes

`deepSearchSourceHost()` in `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/html/HtmlHomeRenderer.ets` (`HTML_HOME_JS`, `:3749-3771`) derives the domain label rendered next to every deep-search citation (`:3856`). It used to strip the scheme and cut at the first `/`, so the label kept the URL userinfo, the port, the query string and the fragment:

```
https://alice:pw@example.com/a   ->  alice:pw@example.com   (rendered as the site name)
https://user@www.paypal.com/     ->  user@www.paypal.com
https://example.com?q=1          ->  example.com?q=1
https://example.com:8443/x       ->  example.com:8443
http://[::1]:8080/x              ->  [::1]:8080
```

The function now parses the authority in a single character pass: it ends at the first `/`, `?`, `#` **or `\`**, and TAB/LF/CR are dropped instead of being kept in the label (that is what a browser does with whitespace inside a URL). After that the userinfo is dropped at the last `@`, and the port is dropped, except that an IPv6 literal keeps its brackets. The scheme test is case-insensitive, and an empty or non-http(s) input yields `''` instead of the raw value.

Only this one function changed. `openWaterfallSource()` (`:3861`), the click path and the `title || url` fallback at `:3855` are untouched.

## Red first

```
cd <tree at upstream main 1432414e> && node --test tests/unit/deep-search-source-host.test.mjs
ℹ tests 20
ℹ pass 6
ℹ fail 14
```

Six positive cases stay green there, so the red is the assertions and not a broken load. The test slices the shipped `text()` and `deepSearchSourceHost()` out of the real `.ets` (brace matching that skips string literals and comments), strips the types and runs both in a `vm` context — no copy of the implementation and no assertion on the source text.

## Green on the head

```
cd <tree at 55df4a9a> && node --test tests/unit/deep-search-source-host.test.mjs
ℹ tests 20
ℹ pass 20
ℹ fail 0
```

Related page baseline: `tests/unit/waterfall-renderer-interaction.test.mjs` `1/1`.

Whole `tests/unit` suite, same checkout pair (measured on the 17-case revision of this branch, `d45838c1`):

| tree | tests | pass | fail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| main `1432414e` | 1699 | 1657 | 35 |
| head `d45838c1` | 1716 | 1674 | 35 |

The difference is exactly the new cases, and the failing set is byte-for-byte the same 28 files on both sides — all of them stop at `Cannot find module 'typescript'` / `'playwright'`, which this sandbox does not install and CI does.

## Follow-up fix after bot review

`agent-ci-infra-bot` raised one finding (F1, medium): the authority scan stopped only at `/`, `?` and `#`, so a crafted citation could label a host the click does not open — `https://evil.test\@example.com/x` was labelled `example.com`, and `https://example.com\@evil.test/` was labelled `evil.test`.

Fixed in two commits on this branch:

- `bac3c5a2` — adds the three cases (both `\@` directions, plus a TAB inside the host), test file only.
- `55df4a9a` — the scan now also breaks on `\` (char code 92) and skips TAB/LF/CR (9/10/13).

Verified against the previous head with the same 20-case file:

```
cd <tree at d45838c1>        ℹ tests 20  pass 17  fail 3
cd <tree at 55df4a9a>        ℹ tests 20  pass 20  fail 0
```

The three red cases on `d45838c1` are exactly the F1 cases, so the new assertions pin the gap rather than restating the fix.

## Mutation

Each mutation is one edit to the shipped `.ets`; the test file is unchanged.

| mutation | result |
| --- | --- |
| M1 — delete the two userinfo lines | `20 / 16 / 4` |
| M2 — remove the `\` break (char code 92) | `20 / 18 / 2` |
| M3 — remove the TAB/LF/CR skip | `20 / 19 / 1` |

Restoring each edit returns `20/20`. The four M1 reds are the userinfo cases, the two M2 reds are the `\@` cases, the single M3 red is the TAB case — so every branch of the rewrite is pinned by an assertion instead of being dead code.

## Not covered here

- `deepSearchSourceTitle` at `:3855` (`text(source && source.title) || url`) still falls back to the whole URL when a source has no title. That is a citation-title decision, not the host label, and it is left for a follow-up.
- A percent-encoded `%5c` in the authority is kept in the label as-is; such a URL does not open, so the label fails closed.
- The upstream source filter at `:3850` compares the scheme case-insensitively only in this function; a `HTTPS://…` source never reaches it today because the filter above is case-sensitive.

items.author: HugoXK
items.body:
## What this fixes

`popupTitleFromUrl()` decided the popup title by searching the **whole URL** for provider names (`indexOf('google')`, `indexOf('paypal')`, `indexOf('checkout.stripe.com/')`, `indexOf('alipay')`), and `popupSubtitleFromTitle()` then gave every non-neutral title the subtitle **`安全确认页面`**. A page could therefore borrow a provider label with a longer domain label, a userinfo authority, a path or a query string, while the popup has no address bar to correct it:

```
https://notpaypal.com/                       -> "PayPal 确认"     / "安全确认页面"
https://www.paypal.com@evil.test/checkout    -> "PayPal 确认"     / "安全确认页面"
https://paypal.com:443@evil.test/checkout    -> "PayPal 确认"     / "安全确认页面"
https://evil.test/?ref=google                -> "Google Pay 确认" / "安全确认页面"
https://evil.test/checkout.stripe.com/pay/x  -> "支付确认"        / "安全确认页面"
```

Fixes #518.

## Change

One function in `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/components/HtmlHomeSurfaceView.ets`: parse the authority, reject anything that is not `http(s)`, has userinfo, is an IPv6 literal or ends with a dot, strip the port, then name a provider only when `host === domain || host.endsWith('.' + domain)`. The Google Maps branch keeps both the `maps.google.com` host and the `google.com` + `/maps/` path form; `checkout.stripe.com` stays an exact host. `popupSubtitleFromTitle()`, `shouldOpenWaterfallSourceExternally()` and the three call sites (`:181`, `:238`, `:832`) are untouched.

## Commits (4, two files, +174/−5)

1. `1460f3df` — test only (+142): slices `popupTitleFromUrl()` and `popupSubtitleFromTitle()` out of the shipped ArkTS file and executes them; red on unmodified `main`.
2. `ce401058` — the fix (+21/−5).
3. `cac7ba8b` — test only (+5): the first mutation run showed the userinfo guard was **not load-bearing**. `https://www.paypal.com@evil.test/checkout` fell back to the neutral title even with the `@` check deleted, because the allowlist alone rejects a host that still contains `@`. The case that does depend on the check is a userinfo authority **with a port**: port stripping runs after the userinfo test, so `paypal.com:443@evil.test` reduces to `paypal.com` and is labelled `PayPal 确认` again. Commit 3 pins both port forms, and deleting `authority.indexOf(@) >= 0` now fails exactly those two cases.
4. `3a3cb666` — follow-up after the bot review (+5 test, +2/−1 code): reject a backslash in the authority.

## Follow-up fix after bot review

`agent-ci-infra-bot` flagged that a special URL scheme rewrites `\` to `/`, so `https://evil.test\.paypal.com/` opens `evil.test` while the raw authority still ends with `.paypal.com` — the popup said `PayPal 确认`; `https://evil.test\.google.com/maps/x` said `Google Maps 路线` the same way. The repository already rejects such addresses in `workers/WaterfallPoolWorker.ets:429` (`[^/?#@\s\\]+`), so this file was looser than the existing policy.

The authority now also has to be free of backslashes before any provider is named. All three backslash shapes are pinned: on the previous head (`cac7ba8b`) the first two were red and `https://paypal.com\.evil.test/` was already neutral; it stays neutral, because the function does not model the backslash rewrite, it just refuses the shape.

## Evidence (all from a full unpack of `main` at `9cd6dc62`; the branch blobs match the API sha1)

```
# red: unmodified main tree + the final test file
node --test tests/unit/home-popup-title-host.test.mjs
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 3  ℹ fail 16

# green: head 3a3cb666 tree (same blobs)
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 19  ℹ fail 0

# red on the previous head cac7ba8b, before the backslash guard
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 17  ℹ fail 2
✖ https://evil.test\.paypal.com/          actual "PayPal 确认"      expected "内容详情"
✖ https://evil.test\.google.com/maps/x    actual "Google Maps 路线" expected "内容详情"

# M2 on 3a3cb666: delete the @ check
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 17  ℹ fail 2   (the two port-userinfo cases)

# M3 on 3a3cb666: host.endsWith('.paypal.com') -> host.endsWith('paypal.com')
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 18  ℹ fail 1   (https://notpaypal.com/)
```

The 16 red cases on `main` are the look-alike hosts (including `notpaypal.com`, `google.com.evil.test`, both port-userinfo forms, the backslash forms and `evil.test/checkout.stripe.com/pay/x`); the 3 passing ones are the real-provider reverse guard, the subtitle mapping guard and `https://evil.test/#checkout.stripe.com`, which is already neutral on `main` and is kept as a guard next to its red variant.

## Known behaviour change

`https://user@www.paypal.com/` changes from `PayPal 确认` to `内容详情`: any address carrying userinfo is now neutral. This is deliberate — the reader cannot see the userinfo, and the popup has no address bar.

- `https://checkout.stripe.com` (no path) changes from `内容详情` to `支付确认`: matching the exact host is wider than the old substring `checkout.stripe.com/`.
- `https://foo.checkout.stripe.com/pay` changes from `支付确认` to `内容详情`: subdomains of the checkout host are no longer accepted.
- `https://paypal.me/someone` changes from `PayPal 确认` to `内容详情`: the old substring match accepted the `paypal` token anywhere, and `paypal.me` is a different registrable domain. It is a genuine PayPal link domain, so adding it to the allowlist is a follow-up decision.
- `https://gpay.app/x` changes from `Google Pay 确认` to `内容详情`: `gpay.app` is not a Google host, so the old label was wrong; it now falls back to the neutral title.
- `https://paypal.com\` and `https://paypal.com\@evil.test/` fall back to `内容详情` even though a browser would open `paypal.com`: the contract is "any authority containing a backslash is neutral". The function refuses the shape instead of modelling the `\`-to-`/` rewrite, which is the conservative direction.

## Not covered here

- `https://evil.test%5c.paypal.com/` (percent-encoded backslash) still resolves to `PayPal 确认`: WHATWG decodes `%5C` inside the host, which makes the address invalid, so the popup loads nothing (fail-closed). Rejecting `%5c` case-insensitively in the authority would close it; recorded as a follow-up rather than added to this minimal fix.

- `https://www.google.com/search?q=1` keeps `Google Pay 确认 / 安全确认页面` before and after: the mapping is host-level, not path-level, and tightening it beyond the maps branch is a separate decision. `https://www.google.com/maps?q=1` and `https://www.google.com/maps` (path `/maps`, without the trailing slash) keep the same title for the same reason; that is pre-existing behaviour on `main`, not introduced here. Accepting them would take `path === '/maps' || path.startsWith('/maps/')`, which is a behaviour widening and is left for a follow-up issue.
- The popup still renders no URL or host anywhere (`popupUrl` is only assigned/loaded, never rendered as text), so the title remains the only site hint. Giving the sheet a host line is a follow-up.

## Who did what

- Issue text: Lead (Product did not deliver in this round).
- Failing test and the port-userinfo hardening: DigitalMate Test.
- Fix in `HtmlHomeSurfaceView.ets`: DigitalMate Dev-1.
- Integration, red/green/mutation runs and this PR: Lead.

<sub>Fledge · DigitalMate · Dev-1 · implemented</sub>

items.author: HugoXK
items.body: ## What The aggregate-search renderer treated any `http(s)` address as a valid source, so `https://a.com@evil.test/y` rendered as a clickable source button and as the "打开原文" preview, while the WebView/browser lands on `evil.test`. The host that receives the click was never checked. ## Fix - `validSourceUrl()` now also rejects an address whose authority carries userinfo (`url.username || url.password`). It is the single gate behind three consumers: the card source anchor, `normalizedRelatedUrl()`, and the related-image filter — including the `coverUrl` fallback, which used to bypass it. - The aggregate post preview is built outside the template by `renderPostLink()`, which wrote the row URL into `href` with no check at all (`javascript:` included). It now goes through a named `safeExternalUrl()` helper using the repository's existing predicate from `workers/WaterfallPoolWorker.ets:429` (http(s) only, no userinfo in the authority). - An `@` inside the path (`https://a.com/x@evil.test`) is not userinfo and keeps working. The template string runs in the WebView, `renderPostLink()` is ArkTS: the template function is not reachable from native code, so the **same judgement exists once per runtime, as two implementations** — not one shared implementation. The divergence is listed below. ## Files - `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/html/HtmlAggregateSearchHomeRenderer.ets` **+12/−2** - `tests/unit/aggregate-search-link-userinfo.test.mjs` **+144/−0** (new independent test file; the existing `waterfall-renderer-interaction.test.mjs` is untouched and still passes) ## Evidence Red on the unmodified `main` tree (`8cc7213`), module byte-identical to main, only the new test file added: ``` $ node --test tests/unit/aggregate-search-link-userinfo.test.mjs ✖ validSourceUrl rejects a host that is not the one in the address bar ✖ the card source anchor is not rendered for a userinfo address ✖ normalizedRelatedUrl drops a userinfo address and keeps an ordinary one ✖ related markup filters a userinfo image and keeps an ordinary one ✖ the aggregate post link preview does not link to a userinfo address ℹ tests 5 / pass 0 / fail 5 ``` After the fix commits (`7ea044c8`, `4e44321e`): ``` $ node --test tests/unit/aggregate-search-link-userinfo.test.mjs ℹ tests 5 / pass 5 / fail 0 $ node --test tests/unit/waterfall-renderer-interaction.test.mjs ℹ tests 1 / pass 1 / fail 0 ``` Mutation checks (each reverted afterwards): | mutation | result | |---|---| | delete `if (url.username || url.password) return false;` | 4 template blocks red, native block green | | `renderPostLink`: `safeExternalUrl(postLinkUrl(block))` → `postLinkUrl(block)` | only `the aggregate post link preview does not link to a userinfo address` red | | `relatedMarkup`: `validSourceUrl(item.coverUrl) ? … : ''` → `item.coverUrl` | only `related markup filters a userinfo image and keeps an ordinary one` red (5/4/1) | Reverse guards: `https://a.com/x`, `http://a.com`, `https://a.com/x@evil.test` stay valid and still render; `javascript:alert(1)` is rejected on both halves; an ordinary `coverUrl` still renders. ## Known residual: the two implementations diverge on 4 malformed inputs A 24-case truth table run against both shipped implementations (job output, not copied code) found 4 divergences: | input | template `validSourceUrl` | native `safeExternalUrl` | |---|---|---| | `https://@evil.test/y` | true (empty userinfo; host evil.test, label also shows evil.test) | false | | `https://a.com%40evil.test/x` | **false** (WHATWG parser rejects the invalid host) | **true** | | `https:a.com/x` | true (normalised to `https://a.com/x`) | false | | `https://a.com\@evil.test/x` | true (`\` treated as `/`, host stays a.com) | false | Three are the native half being **stricter** (a rare malformed address loses its link; the safe direction). The only looser case is `https://a.com%40evil.test/x`: the native regex accepts it, but the WebView's WHATWG parser rejects it as an invalid host and does not navigate (Node's `URL`, same spec, throws `Invalid URL`). Merging the two fully would require `@ohos.url` on the native side; out of scope here. ## Not covered here - Shared JSON corpus pinning both implementations to one list of URLs (review point 3, self-marked non-blocking): it needs a new corpus file plus both harnesses rewritten, beyond one issue / one PR → follow-up after #512. - The other `coverUrl` → `` sinks in this renderer (`:2958`, `:4791`, `:4870`, `:2913`) and `renderEmbed()`'s `embedUrl`/`thumbnail` → ``/`

items.author: itianshu
items.body:
E2E DAG validation compares fixed component states before and after each action, showing paired expected/actual endpoint values in HTML. Non-applicable checks are hidden. Generated reply wording, intermediate animation sequences and DAG-specific screenshots are excluded. Missing captures, invalid paths, ineffective actions and component mismatches fail the artifact gate.

One shared allowlist enables 12 reviewed cases for both CI execution and independent artifact validation. BACK-01, QUOTE-01 and TRAVEL-01 retain their standards but are deferred. ST and UT do not run application DAG/component gates.

CI validation uses the effective target consistently for job naming, simulator startup and signing checks. The dedicated upstream validation branch builds and installs the checkout on the simulator, launches it without an interactive window, and skips ST/cloud image deployment. Standard/checker tests run before device operations. The CLI resolves canonical entry paths so macOS temporary-directory symlinks cannot silently skip execution. Page preflight reuses the workflow driver's readiness checks and reports login or system-blocking conditions explicitly.

Validation:
- 40 DAG/component checker tests passed locally and on the macOS CI runner, including a symlink-entry regression.
- Remote simulator startup, device connection, native build and HAP installation passed.
- Four device/signing scenarios and two emulator-launch branches checked locally with mocked build/device executables.
- Local three-round E2E experiment (one attempt per case, frozen standards): 12/12, 1/12, 1/12. Of 22 failures, 20 showed reply failure, one showed cloud session recovery failure and one failed foreground readiness. The controlled component case passed 3/3. This does not establish stability of all business terminal-state checks.
- Latest remote run: https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/41620367760 . E2E execution is currently blocked because the remote simulator opens the DigitalMate login page. Authentication must be restored before rerunning; no remote E2E pass is claimed.

Readiness limit: an action boundary is captured after its driver returns and a quiet layout or completed frame. This does not independently guarantee completion of all asynchronous business work. Reply-completion readiness currently includes UI heuristics and a stable-text fallback; fixed endpoint controls are checked against the reviewed standard.

items.author: HugoXK
items.body:
## 问题

「执行步骤」卡片、子代理活动行和步骤摘要都经过 `brief()`（`CloudMessage.ets`）。它只认 `data:` URL 一种二进制形态，而且 scheme 匹配会跨过 JSON 引号：

1. **裸露 base64 不被遮蔽**：`{"image_base64":"iVBORw0KGgo" + "A"×600}` 原样输出 612 个字符（最长到 12000 字符上限），图片生成工具的字节铺满步骤卡片。
2. **多个内联 data URL 被合并**：`{"images":["data:...","data:..."]}` → `{"images":["[二进制内容]"]}`，第二张图消失——`data:[^\s]+;base64,` 会吃到最后一个 `;base64,`，把中间字段吞掉。

Fixes #407

## 改动

`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudMessage.ets`（+6/−1）：

- `data:[^"\s]+;base64,` —— 遇到引号即止，两个二进制条目各自遮蔽，JSON 结构与同级字段保持完整。
- 新增 `[A-Za-z0-9+/]{200,}={0,2}` —— 不带 scheme 的裸 base64（≥200 连续字符）同样折叠为 `[二进制内容]`；阈值远大于任何正常标识符，普通文本、短数字、URL 主机名与 `?download_token=` 既有遮蔽行为不变。
- 不改气泡正文、不改协议、不改任何网络行为。

## 测试

新增 `tests/unit/cloud-binary-mask.test.mjs`，**先失败后通过**（`0fb0456` 上 5 条中 2 条失败：裸 base64 未遮蔽、两个 data URL 合并；修复后 5/5）：

```
node --test tests/unit/cloud-binary-mask.test.mjs
```

回归范围（cloud-* 与 digitalmate-*）：

```
node --test tests/unit/cloud-*.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-*.test.mjs
ℹ tests 1015 · pass 1012 · fail 3
```

3 条失败全部是本地缺依赖导致的既有基线，与本次改动无关：`Cannot find module 'typescript'`（`cloud-account-service`、`cloud-embedding`）、`Cannot find module 'playwright'`；CI 的 `ut.yml` 会安装这些依赖。

## 未验证

- 真机上步骤卡片的排版：仓库无 ArkTS 工具链与真机，只能靠 CI 的 ArkTS Code Check 与纯函数测试。
- 遮蔽阈值 200 是启发式：≥200 连续 `[A-Za-z0-9+/]` 视为编码数据。签名 URL 的超长路径段也会被折叠（主机名仍可见），这是有意的取舍。

## 风险与回滚

只影响步骤/活动文本的显示内容，不改变消息正文与协议。单文件纯函数，回滚只需 revert 这一个 commit。

## What this ships

One focused slice of backlog item **B01 记忆溯源** (`docs/product/backlog.md`): provenance metadata for a memory record + a pure zh/en renderer for the user-facing "why do you remember this?" sentence.

- New module `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/memory/MemoryProvenance.ets` (183 lines, no imports, no new dependencies).
- `MemoryProvenance` = `{ source, sourceTurnId, recordedAt, reasonCode }`; reason codes `user_stated | user_confirmed | leader_inferred | imported | unknown`.
- `normalizeMemoryProvenance` / `memoryProvenanceFromRecord` project existing `MemoryRecord.sourceTurnId` + `createdAt` without touching storage.
- `memoryProvenanceSentence(input, locale)` renders zh or en; `en-*` selects English, everything else Chinese.
- Honest degradation: missing reason renders "没有记录 / not recorded"; empty provenance renders "来源未知 / source unknown"; `leader_inferred` always says it may be wrong.
- UTC-only dates, control-char stripping, 48-char cap on turn references, and the memory fact text is never passed in or echoed.

**Declared cuts:** no management-page UI, no reason-code persistence / DB migration, no wiring into `LongTermMemoryOverviewCoordinator` yet. Those are explicitly out of this PR; the module is the tested substrate for them.

Fixes #416

## Red-first, as real commits

- `f96f0e8` — **test only** (`tests/unit/memory-provenance.test.mjs`, 13 tests). On this commit the suite is red: 13/13 fail, every failure `ENOENT .../MemoryProvenance.ets` (module intentionally absent). Exit code 1.
- `aeb9da5` — implementation. Same command: **13/13 pass**, 0 fail, exit 0.

No fix and test in the same commit; the test file is unchanged between the two commits.

## Tests run

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `node --test tests/unit/memory-provenance.test.mjs` (red, `f96f0e8`) | 13 fail / 13, exit 1, all ENOENT |
| `node --test tests/unit/memory-provenance.test.mjs` (green, `aeb9da5`) | 13 pass / 13, 0 fail, exit 0 |
| `node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs` (branch) | 1647 tests, 1608 pass, 32 fail, 7 skipped |
| same suite on baseline `04621bb` | 1634 tests, 1595 pass, 32 fail, 7 skipped |

The +13 tests / +13 passes are exactly this PR; the 32 failures are the known environment gaps (missing `typescript`, `playwright`, Chromium) and the failing set is identical to baseline apart from reporter naming.

**Not run locally:** ArkTS/`hvigorw` build and on-device rendering (no HarmonyOS toolchain here). The new file is pure ArkTS with no ArkUI imports.

## CI at callback time

- `node-ut`: **success**
- `ArkTS Code Check`: **success**
- `hypium-ut`, `auto-review`, `claude-mention`: skipped (repo defaults)

## Issue labels / repo metadata

Issue #416 carries `feature`, `goal:P1`, `priority:P0`, `source:goal`. `type:feature` **does not exist** in this repo, and this round forbids creating labels, so the issue was opened without it and without touching any repository metadata. No labels, protections, webhooks, secrets or settings were changed.

## Review

Per this round's rule, the COMMENT review must be posted by the DigitalMate Reviewer bot itself. It was asked to review this PR and ran for 15+ minutes, but **posted no review** (`GET /pulls/417/reviews` = 0 at callback time) and it has **no separate GitHub identity/token** in this environment. Posting from this account would be a self-review by the implementation account, so no review was posted and no review id is invented here.

## Privacy / security / rollback

- No secrets, tokens, prompt text or response bodies added; the renderer only receives provenance fields.
- No permission widening, no new dependency, no network or filesystem access in the module.
- Rollback: `git revert f96f0e8..aeb9da5` (one new module + one test file); no data migration, no feature flag needed.
